full_stock_ffed21b0.name: Full Stock
full_stock_ffed21b0.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

canted_animu_sight_f3ea8a7a.name: Canted Animu Sight
canted_animu_sight_f3ea8a7a.info:
Adds an additional Anti at 45° on the sidelines supporting you in the heat of battle, ready to help when she's needed!

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

green_laser_852e4e0d.name: Green Laser
green_laser_852e4e0d.info:
A large tactical green laser that helps improve gun stability.

20% less gun sway
7.5% better recoil recovery
3.5% slower equip speeds

flashlight_a6e10979.name: Flashlight
flashlight_a6e10979.info: A rugged, heavy-duty, high-powered flashlight that lights up dark environments. Don't leave home without one.

canted_acog_scope_4842cbd9.name: Canted Acog Scope
canted_acog_scope_4842cbd9.info:
Adds an additional Acog scope at 45° for those moments you really just need a second scope.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

blue_laser_d59d75f6.name: Blue Laser
blue_laser_d59d75f6.info:
A tactical blue laser designed to improve target acquisition speeds.

Improves aiming speed by 7%.

yellow_laser_0bd92c1d.name: Yellow Laser
yellow_laser_0bd92c1d.info: A yellow-colored laser with a built-in IR illuminator. Improves weapon equip & unequip speeds, and slightly improves weapon sway.

laser_a9d6bd36.name: Laser
laser_a9d6bd36.info:
A red colored laser pointer.
Improves your gun transition speed when you start and stop sprinting.

ballistics_tracker_cdeb1bf3.name: Ballistics Tracker
ballistics_tracker_cdeb1bf3.info:
A StyLiS-branded phone mount. It's duct-taped to the side of your weapon. Somehow the phone can calculate the perfect position for a headshot.
Unbalances the weapon. Tracks targets within a small radius while aiming. Only you can see the targeting dots.

Unfortunately, the always-on targeting system makes it harder to conceal your own presence: your minimap hide range with suppressors is increased (worsened) by 30 studs, and your minimap pings last 30% longer.

canted_furro_sight_015be6b2.name: Canted Furro Sight
canted_furro_sight_015be6b2.info:
Adds awn addwitional fuwwwy at 45° on the sidewines suwppowting u in the heat of battwe, weady to hewp when he's needed! OwO

Pwess T to toggwe between optics and these sights.

canted_iron_sight_da9182e4.name: Canted Iron Sight
canted_iron_sight_da9182e4.info:
Adds an additional set of iron sights at 45°, allowing users to quickly switch from a high powered optic to iron sights for favorable performance in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_delta_sight_c79d63d8.name: Canted Delta Sight
canted_delta_sight_c79d63d8.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45° for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

tri_laser_c6ddbd0c.name: Tri Laser
tri_laser_c6ddbd0c.info:
A triple laser pointer.
Improves hipfire damping and decreases your crosshair size & spread rate.

oil_filter_af703bc6.name: Oil Filter
oil_filter_af703bc6.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

x_ring_a846d488.name: X-Ring
x_ring_a846d488.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

suppressor_8959e9ac.name: Suppressor
suppressor_8959e9ac.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

r2_suppressor_3ce3c955.name: R2 Suppressor
r2_suppressor_3ce3c955.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

ars_suppressor_b79066e4.name: ARS Suppressor
ars_suppressor_b79066e4.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

muffler_13e99d1a.name: Muffler
muffler_13e99d1a.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and reduce RPM by 10%.

compensator_4052c891.name: Compensator
compensator_4052c891.info:
A compensating muzzle device.
40% less horizontal recoil variance
15% more vertical muzzle kick and variance
25% more muzzle climb
Slightly worse hipfire spread and stability.

muzzle_booster_f34875e8.name: Muzzle Booster
muzzle_booster_f34875e8.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

flash_hider_97734ed9.name: Flash Hider
flash_hider_97734ed9.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

loudener_a092301f.name: Loudener
loudener_a092301f.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

long_barrel_ar_2ba256d1.name: Long Barrel (AR)
long_barrel_ar_2ba256d1.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

muzzle_brake_967420e7.name: Muzzle Brake
muzzle_brake_967420e7.info:
A standard muzzle device which reduces vertical recoil climb by dispersing muzzle gases horizontally.

40% reduction in vertical kick
15% increase to vertical stability
15% less vertical rotational recoil
20% less muzzle climb

15% more horizontal recoil variance

halbek_device_72f95e11.name: Halbek Device
halbek_device_72f95e11.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

pbs_4_suppressor_f73c95ef.name: PBS-4 Suppressor
pbs_4_suppressor_f73c95ef.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

pbs_1_suppressor_7cbd4b89.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_7cbd4b89.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

t_brake_1143fcaf.name: T-Brake
t_brake_1143fcaf.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

potato_grip_70a95fd3.name: Potato Grip
potato_grip_70a95fd3.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

romanian_grip_7fe4a2ea.name: Romanian Grip
romanian_grip_7fe4a2ea.info:
A sturdy tactical foregrip that improves gun stability and vertical camera recoil but has worse horizontal recoil control, handling and mobility while aiming.

[GAIN]
-20% Translation recoil.
-10% Vertical camera body (X) recoil.
-10% Vertical camera Body (X) recoil climb.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-20% Idle & Walk sway.
-25% Scope sway.

[LOSS]
+10% Horizontal camera body (Y) recoil.
-5% Walk speed while aiming.
-10% Aiming/Equipping/Sprinting transition speeds.

folding_grip_8426e50a.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_8426e50a.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

angled_grip_7cf1c149.name: Angled Grip
angled_grip_7cf1c149.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
5% faster aiming speeds
8% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces equip speeds by 5%

vertical_grip_a1cbc207.name: Vertical Grip
vertical_grip_a1cbc207.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

[LOSS]
- +12% Camera Body horizontal (Y) recoil.
-5% aim/equip speed.

chainsaw_grip_9cb00d0d.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_9cb00d0d.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

skeleton_grip_72d02e71.name: Skeleton Grip
skeleton_grip_72d02e71.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

stubby_grip_0c7ba1a9.name: Stubby Grip
stubby_grip_0c7ba1a9.info:
A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

15% better weapon sway
15% less muzzle climb and muzzle kick
8% less gun rotational recoil
20% less rearward gun kick
10% better hipfire stability
6% more horizontal gun shake
10% less aiming walkspeed
5% worse equip speed

handstop_5697b84a.name: Handstop
handstop_5697b84a.info:
A low-profile handstop to help you maintain a stable firing position.

Lowers rearward kick by 25%, reduces rearward kick variance by 55%
Slightly improves horizontal and vertical translational recoil and kick
Slightly increases vertical and horizontal variance
10% faster sprint speeds
15% faster aim time
3% better aiming walkspeed
10% lower weapon sway when aiming down sights or scoped in

sideways_grip_7dccbd4f.name: Sideways Grip
sideways_grip_7dccbd4f.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased hipfire spread.Decreased camera body YZ recoil and variance.Slightly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Slightly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation recoil.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

pistol_grip_858d3da9.name: Pistol Grip
pistol_grip_858d3da9.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

hera_cqr_grip_0898a216.name: Hera CQR Grip
hera_cqr_grip_0898a216.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased weapon rotation and translation recoil.Decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased camera body X recoil.Slightly decreased camera body YZ recoil.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation look sway speed.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

hk416a5_300_conversion_edc421a5.name: HK416A5 .300 Conversion
hk416a5_300_conversion_edc421a5.info: I don't really want to write a description for this. You know what it is and why it's here. Enjoy.

reduced_magazine_749d7cfe.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_749d7cfe.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

tracerless_f212a6c7.name: Tracerless
tracerless_f212a6c7.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

223_remington_f48ee8f0.name: .223 Remington
223_remington_f48ee8f0.info:
Civilian version of the 5.56x45mm NATO military round.

Reduces recoil at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and a little bit of penetration and suppression.
Also slightly boosts aim speed!

Decreases camera recoil.
+2.5% Aiming speed.
-7% Min damage.
-25% Max range.
-8% Penetration and Suppression.

armor_piercing_cb8dbb22.name: Armor Piercing
armor_piercing_cb8dbb22.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

hollow_point_bfb6515a.name: Hollow Point
hollow_point_bfb6515a.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).

ta01_acog_9b95fc3b.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_9b95fc3b.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_5b53c0ce.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_5b53c0ce.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_767b6f63.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_767b6f63.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_23060734.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_23060734.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_3a86d9a4.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_3a86d9a4.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_3c8f5f98.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_3c8f5f98.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_5b2363ee.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_5b2363ee.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_fa56e784.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_fa56e784.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

eotech_552_6b470310.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_6b470310.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_fc986836.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_fc986836.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_6bd18ea3.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_6bd18ea3.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_26801c58.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_26801c58.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_367bcad0.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_367bcad0.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_a90eec92.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_a90eec92.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_5ced3039.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_5ced3039.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_22fc4d3e.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_22fc4d3e.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_cfa883be.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_cfa883be.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_efe3aa81.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_efe3aa81.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_a84ab728.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_a84ab728.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_b97aa926.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_b97aa926.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_952388b3.name: Z-Point
z_point_952388b3.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_a6f98522.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_a6f98522.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_3c8f5f98.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_3c8f5f98.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_3c8f5f98.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_3c8f5f98.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_380ed9e1.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_380ed9e1.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

furro_sight_af56c4bc.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_af56c4bc.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_58a61b8b.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_58a61b8b.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_8fa56b7f.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_8fa56b7f.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_bbfa9826.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_bbfa9826.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_c6c98d97.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_c6c98d97.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_28c9ea54.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_28c9ea54.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_5beccb62.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_5beccb62.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_3c8f5f98.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_3c8f5f98.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_13aa3e96.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_13aa3e96.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_9c5bac97.name: M145
m145_9c5bac97.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_7471eee0.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_7471eee0.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

vcog_8x_scope_41ecdfde.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_41ecdfde.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

ta33_acog_3885361d.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_3885361d.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

tango_msr_1_8x_67b77fd6.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_67b77fd6.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_48b215e3.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_48b215e3.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

elfx_sight_3c8f5f98.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_3c8f5f98.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

maglite_40cd5eac.name: Maglite
maglite_40cd5eac.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

ddhb_reflex_68d402f2.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_68d402f2.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

buis_sight_28ff8b49.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_28ff8b49.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

microdot_mini_dd2dc476.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_dd2dc476.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

mro_sight_3c8f5f98.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_3c8f5f98.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

kalashnikov_sight_71c231d3.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_71c231d3.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sro_sight_3c8f5f98.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_3c8f5f98.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_e1ccb841.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_e1ccb841.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_31bee48d.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_31bee48d.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

animu_sight_b4cf80f1.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_b4cf80f1.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

dcl_120_37d89cf8.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window.

troy_flip_up_sight_c6388a95.name: Troy Flip Up Sight

pso_1m2_scope_6d88dc4a.name: PSO-1M2 Scope

electra_5x_1a4219e9.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_1a4219e9.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

mini_sight_ae926a4f.name: Mini Sight

susat_scope_fd6f432a.info:

peak01_sight_3c8f5f98.name: PEAK01 Sight

amt_terminator_045519dc.name: AMT-Terminator

mbus_gen_3_sight_3c8f5f98.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_3c8f5f98.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

eotech_vudu_1_10_7cbd4034.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_7cbd4034.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

mbus_gen_3_sight_d9cb1816.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_d9cb1816.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_e4d22fba.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_e4d22fba.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

eotech_xps2_aa58d2f2.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_aa58d2f2.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

kel_tec_sight_6a7e4863.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_6a7e4863.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

susat_scope_e6bd8c44.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_e6bd8c44.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

reflector_scope_ccd84118.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_ccd84118.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

socom_buis_sight_34b4999e.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_34b4999e.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

elfx_sight_590a29c8.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_590a29c8.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

ta33_acog_bc512468.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_bc512468.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

gyrojet_full_auto_conversion_ab8865cf.name: Gyrojet Full-Auto Conversion
gyrojet_full_auto_conversion_ab8865cf.info:
You ever wonder how the Grand Federation had made it to the moon? Rockets of course!
This fits your Gyrojet with the capability of firing in automatic. Trading off semi-auto performance for full-auto rocket power!

potato_grip_6e0b972b.name: Potato Grip

A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.

gyrojet_12mm_rockets_391bd7c8.name: Gyrojet 12mm Rockets
gyrojet_12mm_rockets_391bd7c8.info:
12mm Rockets introduced with the Gyrojet Mark II.
This makes your Gyrojet load a newer, smaller .49 caliber rocket. These rockets will fly faster at the cost of a longer activation range. Higher firerate.

leupold_m8_6x_c83e99b1.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_c83e99b1.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

collapsible_stock_84983556.name: Collapsible Stock
collapsible_stock_84983556.info: Alternative lightweight stock with the ability to fold down or collapse. Lightens your weapon, but makes it slightly more front-heavy in the process - slightly increasing vertical gun rotation.

retract_stock_84983556.name: Retract Stock
retract_stock_84983556.info:
Fold in the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

magazine_stock_dc425519.name: Magazine Stock
magazine_stock_dc425519.info: Do away with a conventional weapon stock, the PP-2000 has a space for you to place your spare magazines! Increased reserve count, but expect less stability.

osprey_suppressor_a2a86a31.name: Osprey Suppressor
osprey_suppressor_a2a86a31.info:
35 stud detection radius.

A light multi-caliber Western suppressor manufactured by SilencerCo for pistol caliber weaponry. Provides better hipfire accuracy, range, and exceptional masking, however aim accuracy is not affected.

short_barrel_pistol_3279369c.name: Short Barrel (PISTOL)
short_barrel_pistol_3279369c.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

super_armor_piercing_pp2000_e7dd7a45.name: Super Armor Piercing PP2000
super_armor_piercing_pp2000_e7dd7a45.info:
Changes your ammunition to red tipped super armor piercing rounds.
This cartridge in particular is the 7N31 cartridge, originally designed for use with the GSh-18 pistol. Damage drops off immediately with vastly increased bullet penetration but harshly cuts at suppression and long range damage.

plague_insight_e329128e.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_e329128e.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

light_stock_f64a2300.name: Light Stock
light_stock_f64a2300.info:
A lighter alternative over the default stock.
Improves mobility and handling speed but increases recoil due to missing recoil buffer parts. Increases weapon sway when scoping and walking.

g36k_300_conversion_8153dae2.name: G36K .300 Conversion
g36k_300_conversion_8153dae2.info:
Load your AR36K with .300 Blackout, making it the civilian variant with a custom 3-1-S trigger group.

Excellent close range performance, but somewhat worse at longer ranges.

mp7_sight_c1a6398e.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_c1a6398e.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hensoldt_dual_optic_4987eadb.name: Hensoldt Dual Optic
hensoldt_dual_optic_4987eadb.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the AR36 rifles, featuring a 3.0x optical sight accompanied by a special reflex sight.

mbus_pro_sight_c1a6398e.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_c1a6398e.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_c1a6398e.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_c1a6398e.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

super_small_sight_c1a6398e.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_c1a6398e.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mro_sight_c1a6398e.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_c1a6398e.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_c1a6398e.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_c1a6398e.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

peak01_sight_c1a6398e.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_c1a6398e.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_c1a6398e.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_c1a6398e.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_c1a6398e.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_c1a6398e.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

socom_buis_sight_c1a6398e.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_c1a6398e.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

elfx_sight_c1a6398e.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_c1a6398e.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

short_barrel_pistol_d8ae53d6.name: Short Barrel (PISTOL)
short_barrel_pistol_d8ae53d6.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

long_barrel_pistol_c6cad88c.name: Long Barrel (PISTOL)
long_barrel_pistol_c6cad88c.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

410_flechette_edc75770.name: .410 Flechette
410_flechette_edc75770.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 flechettes, six small dart projectiles specially designed to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover.

410_bore_ddc67275.name: .410 Bore
410_bore_ddc67275.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 buckshot, four average sized pellets that are great for putting down pesky human-sized vermin.
Functions almost identically to the Judge default ammo.

410_birdshot_590a3783.name: .410 Birdshot
410_birdshot_590a3783.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 birdshot, small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse.
Fires twice the amount of pellets, but each pellet has lower damage potential and is slower. Reduced penetration. Wider pellet spread due to wider choke.

410_slugs_875f33ce.name: .410 Slugs
410_slugs_875f33ce.info:
Changes your shot load to a .410 slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

410_rubber_pellets_5d4e4e82.name: .410 Rubber Pellets
410_rubber_pellets_5d4e4e82.info:
Changes your load to .410 rubber pellets, three rubber balls projectiles specially designed to make a target feel stinging pain.
Great for close range encounters but hardly make a difference at long range.

ta01_acog_38fbed75.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_38fbed75.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

diopter_sight_open_7d1f8a14.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_7d1f8a14.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

anti_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_7d1f8a14.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_7d1f8a14.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_7d1f8a14.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

mp7_sight_7d1f8a14.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

animu_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

super_slim_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_7d1f8a14.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

malcolm_3x_scope_1c334136.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_1c334136.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

reflex_sight_38fbed75.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_38fbed75.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

leupold_m8_6x_912a6b07.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_912a6b07.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

quick_release_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_38fbed75.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_38fbed75.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_7d1f8a14.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_7d1f8a14.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_38fbed75.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_38fbed75.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_38fbed75.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_38fbed75.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_38fbed75.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_38fbed75.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

reflector_scope_38fbed75.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_38fbed75.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

z_point_38fbed75.name: Z-Point
z_point_38fbed75.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_38fbed75.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_38fbed75.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_7d1f8a14.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

malcolm_6x_scope_1c334136.name: Malcolm 6x Scope
malcolm_6x_scope_1c334136.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Long version of the Malcolm scope design.

ta33_acog_38fbed75.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_38fbed75.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

furro_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

leupold_m8_2x_912a6b07.name: Leupold M8-2x
leupold_m8_2x_912a6b07.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

kobra_ekp_sight_38fbed75.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_38fbed75.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_38fbed75.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_38fbed75.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_38fbed75.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_38fbed75.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_38fbed75.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_38fbed75.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_38fbed75.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_38fbed75.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_7d1f8a14.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_7d1f8a14.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_38fbed75.name: M145
m145_38fbed75.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

tango_msr_1_8x_38fbed75.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_38fbed75.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

vcog_8x_scope_38fbed75.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_38fbed75.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

acog_scope_38fbed75.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_38fbed75.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

1200m_sight_7d1f8a14.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

handmade_sight_38fbed75.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_38fbed75.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

mars_38fbed75.name: MARS
mars_38fbed75.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

maglite_38fbed75.name: Maglite
maglite_38fbed75.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

pilad_3_38fbed75.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_38fbed75.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

pro_3_9x_scope_38fbed75.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_38fbed75.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

kousaku_oled_sight_38fbed75.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_38fbed75.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

mro_sight_38fbed75.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_38fbed75.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

troy_flip_up_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_7d1f8a14.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

sro_sight_38fbed75.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_38fbed75.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_38fbed75.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_38fbed75.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

tac_c_note_38fbed75.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_38fbed75.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

kalashnikov_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mbus_sight_7d1f8a14.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_7d1f8a14.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

hensoldt_3x_sight_38fbed75.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_38fbed75.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

dcl_120_38fbed75.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_38fbed75.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

eotech_m40_38fbed75.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_38fbed75.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

sako_backup_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

electra_5x_38fbed75.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_38fbed75.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

mini_sight_38fbed75.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_38fbed75.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

barska_electro_38fbed75.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_38fbed75.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

hensoldt_z24_38fbed75.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_38fbed75.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

iwi_sight_7d1f8a14.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_7d1f8a14.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

pka_s_38fbed75.name: PKA-S
pka_s_38fbed75.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

coyote_sight_38fbed75.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_38fbed75.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

susat_scope_38fbed75.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_38fbed75.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

peak01_sight_7d1f8a14.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_7d1f8a14.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

c79_38fbed75.name: C79
c79_38fbed75.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

pk_a_38fbed75.name: PK-A
pk_a_38fbed75.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

aac_flip_up_sight_7d1f8a14.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

okp_7_38fbed75.name: OKP-7
okp_7_38fbed75.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

fal_sight_7d1f8a14.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_7d1f8a14.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

eotech_vudu_1_10_38fbed75.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_38fbed75.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

mbus_gen_3_sight_7d1f8a14.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_7d1f8a14.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_7d1f8a14.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

oeg_38fbed75.name: OEG
oeg_38fbed75.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

carry_handle_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_7d1f8a14.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_38fbed75.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_38fbed75.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

steyr_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

eotech_xps2_38fbed75.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_38fbed75.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

vcog_6x_scope_38fbed75.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_38fbed75.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

h_k_sight_7d1f8a14.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

kousaku_sight_38fbed75.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_38fbed75.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

kel_tec_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_7d1f8a14.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

diopter_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

delta_sight_38fbed75.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_38fbed75.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_7d1f8a14.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

hand_sight_7d1f8a14.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_7d1f8a14.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

eotech_552_38fbed75.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_38fbed75.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

microdot_mini_38fbed75.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_38fbed75.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

socom_buis_sight_7d1f8a14.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_7d1f8a14.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

buis_sight_7d1f8a14.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_7d1f8a14.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_38fbed75.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_38fbed75.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_38fbed75.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_38fbed75.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

mbus_pro_sight_7d1f8a14.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_7d1f8a14.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

microdot_srs_38fbed75.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_38fbed75.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

super_armor_piercing_807a7d51.name: Super Armor Piercing
super_armor_piercing_807a7d51.info:
For 5.45x39mm firearms.
Changes your ammunition to red tipped super armor piercing rounds.
Damage drops off immediately with vastly increased bullet penetration (+40%) but harshly cuts at long range damage (-10%) and reduces head damage multiplier (-7.5%).

x95r_300_conversion_ea68b6d9.name: X95R .300 Conversion
x95r_300_conversion_ea68b6d9.info:
Convert your X95R to fire .300 AAC Blackout.
Adjusts performance of the firearm.

x95r_5_56_conversion_0914bef5.name: X95R 5.56 Conversion
x95r_5_56_conversion_0914bef5.info:
Convert your X95R to fire 5.56x45mm NATO.
Adjusts performance of the firearm.

canted_iron_sight_4522d7ad.name: Canted Iron Sight
canted_iron_sight_4522d7ad.info:
Adds an additional set of iron sights at 45°, allowing users to quickly switch from a high powered optic to iron sights for favorable performance in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_delta_sight_4522d7ad.name: Canted Delta Sight
canted_delta_sight_4522d7ad.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45° for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

potato_grip_84aa1b2c.name: Potato Grip
potato_grip_84aa1b2c.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

romanian_grip_84aa1b2c.name: Romanian Grip
romanian_grip_84aa1b2c.info:
A sturdy tactical foregrip that improves gun stability and vertical camera recoil but has worse horizontal recoil control, handling and mobility while aiming.

[GAIN]
-20% Translation recoil.
-10% Vertical camera body (X) recoil.
-10% Vertical camera Body (X) recoil climb.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-20% Idle & Walk sway.
-25% Scope sway.

[LOSS]
+10% Horizontal camera body (Y) recoil.
-5% Walk speed while aiming.
-10% Aiming/Equipping/Sprinting transition speeds.

folding_grip_84aa1b2c.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_84aa1b2c.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

angled_grip_84aa1b2c.name: Angled Grip
angled_grip_84aa1b2c.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
5% faster aiming speeds

vertical_grip_84aa1b2c.name: Vertical Grip
vertical_grip_84aa1b2c.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.

-5% aim/equip speed.

A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

skeleton_grip_84aa1b2c.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

groza_5_45_conversion_e1bc57b6.name: Groza 5.45 Conversion
groza_5_45_conversion_e1bc57b6.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.45x39mm. It was never adopted simply because it was redundant compared to 7.62x39mm performance out of a shorter barrel. Average range performance and comes with a 45rd magazine!

groza_5_56_conversion_aad249c3.name: Groza 5.56 Conversion
groza_5_56_conversion_aad249c3.info: A experimental conversion kit for the OTs-14 'Groza' that allows it to chamber and fire 5.56x45mm NATO. It never went into production due to project funding issues. Improves weapon accuracy drastically but reduces overall damage and range.

mts_570_conversion_086fac7b.name: MTS-570 Conversion
mts_570_conversion_086fac7b.info:
A conversion for the MTS-569.
Trades off the stopping power of 12.7x55mm for the slightly better ballistics of 9x39mm SP, along with less recoil!
Changes the gun's name to the MTS-570!

rsh_12_gauge_327356a4.name: RSH 12 Gauge
rsh_12_gauge_327356a4.info: Loads your revolver in 28 Gauge shells effectively turning it into a full on shotgun revolver!

long_barrel_ar_7dd5b026.name: Long Barrel (AR)
long_barrel_ar_7dd5b026.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

mp7_sight_83e4f89d.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_83e4f89d.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_83e4f89d.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_83e4f89d.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_83e4f89d.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_83e4f89d.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_83e4f89d.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_83e4f89d.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

peak01_sight_83e4f89d.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_83e4f89d.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

fal_sight_83e4f89d.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_83e4f89d.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

mbus_gen_3_sight_83e4f89d.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

socom_buis_sight_83e4f89d.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

aug_a3_cqc_barrel_33e3e188.name: AUG A3 CQC Barrel
aug_a3_cqc_barrel_33e3e188.info:
An intermediate longer barrel for the UAR A3.
Slightly increases range and bullet speed for a slight reduction in handling speeds.
Somewhat acts like a Compensator.

aug_a3_integral_suppressor_c75692ef.name: AUG A3 Integral Suppressor
aug_a3_integral_suppressor_c75692ef.info:
50 stud detection radius.

An integral suppressor designed for the UAR A3.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walk speed and handling!

Converts your UAR A3 to fire 7.62x39mm.
Increases damage and penetration at the cost of high recoil, lower bullet speed and a slower reload time.

aug_300_conversion_ae6a923e.name: AUG .300 Conversion
aug_300_conversion_ae6a923e.info:
Loads your UAR A3 with supersonic .300 Blackout.
Improves close range damage and penetration at the cost of worse ranged damage and bullet speed.
Reduces radar detection range further by 50% with suppressors!

zf69_scope_4bb3f545.name: ZF69 Scope
zf69_scope_4bb3f545.info: A Nomensland fixed-power precision riflescope used as the primary optic for the UAR HBAR-T configuration.

mp7_sight_7753fb50.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_7753fb50.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_7753fb50.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

peak02_sight_7753fb50.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

elfx_sight_7753fb50.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

mro_sight_7753fb50.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_7753fb50.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_7753fb50.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

steyr_integrated_scope_ec54bb2b.name: Steyr Integrated Scope
steyr_integrated_scope_ec54bb2b.info: Integrated railed version of the UAR scope.

bundeswehr_sight_5215b449.name: Bundeswehr Sight
bundeswehr_sight_5215b449.info: Iron sights found on the MG3KWS. Press T for an LMG-style alternate aim mode.

peak01_sight_7753fb50.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_7753fb50.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_7753fb50.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.
