socom_buis_sight_7753fb50.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

short_barrel_ar_140e80dd.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_140e80dd.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

ar_7_62x39_conversion_296bb385.name: AR 7.62x39 Conversion
ar_7_62x39_conversion_296bb385.info: A high-precision rifle round designed to give the AR-15 platform performance somewhat comparable to 7.62x51mm, but with around half of the recoil impulse. The larger bullet is still able to load into the AR-15's magazines, but with a lower maximum capacity.

ar_25_45_conversion_2143bf8d.name: AR 25-45 Conversion
ar_25_45_conversion_2143bf8d.info:
Loads your AR-15 with .25-45 Sharps.
 This uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

full_stock_2c289954.name: Full Stock
full_stock_2c289954.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

retract_stock_2c289954.name: Retract Stock
retract_stock_2c289954.info:
Fold in the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

remove_stock_f6f1b93b.name: Remove Stock
remove_stock_f6f1b93b.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

short_barrel_ar_7112b189.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_7112b189.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

long_barrel_ar_3279369c.name: Long Barrel (AR)
long_barrel_ar_3279369c.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

aku_9mm_conversion_b01d7102.name: AKU 9mm Conversion
aku_9mm_conversion_b01d7102.info:
A speculative 9x19mm kit for the AK-12 platform, likely intended for the export market to law enforcement.

Low damage, low recoil, excellent handling.

bundeswehr_sight_4c6a020f.name: Bundeswehr Sight
bundeswehr_sight_4c6a020f.info: Iron sights found on the MG3KWS. Press T for an LMG-style alternate aim mode.

full_stock_809fd7c6.name: Full Stock
full_stock_809fd7c6.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

hk51b_stock_7765f28e.name: HK51B Stock
hk51b_stock_7765f28e.info: Extend out the MG89B. Generally reduces recoil with mobility drawbacks.

short_barrel_pistol_4ae152de.name: Short Barrel (PISTOL)
short_barrel_pistol_4ae152de.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

silent_904e63aa.name: Silent
silent_904e63aa.info:
An experimental military cartridge designed to improve suppressor function by reducing the velocity of the round to subsonic levels, thereby eliminating the telltale supersonic crack. The round is also heavier, providing better overall energy retention at range - just watch the drop!

Suppressor masking ranges are significantly better with this round!

full_stock_3_0ccff76f.name: Full Stock 3
full_stock_3_0ccff76f.info:
An extended stock, providing a better firing position.

Improves kick damper, kick speed, and general recoil. Reduces aim speed, maneuverability, and hipfire stability.

short_barrel_ar_5cd54c31.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_5cd54c31.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

ar_7_62x39_conversion_c5833a25.name: AR 7.62x39 Conversion
ar_7_62x39_conversion_c5833a25.info: A high-precision rifle round designed to give the AR-15 platform performance somewhat comparable to 7.62x51mm, but with around half of the recoil impulse. The larger bullet is still able to load into the AR-15's magazines, but with a lower maximum capacity.

ar_20_tact_conversion_af46a848.name: AR 20 Tact Conversion
ar_20_tact_conversion_af46a848.info:
Load your Diemaco rifle with .20 Tactical.
Uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. But you'll be punished if shots are missed.

ta01_acog_58a1c0f2.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

diopter_sight_open_58a1c0f2.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_58a1c0f2.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

anti_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_58a1c0f2.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_58a1c0f2.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_58a1c0f2.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_58a1c0f2.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_58a1c0f2.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_58a1c0f2.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_58a1c0f2.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

tac_c_note_58a1c0f2.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_58a1c0f2.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

eotech_552_58a1c0f2.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_58a1c0f2.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_58a1c0f2.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_58a1c0f2.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_58a1c0f2.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_58a1c0f2.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_58a1c0f2.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_58a1c0f2.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_58a1c0f2.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_58a1c0f2.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_58a1c0f2.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

microdot_mini_58a1c0f2.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_58a1c0f2.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

kousaku_oled_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_58a1c0f2.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_58a1c0f2.name: Z-Point
z_point_58a1c0f2.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_58a1c0f2.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_58a1c0f2.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_58a1c0f2.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_58a1c0f2.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_58a1c0f2.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_58a1c0f2.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

furro_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_58a1c0f2.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_58a1c0f2.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_58a1c0f2.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_58a1c0f2.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_58a1c0f2.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_58a1c0f2.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_58a1c0f2.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_58a1c0f2.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_58a1c0f2.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_58a1c0f2.name: M145
m145_58a1c0f2.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

tango_msr_1_8x_58a1c0f2.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_58a1c0f2.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

vcog_8x_scope_58a1c0f2.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

izhmash_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

1200m_sight_58a1c0f2.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

handmade_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_58a1c0f2.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

mars_58a1c0f2.name: MARS
mars_58a1c0f2.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

maglite_58a1c0f2.name: Maglite
maglite_58a1c0f2.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

pilad_3_58a1c0f2.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_58a1c0f2.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

pro_3_9x_scope_58a1c0f2.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_58a1c0f2.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

iwi_sight_58a1c0f2.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_58a1c0f2.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

mro_sight_58a1c0f2.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_58a1c0f2.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

hensoldt_3x_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

sro_sight_58a1c0f2.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_58a1c0f2.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_58a1c0f2.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

super_slim_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

sako_backup_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_58a1c0f2.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_58a1c0f2.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

troy_flip_up_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

dcl_120_58a1c0f2.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_58a1c0f2.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

diopter_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

pso_1m2_scope_58a1c0f2.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_58a1c0f2.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_58a1c0f2.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_58a1c0f2.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

vcog_6x_scope_58a1c0f2.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

barska_electro_58a1c0f2.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_58a1c0f2.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

mini_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_58a1c0f2.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

hensoldt_z24_58a1c0f2.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_58a1c0f2.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

pka_s_58a1c0f2.name: PKA-S
pka_s_58a1c0f2.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

eotech_m40_58a1c0f2.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_58a1c0f2.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

coyote_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

kousaku_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

peak01_sight_58a1c0f2.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_58a1c0f2.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

aac_flip_up_sight_58a1c0f2.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

pk_a_58a1c0f2.name: PK-A
pk_a_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

okp_7_58a1c0f2.name: OKP-7
okp_7_58a1c0f2.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

eotech_vudu_1_10_58a1c0f2.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_58a1c0f2.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

mbus_gen_3_sight_58a1c0f2.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_58a1c0f2.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_58a1c0f2.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_58a1c0f2.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_58a1c0f2.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_58a1c0f2.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_58a1c0f2.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_58a1c0f2.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

oeg_58a1c0f2.name: OEG
oeg_58a1c0f2.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_xps2_58a1c0f2.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_58a1c0f2.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

steyr_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

h_k_sight_58a1c0f2.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_58a1c0f2.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_58a1c0f2.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

kel_tec_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_58a1c0f2.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

susat_scope_58a1c0f2.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

delta_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

reflector_scope_58a1c0f2.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_58a1c0f2.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

animu_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

kalashnikov_sight_58a1c0f2.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

socom_buis_sight_58a1c0f2.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_58a1c0f2.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

buis_sight_58a1c0f2.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_58a1c0f2.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_58a1c0f2.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_58a1c0f2.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_58a1c0f2.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_58a1c0f2.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

ta33_acog_58a1c0f2.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

microdot_srs_58a1c0f2.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_58a1c0f2.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

integral_suppressor_generic_3b099a3d.name: Integral Suppressor (Generic)
integral_suppressor_generic_3b099a3d.info: A suppressor mounted within the handguard of the gun, either permanently affixed to the gun or by using a very short barrel. Provides better masking than standard suppressors and has minimal impact on handling.

chainsaw_grip_f1d10fb1.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_f1d10fb1.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

fast_mag_41e0f157.name: Fast Mag
fast_mag_41e0f157.info: Swaps the gun's magazines to ones designed for speedier reloads, especially on empty. They typically use pull grips that make them easier to remove from pouches, but possess a slightly more awkward profile. Sprint transitions speeds are slightly worse.

reduced_magazine_57c9f4cd.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_57c9f4cd.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

virtus_5_56_35a75eaf.name: VIRTUS 5.56
virtus_5_56_35a75eaf.info: Converts your VIRTUS to fire 5.56x45mm. Provides improved performance at longer range at the cost of CQC damage potential. Comes with a 45 round extended mag!

mp7_sight_a948b1a4.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_a948b1a4.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_a948b1a4.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_a948b1a4.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_a948b1a4.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_a948b1a4.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_a948b1a4.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_a948b1a4.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

mro_sight_a948b1a4.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_a948b1a4.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_a948b1a4.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_a948b1a4.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

peak01_sight_a948b1a4.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_a948b1a4.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_a948b1a4.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_a948b1a4.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_a948b1a4.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_a948b1a4.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

socom_buis_sight_a948b1a4.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_a948b1a4.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

elfx_sight_a948b1a4.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_a948b1a4.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

mc51sd_stock_2c289954.name: MC51SD Stock
mc51sd_stock_2c289954.info: STG-89C's stock now extended out. Reduces recoil while reducing mobility and hipfire stability.

r2_suppressor_3e2696c8.name: R2 Suppressor
r2_suppressor_3e2696c8.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

integral_mc51_8ffefd01.name: Integral MC51
integral_mc51_8ffefd01.info: An integral suppressor for the STG-89C.

long_barrel_mc51_8ffefd01.name: Long Barrel (MC51)
long_barrel_mc51_8ffefd01.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

pbs_4_suppressor_3e2696c8.name: PBS-4 Suppressor
pbs_4_suppressor_3e2696c8.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

ars_suppressor_3e2696c8.name: ARS Suppressor
ars_suppressor_3e2696c8.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

flash_hider_2d61ccad.name: Flash Hider
flash_hider_2d61ccad.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

pbs_1_suppressor_3e2696c8.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_3e2696c8.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

suppressor_3e2696c8.name: Suppressor
suppressor_3e2696c8.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

straight_pull_bolt_8ba75e97.name: Straight Pull Bolt
straight_pull_bolt_8ba75e97.info:
Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all your chakras.
Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, can cycle freely, have a lot less weapon sway and can hold breath for longer while scoping.
Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

bloxy_cola_a872d45d.name: Bloxy Cola
bloxy_cola_a872d45d.info: Warning: Bloxy Cola may be habit-forming.

cannon_ball_1622f821.name: Cannon Ball
cannon_ball_1622f821.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with a literal cannon ball! Armed with a true cannon, become a swashbuckling pirate with this slow but powerful projectile!

golf_ball_bb5df0fe.name: Golf Ball
golf_ball_bb5df0fe.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with a golf ball! Take to the green and score a hole in one with a higher velocity projectile! It is however weaker in terms of overall damage due to being smaller.

marble_jar_45bdee28.name: Marble Jar
marble_jar_45bdee28.info:
A masonry jar full with half-inch diameter glass marbles. The shattering glass and the marbles will make for excellent shrapnel against any close range target, however....glass doesn't fly very far, so velocity will drop badly.

Now, eat the forbidden caviar...just don't lose your marbles while doing it, will ya?

heavy_can_574cb85e.name: Heavy Can
heavy_can_574cb85e.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with a larger can! This can is taller, making it heavier, it'll travel slower but it'll do a lot more damage. Taste the sand, no matter how coarse it is.

tennis_balls_49dc19c5.name: Tennis Balls
tennis_balls_49dc19c5.info: Instead of a regular drink can, load your CAN CANNON with two tennis balls! Start a ralley and launch two tennis balls which will deal more damage in range! Accounting for how light tennis balls are there may be deviation into if they will hit anyone.

17_hmr_blanks_46c636e5.name: .17 HMR Blanks
17_hmr_blanks_46c636e5.info:
Challenge Mode Unlocked!
Extremely low caliber blanks with pitiful performance, but better handling!
Good luck!

7_62x39_blanks_8d4b099a.name: 7.62x39 Blanks
7_62x39_blanks_8d4b099a.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with 7.62x39mm blank rounds! These being larger cartridges means you will propel your projectile further than 5.56x45mm, you also get greater ranges. However, there is the smaller magazine to tend to.

50_beowulf_blanks_c19f76a4.name: .50 Beowulf Blanks
50_beowulf_blanks_c19f76a4.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with custom 12.7x42mm blanks! Despite your small reserve pool, you get a large boost to your range potential with poorer velocity and close range performance.

223_blanks_baa97ec1.name: .223 Blanks
223_blanks_baa97ec1.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with .223 Remington blank rounds! These being weaker cartridges will hurt your projecticles range performance, hurting velocity and damage ranges. But fret not! For you have a 50 round drum!

sagittarius_40x_02f7140a.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_02f7140a.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

pm_ii_02f7140a.name: PM II
pm_ii_02f7140a.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

hollow_point_9cab4c2d.name: Hollow Point
hollow_point_9cab4c2d.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).

extended_magazine_1ab6b4f4.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_1ab6b4f4.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

armor_piercing_11748ee5.name: Armor Piercing
armor_piercing_11748ee5.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

pkp_duplex_f2474b2d.name: PKP Duplex
pkp_duplex_f2474b2d.info:
Loads your PKP with deadly 7.62x54mmR Duplex rounds.
Fires two bullets that deal significantly higher damage if both hit the same target.
Reduced fire rate due to the lower powder load.
Reduced penetration, suppression and may deviate from the center.

extended_stock_503d3ddb.name: Extended Stock
extended_stock_503d3ddb.info: Extend out the weapon stock for greater aiming recoil reduction while increasing aiming and sprint to aim time.

short_barrel_ar_679eb84e.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_679eb84e.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

long_barrel_ar_fa151508.name: Long Barrel (AR)
long_barrel_ar_fa151508.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

reduced_magazine_a2512a82.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_a2512a82.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

m16a1_m855_7cd42ef7.name: M16A1 M855
m16a1_m855_7cd42ef7.info:
Load your GAU-5A/A with green-tipped M855 5.56x45mm ammo.

Later used due to being more favourable than M193, M855 has much greater penetration potential than the M193.

However M855 has erratic performance when fired in the GAU-5A/A as bullets tumble in the air.

colt_retro_scope_ec6be0a6.name: Colt Retro Scope
colt_retro_scope_ec6be0a6.info: A reissued version of the original M16A1 4x21mm rifle scope, mounting directly to the gun's carry handle. Minimal impact on handling.

speedloader_922b3d8d.name: Speedloader
speedloader_922b3d8d.info: A lightweight piece of kit that is perfect for making reloading revolvers a breeze. When you use all of your rounds in the cylinder, you can reload at a faster rate! However it comes at the cost of a slower reload when theres unspent rounds in the cylinder.

diopter_sight_open_38fbed75.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_38fbed75.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

anti_sight_38fbed75.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_38fbed75.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_38fbed75.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_38fbed75.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

mp7_sight_38fbed75.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_38fbed75.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_38fbed75.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_38fbed75.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_38fbed75.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

quick_release_sight_38fbed75.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_38fbed75.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_38fbed75.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_38fbed75.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_38fbed75.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_38fbed75.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

izhmash_sight_38fbed75.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_38fbed75.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

super_small_sight_38fbed75.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_38fbed75.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

furro_sight_38fbed75.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_38fbed75.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

peak02_sight_38fbed75.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_38fbed75.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_38fbed75.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

1200m_sight_38fbed75.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

buis_sight_38fbed75.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

mbus_pro_sight_38fbed75.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_38fbed75.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

sako_backup_sight_38fbed75.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_38fbed75.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

double_open_sight_38fbed75.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_38fbed75.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

animu_sight_38fbed75.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_38fbed75.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

kalashnikov_sight_38fbed75.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mbus_sight_38fbed75.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_38fbed75.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

troy_flip_up_sight_38fbed75.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_38fbed75.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

kel_tec_sight_38fbed75.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_38fbed75.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

aac_flip_up_sight_38fbed75.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

steyr_sight_38fbed75.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

mbus_gen_3_sight_38fbed75.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_38fbed75.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_38fbed75.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_38fbed75.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_38fbed75.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_38fbed75.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_38fbed75.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

peak01_sight_38fbed75.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_38fbed75.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

h_k_sight_38fbed75.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

diopter_sight_38fbed75.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_38fbed75.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

iwi_sight_38fbed75.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_38fbed75.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

full_ring_sight_38fbed75.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_38fbed75.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

socom_buis_sight_38fbed75.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_38fbed75.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

short_barrel_ar_53cbea2d.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_53cbea2d.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

ar_7_62x39_conversion_9c8fe1de.name: AR 7.62x39 Conversion
ar_7_62x39_conversion_9c8fe1de.info: A high-precision rifle round designed to give the AR-15 platform performance somewhat comparable to 7.62x51mm, but with around half of the recoil impulse. The larger bullet is still able to load into the AR-15's magazines, but with a lower maximum capacity.

ar_25_45_conversion_71210fbc.name: AR 25-45 Conversion
ar_25_45_conversion_71210fbc.info:
Loads your AR-15 with .25-45 Sharps.
 This uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

elfx_sight_ab885e47.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_ab885e47.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

mro_sight_ab885e47.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_ab885e47.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_ab885e47.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_ab885e47.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

folding_grip_34981335.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_34981335.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

angled_grip_34981335.name: Angled Grip
angled_grip_34981335.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
5% faster aiming speeds
8% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces equip speeds by 5%

vertical_grip_34981335.name: Vertical Grip
vertical_grip_34981335.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

[LOSS]
- +12% Camera Body horizontal (Y) recoil.
-5% aim/equip speed.

stubby_grip_34981335.name: Stubby Grip
stubby_grip_34981335.info:
A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

15% better weapon sway
15% less muzzle climb and muzzle kick
8% less gun rotational recoil
20% less rearward gun kick
10% better hipfire stability
6% more horizontal gun shake
10% less aiming walkspeed
5% worse equip speed

45_special_2135fe65.name: .45 Special
45_special_2135fe65.info:
Modernised version of the .45 ACP cartridge made of stronger brass and filled with more powder. All without changing the original cartridge dimensions.
Increases overall bullet performance, with poorer damage in range. Greater velocity and range.

plus_p_08ff68c3.name: Plus P
plus_p_08ff68c3.info:
Overpacked with powder, these rounds aim to make your bullets fly faster, penetrate surfaces better, and increase suppression.
Harder to control.

usc_40_conversion_127b7c6d.name: USC 40 Conversion
usc_40_conversion_127b7c6d.info:
Changes the ammunition fired from your PDC-45 with .40 S&W.
Allows for a lethal one shot to the head at close range. Increases fire rate, bullet speed and lowers recoil at the cost of general body damage and range.

mp7_sight_56f6befd.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_56f6befd.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

skeleton_grip_6699dbf8.name: Skeleton Grip
skeleton_grip_6699dbf8.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

hera_cqr_grip_6699dbf8.name: Hera CQR Grip
hera_cqr_grip_6699dbf8.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased weapon rotation and translation recoil.Decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased camera body X recoil.Slightly decreased camera body YZ recoil.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation look sway speed.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

k1a_7_62x39_conversion_ccb602f3.name: K1A 7.62x39 Conversion
k1a_7_62x39_conversion_ccb602f3.info:
Loads your K1A with 7.62x39mm.
Compared to the DR-300, this is a modification to your K1A which through some clever machining, makes it the MAX-III, allowing it to feed the same 7.62x39 magazines coming with the same flaws as the DR-300 in its design.

ta01_acog_414b28c1.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_414b28c1.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_414b28c1.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_414b28c1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_414b28c1.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_414b28c1.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_3fb0c0c2.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

eotech_552_414b28c1.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_414b28c1.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_414b28c1.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_414b28c1.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_414b28c1.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_414b28c1.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_3eca8025.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_3eca8025.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_414b28c1.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_414b28c1.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_414b28c1.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_414b28c1.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_414b28c1.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_414b28c1.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_414b28c1.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_414b28c1.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_414b28c1.name: Z-Point
z_point_414b28c1.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_414b28c1.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_414b28c1.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_414b28c1.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_414b28c1.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

furro_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_414b28c1.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_414b28c1.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_414b28c1.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_414b28c1.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_414b28c1.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_414b28c1.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_414b28c1.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_414b28c1.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_414b28c1.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_414b28c1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_414b28c1.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_414b28c1.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_414b28c1.name: M145
m145_414b28c1.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

vcog_8x_scope_414b28c1.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_414b28c1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

tango_msr_1_8x_414b28c1.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_414b28c1.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_414b28c1.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_414b28c1.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

1200m_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

maglite_414b28c1.name: Maglite
maglite_414b28c1.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

ta33_acog_414b28c1.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_414b28c1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

elfx_sight_414b28c1.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_414b28c1.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

ddhb_reflex_414b28c1.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_414b28c1.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

mro_sight_414b28c1.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_414b28c1.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

buis_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

sro_sight_414b28c1.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_414b28c1.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_414b28c1.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_414b28c1.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

microdot_mini_414b28c1.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_414b28c1.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

sako_backup_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

kalashnikov_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

dcl_120_414b28c1.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_414b28c1.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

animu_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

pso_1m2_scope_414b28c1.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_414b28c1.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_414b28c1.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_414b28c1.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

reflector_scope_414b28c1.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_414b28c1.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

barska_electro_414b28c1.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_414b28c1.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

mini_sight_414b28c1.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_414b28c1.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

susat_scope_414b28c1.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_414b28c1.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

pka_s_414b28c1.name: PKA-S
pka_s_414b28c1.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

kel_tec_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

coyote_sight_414b28c1.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_414b28c1.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

diopter_sight_open_3fb0c0c2.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_3fb0c0c2.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

c79_414b28c1.name: C79
c79_414b28c1.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

kousaku_sight_414b28c1.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_414b28c1.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

peak01_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

steyr_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

eotech_xps2_414b28c1.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_414b28c1.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

eotech_vudu_1_10_414b28c1.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_414b28c1.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_414b28c1.name: OKP-7
okp_7_414b28c1.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

oeg_414b28c1.name: OEG
oeg_414b28c1.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

amt_terminator_414b28c1.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_414b28c1.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

mbus_gen_3_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

pk_a_414b28c1.name: PK-A
pk_a_414b28c1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

aac_flip_up_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

h_k_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_414b28c1.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_414b28c1.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_414b28c1.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_414b28c1.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_m40_414b28c1.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_414b28c1.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

delta_sight_414b28c1.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_414b28c1.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

troy_flip_up_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

tac_c_note_414b28c1.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_414b28c1.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

hensoldt_3x_sight_414b28c1.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_414b28c1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

diopter_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

socom_buis_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_414b28c1.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_414b28c1.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_414b28c1.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_414b28c1.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_414b28c1.name: MARS
mars_414b28c1.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

iwi_sight_3fb0c0c2.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_3fb0c0c2.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_414b28c1.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_414b28c1.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

collapsible_stock_d0d89c0a.name: Collapsible Stock
collapsible_stock_d0d89c0a.info: Alternative lightweight stock with the ability to fold down or collapse. Lightens your weapon, but makes it slightly more front-heavy in the process - slightly increasing vertical gun rotation.

reduced_magazine_fd9f0954.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_fd9f0954.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

mp7_sight_50327d36.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_50327d36.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_50327d36.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_50327d36.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_50327d36.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_50327d36.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_50327d36.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_50327d36.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

mro_sight_50327d36.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_50327d36.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_50327d36.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_50327d36.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

peak01_sight_50327d36.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_50327d36.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_50327d36.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_50327d36.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_50327d36.name: FAL Sight
