A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

15% better weapon sway
15% less muzzle climb and muzzle kick
8% less gun rotational recoil
20% less rearward gun kick
10% better hipfire stability
6% more horizontal gun shake
10% less aiming walkspeed
5% worse equip speed

yellow_laser_830a205c.name: Yellow Laser
yellow_laser_830a205c.info: A yellow-colored laser with a built-in IR illuminator. Improves weapon equip & unequip speeds, and slightly improves weapon sway.

fbi_10_tommy_e6198388.name: FBI 10 TOMMY
fbi_10_tommy_e6198388.info:
Change the internals of your Thompson with those of the specialized FBI variant that fired 10mm Auto.
Turn the criminal's own weapon against them, with rounds kick like a mule!

lyman_sight_fec50af9.name: Lyman Sight
lyman_sight_fec50af9.info:
Flip up the Thompson's rear sight.
The Lyman sight was created specifically for the Thompson. It is primarily found on Soveran models of the weapon and exists on most Thompsons.

extended_magazine_2fac3a8e.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_2fac3a8e.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

beta_c_drum_mag_cdade875.name: Beta C Drum Mag
beta_c_drum_mag_cdade875.info:
A large 100 round Beta-C drum magazine!
Allows you to fire for a long time at the cost of walk walkspeed, your aim, sprint and equip transition speeds and increases reload time significantly!

hk_reduced_mag_48fa7e48.name: HK Reduced Mag
hk_reduced_mag_48fa7e48.info: A smaller magazine that only holds 10 rounds! But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun significantly!

full_stock_3_1cdbab58.name: Full Stock 3
full_stock_3_1cdbab58.info: A modernization kit for the Rattler with an updated receiver and handguard assembly in the style of the SPEAR LT.

suppressor_07466acf.name: Suppressor
suppressor_07466acf.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

oil_filter_385fa161.name: Oil Filter
oil_filter_385fa161.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

pbs_4_suppressor_b7815e0d.name: PBS-4 Suppressor
pbs_4_suppressor_b7815e0d.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

pbs_1_suppressor_4f394345.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_4f394345.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

rattler_7_62x39_ce1cf137.name: RATTLER 7.62x39
rattler_7_62x39_ce1cf137.info: Converts your RATTLER to fire 7.62x39mm, improving damage and consistency at the expense of recoil control and velocity.

223_remington_4d0eb4d7.name: .223 Remington
223_remington_4d0eb4d7.info:
Civilian version of the 5.56x45mm NATO military round.

Reduces recoil at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and a little bit of penetration and suppression.
Also slightly boosts aim speed!

Decreases camera recoil.
+2.5% Aiming speed.
-7% Min damage.
-25% Max range.
-8% Penetration and Suppression.

oss_suppressor_12dd3c43.name: OSS Suppressor
oss_suppressor_12dd3c43.info:
35 stud detection radius.

Covert Ops suppressor built during WW2 to accommodate the M3 SMG, and adapted for use on the M3A1.
Improved performance at range with decent masking.

type_37_conversion_7b8aaed1.name: Type 37 Conversion
type_37_conversion_7b8aaed1.info:
Changes the internals of your M3A1 to match the one of its clone, the Type 37.
This clone developed by Jinhan fires 9x19mm. Offering a higher headshot multiplier, more accuracy, more spare ammo and better range performance!
However, your close range damage is reduced!

mp7_sight_3f2888cc.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_3f2888cc.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_3f2888cc.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_3f2888cc.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_3f2888cc.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_3f2888cc.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_3f2888cc.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_3f2888cc.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

elfx_sight_3f2888cc.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_3f2888cc.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

mro_sight_3f2888cc.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_3f2888cc.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_3f2888cc.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_3f2888cc.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

peak01_sight_3f2888cc.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_3f2888cc.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

fal_sight_3f2888cc.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_3f2888cc.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

mbus_gen_3_sight_3f2888cc.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_3f2888cc.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

socom_buis_sight_3f2888cc.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_3f2888cc.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

scar_sc_integral_767bc502.name: SCAR SC Integral
scar_sc_integral_767bc502.info:
An odd suppressor that almost makes you feel as though the gun should be firing BBs instead of bullets...

Don't ask how it works, we don't know either.

g36c_300_conversion_fb909e73.name: G36C .300 Conversion
g36c_300_conversion_fb909e73.info:
Load your AR36C with .300 Blackout, making it the civilian variant with a custom 3-1-S trigger group.

Excellent close range performance, but somewhat worse at longer ranges.

mp7_sight_da1bccfc.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_da1bccfc.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

socom_buis_sight_da1bccfc.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

ia2_smg_40_s_w_b6e97c52.name: IA2 SMG 40 S&W
ia2_smg_40_s_w_b6e97c52.info:
Converts your IA2 SMG to fire .40 S&W. Increased damage up close while also increasing penetration and suppression but worse ranged performance and slightly higher recoil!
Smaller magazine capacity but lowers overall gun weight.

five_0_full_auto_trigger_group_3b7ab0e6.info: Change the trigger group of your FIVE-0 to make it fire in full-automatic and semi-automatic. Lowers your firerate, ranges, and increases recoil somewhat.

five_0_9mm_conversion_9f7ef595.name: FIVE-0 9mm Conversion
five_0_9mm_conversion_9f7ef595.info: Convert your FIVE-0 into firing 9x19mm, greatly increases your magazine capacity at the cost of close range effectiveness. Also increases rate of fire.

mp5sd_burst_trigger_group_ff769a06.name: MP5SD Burst Trigger Group
mp5sd_burst_trigger_group_ff769a06.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9SD to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance at further distances with damage dropping off slower. Generally easier to control recoil.

long_barrel_pistol_69de1d6e.name: Long Barrel (PISTOL)
long_barrel_pistol_69de1d6e.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

mac10_stock_553caedb.name: Mac10 Stock
mac10_stock_553caedb.info: Extend the default stock out to reduce overall camera recoil with some minor handling and reload speed reductions.

canted_iron_sight_856cb780.name: Canted Iron Sight
canted_iron_sight_856cb780.info:
Adds an additional set of iron sights at 45°, allowing users to quickly switch from a high powered optic to iron sights for favorable performance in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_acog_scope_856cb780.name: Canted Acog Scope
canted_acog_scope_856cb780.info:
Adds an additional Acog scope at 45° for those moments you really just need a second scope.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_delta_sight_856cb780.name: Canted Delta Sight
canted_delta_sight_856cb780.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45° for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

sionics_suppressor_d02bc354.name: Sionics Suppressor
sionics_suppressor_d02bc354.info:
No detection radius.

A unique suppressor designed for the MAC-10, famous for being so quiet that the action can be heard cycling. A mixture of the long barrel and heavy suppressor. Great for close range combat, but can be decently useful at long range too.

m10_carbine_barrel_1fc9281a.name: M10 Carbine Barrel
m10_carbine_barrel_1fc9281a.info: A familiar looking barrel for the Carbine Variant of the MAC-10. Further positives but also negative aspects than the typical long barrel!

potato_grip_a1b240c4.name: Potato Grip
potato_grip_a1b240c4.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

folding_grip_a1b240c4.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

45_special_4a6c388a.info:
Modernised version of the .45 ACP cartridge made of stronger brass and filled with more powder. All without changing the original cartridge dimensions.
Increases overall bullet performance, with poorer damage in range. Greater velocity and range.

mac10_9mm_conversion_54a9808b.name: Mac10 9mm Conversion
mac10_9mm_conversion_54a9808b.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MAC-10 into 9x19mm!
Shoots significantly faster. Reduces recoil and improves bullet speed but weaker damage!

ta01_acog_da8e2c57.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_da8e2c57.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_da8e2c57.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_da8e2c57.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_da8e2c57.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_da8e2c57.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_da8e2c57.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_da8e2c57.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_da8e2c57.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_da8e2c57.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_da8e2c57.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_da8e2c57.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_da8e2c57.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_da8e2c57.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_da8e2c57.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

eotech_552_da8e2c57.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_da8e2c57.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_da8e2c57.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_da8e2c57.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_da8e2c57.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_da8e2c57.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_da8e2c57.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_da8e2c57.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_da8e2c57.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_da8e2c57.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_da8e2c57.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_da8e2c57.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_da8e2c57.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_da8e2c57.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_a4ec8a30.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_a4ec8a30.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_da8e2c57.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_da8e2c57.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_da8e2c57.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_da8e2c57.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_da8e2c57.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_da8e2c57.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_da8e2c57.name: Z-Point
z_point_da8e2c57.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_da8e2c57.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_da8e2c57.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_da8e2c57.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_da8e2c57.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_da8e2c57.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_da8e2c57.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_da8e2c57.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_da8e2c57.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

kobra_ekp_sight_da8e2c57.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_da8e2c57.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_da8e2c57.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_da8e2c57.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_da8e2c57.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_da8e2c57.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_da8e2c57.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_da8e2c57.info:

global_offensive_scope_da8e2c57.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_da8e2c57.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_da8e2c57.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_da8e2c57.name: M145
m145_da8e2c57.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_da8e2c57.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

vcog_8x_scope_da8e2c57.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_da8e2c57.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

ta33_acog_da8e2c57.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_da8e2c57.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

tango_msr_1_8x_da8e2c57.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_da8e2c57.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_da8e2c57.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_da8e2c57.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

elfx_sight_da8e2c57.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_da8e2c57.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

maglite_da8e2c57.name: Maglite
maglite_da8e2c57.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

ddhb_reflex_da8e2c57.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_da8e2c57.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

buis_sight_da8e2c57.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

microdot_mini_da8e2c57.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_da8e2c57.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

mro_sight_da8e2c57.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_da8e2c57.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

kalashnikov_sight_da8e2c57.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sro_sight_da8e2c57.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_da8e2c57.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_da8e2c57.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_da8e2c57.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_da8e2c57.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_da8e2c57.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

animu_sight_da8e2c57.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_da8e2c57.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

sako_backup_sight_da8e2c57.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_da8e2c57.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_da8e2c57.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_da8e2c57.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

reflector_scope_da8e2c57.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_da8e2c57.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

dcl_120_da8e2c57.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_da8e2c57.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

troy_flip_up_sight_da8e2c57.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_da8e2c57.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

pso_1m2_scope_da8e2c57.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_da8e2c57.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_da8e2c57.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_da8e2c57.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

mini_sight_da8e2c57.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_da8e2c57.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

barska_electro_da8e2c57.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_da8e2c57.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

susat_scope_da8e2c57.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_da8e2c57.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

kel_tec_sight_da8e2c57.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_da8e2c57.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

pka_s_da8e2c57.name: PKA-S
pka_s_da8e2c57.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

diopter_sight_open_da8e2c57.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_da8e2c57.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

coyote_sight_da8e2c57.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_da8e2c57.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

kousaku_sight_da8e2c57.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_da8e2c57.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

c79_da8e2c57.name: C79
c79_da8e2c57.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

steyr_sight_da8e2c57.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

peak01_sight_da8e2c57.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_da8e2c57.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

eotech_xps2_da8e2c57.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_da8e2c57.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

oeg_da8e2c57.name: OEG
oeg_da8e2c57.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_vudu_1_10_da8e2c57.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_da8e2c57.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_da8e2c57.name: OKP-7
okp_7_da8e2c57.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_da8e2c57.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_da8e2c57.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_da8e2c57.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_da8e2c57.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_da8e2c57.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_da8e2c57.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_da8e2c57.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

mbus_gen_3_sight_da8e2c57.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_da8e2c57.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

pk_a_da8e2c57.name: PK-A
pk_a_da8e2c57.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

aac_flip_up_sight_da8e2c57.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

h_k_sight_da8e2c57.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_da8e2c57.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_da8e2c57.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_da8e2c57.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_da8e2c57.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_m40_da8e2c57.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_da8e2c57.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

delta_sight_da8e2c57.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_da8e2c57.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_da8e2c57.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_da8e2c57.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

tac_c_note_da8e2c57.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_da8e2c57.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

hensoldt_3x_sight_da8e2c57.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_da8e2c57.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

diopter_sight_da8e2c57.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_da8e2c57.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

socom_buis_sight_da8e2c57.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_da8e2c57.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_da8e2c57.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_da8e2c57.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_da8e2c57.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_da8e2c57.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_da8e2c57.name: MARS
mars_da8e2c57.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

iwi_sight_da8e2c57.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_da8e2c57.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_da8e2c57.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_da8e2c57.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

full_stock_95b60b14.name: Full Stock
full_stock_95b60b14.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

full_stock_3_79bdbc7e.name: Full Stock 3
full_stock_3_79bdbc7e.info:
An extended stock, providing a better firing position.

Improves kick damper, kick speed, and general recoil. Reduces aim speed, maneuverability, and hipfire stability.

uzi_light_bolt_94f24fc0.name: Uzi Light Bolt
uzi_light_bolt_94f24fc0.info: Installs a lightweight bolt into the Uzi, significantly increasing the weapon's rate of fire. Unfortunately, you lose some controllability in the process.

uzi_45_conversion_70fcaaa7.name: Uzi .45 Conversion
uzi_45_conversion_70fcaaa7.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .45 ACP.
Improve damage performance but makes the recoil harder to control. Lowered RPM.
Conversion kit by Vector Arms allows the UZI to use M3A1 magazines!

uzi_41_conversion_2c707362.name: Uzi .41 Conversion
uzi_41_conversion_2c707362.info:
Locks to Semi-Auto.
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .41 Action Express in a custom 20 round magazine. Perfect for seige missions.
Use this ammo to punch through cover, and land harder hits to take down the opposition.

uzi_22lr_conversion_c133ad46.name: Uzi .22LR Conversion
uzi_22lr_conversion_c133ad46.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your UZI into .22 Long Rifle.
Stats similar to the ZIP22... But in full auto! Why would you do this?
Comes with a specially made 50 round Promag!

cmars_9x30_conversion_8cb72e76.name: CMARS 9x30 Conversion
cmars_9x30_conversion_8cb72e76.info:
Load your MARS with 9x30mm MARS, a cartridge made from a necked down 10mm Magnum round.

Possesses high stopping power up close, but falls off at longer ranges.

plague_insight_f1caead1.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_f1caead1.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

c79_58a1c0f2.name: C79
c79_58a1c0f2.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

x95_armscor_ammo_a5853399.name: X95 Armscor Ammo
x95_armscor_ammo_a5853399.info: Specialty Armascor 9x19mm ammo stuffed with 3 tiny, buckshot-like, pellets. Splits the stats, and uses a smaller magazine than normal. More powerful than you'd expect, and reloads swiftly.

x95_5_56x30_conversion_4fcce752.name: X95 5.56x30 Conversion
x95_5_56x30_conversion_4fcce752.info: An experimental version of the X95 chambered in 5.56x30mm MINSAS for the Sindhara Army. It was ultimately cancelled, but that doesn't stop you! Reduces close range damage while massively boosting muzzle velocity and damage at range.

potato_grip_b9532c18.name: Potato Grip
potato_grip_b9532c18.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

folding_grip_b9532c18.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_b9532c18.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

angled_grip_b9532c18.name: Angled Grip
angled_grip_b9532c18.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
5% faster aiming speeds
8% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces equip speeds by 5%

vertical_grip_b9532c18.name: Vertical Grip
vertical_grip_b9532c18.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

[LOSS]
- +12% Camera Body horizontal (Y) recoil.
-5% aim/equip speed.

chainsaw_grip_a3f3d8d7.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_a3f3d8d7.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

skeleton_grip_b9532c18.name: Skeleton Grip
skeleton_grip_b9532c18.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

stubby_grip_b9532c18.name: Stubby Grip
stubby_grip_b9532c18.info:
A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

15% better weapon sway
15% less muzzle climb and muzzle kick
8% less gun rotational recoil
20% less rearward gun kick
10% better hipfire stability
6% more horizontal gun shake
10% less aiming walkspeed
5% worse equip speed

sideways_grip_b9532c18.name: Sideways Grip
sideways_grip_b9532c18.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased hipfire spread.Decreased camera body YZ recoil and variance.Slightly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Slightly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation recoil.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

pistol_grip_b9532c18.name: Pistol Grip
pistol_grip_b9532c18.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

hera_cqr_grip_b9532c18.name: Hera CQR Grip
hera_cqr_grip_b9532c18.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased weapon rotation and translation recoil.Decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased camera body X recoil.Slightly decreased camera body YZ recoil.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation look sway speed.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

fal_50_reduced_magazine_a8370ff8.name: FAL 50 Reduced Magazine
fal_50_reduced_magazine_a8370ff8.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the FAL, ammo conservation will be even harder but you will get rid of the very harsh downside of the FAL's reload time and some weight improvements.

mp7_sight_55201222.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_55201222.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

malcolm_3x_scope_325e3534.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_325e3534.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

plague_insight_157d98b7.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_157d98b7.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

super_small_sight_55201222.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_55201222.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_55201222.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_55201222.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_55201222.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_55201222.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

mro_sight_55201222.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_55201222.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_55201222.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_55201222.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

peak01_sight_55201222.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_55201222.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_55201222.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_55201222.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_55201222.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_55201222.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

socom_buis_sight_55201222.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_55201222.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

elfx_sight_55201222.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_55201222.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

loudener_24a47c01.name: Loudener
loudener_24a47c01.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

lmx_suppressor_a5bddf83.name: LMX Suppressor
lmx_suppressor_a5bddf83.info:
25 stud detection radius.

An unique suppressor designed for the X46A2!
Improves mid-range performance at the cost of some handling.

folding_grip_7ea59563.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_7ea59563.info:

oil_filter_24fee677.name: Oil Filter
oil_filter_24fee677.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

suppressor_24fee677.name: Suppressor
suppressor_24fee677.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

pbs_1_suppressor_24fee677.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_24fee677.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

t_brake_24fee677.name: T-Brake
t_brake_24fee677.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

potato_grip_ba681d60.name: Potato Grip
potato_grip_ba681d60.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

romanian_grip_ba681d60.name: Romanian Grip
romanian_grip_ba681d60.info:
A sturdy tactical foregrip that improves gun stability and vertical camera recoil but has worse horizontal recoil control, handling and mobility while aiming.

[GAIN]
-20% Translation recoil.
-10% Vertical camera body (X) recoil.
-10% Vertical camera Body (X) recoil climb.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-20% Idle & Walk sway.
-25% Scope sway.

[LOSS]
+10% Horizontal camera body (Y) recoil.
-5% Walk speed while aiming.
-10% Aiming/Equipping/Sprinting transition speeds.

folding_grip_ba681d60.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_ba681d60.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

angled_grip_ba681d60.name: Angled Grip
angled_grip_ba681d60.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
5% faster aiming speeds
8% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces equip speeds by 5%

vertical_grip_ba681d60.name: Vertical Grip
vertical_grip_ba681d60.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

[LOSS]
- +12% Camera Body horizontal (Y) recoil.
-5% aim/equip speed.

chainsaw_grip_e68f0719.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_e68f0719.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

skeleton_grip_ba681d60.name: Skeleton Grip
skeleton_grip_ba681d60.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

stubby_grip_ba681d60.name: Stubby Grip
stubby_grip_ba681d60.info:
A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

15% better weapon sway
15% less muzzle climb and muzzle kick
8% less gun rotational recoil
20% less rearward gun kick
10% better hipfire stability
6% more horizontal gun shake
10% less aiming walkspeed
5% worse equip speed

handstop_ba681d60.name: Handstop
handstop_ba681d60.info:
A low-profile handstop to help you maintain a stable firing position.

Lowers rearward kick by 25%, reduces rearward kick variance by 55%
Slightly improves horizontal and vertical translational recoil and kick
Slightly increases vertical and horizontal variance
10% faster sprint speeds
15% faster aim time
3% better aiming walkspeed
10% lower weapon sway when aiming down sights or scoped in

sideways_grip_ba681d60.name: Sideways Grip
sideways_grip_ba681d60.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased hipfire spread.Decreased camera body YZ recoil and variance.Slightly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Slightly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation recoil.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

pistol_grip_ba681d60.name: Pistol Grip
pistol_grip_ba681d60.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

380_rama_aec981d1.name: 380 RAMA
380_rama_aec981d1.info: Switch the ammotype used in your RAMA 1130 into 380 ACP. Stats adjusted to suit the ammo type fired.

ta01_acog_7b8c00b5.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_7b8c00b5.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

diopter_sight_open_7b8c00b5.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_7b8c00b5.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

anti_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_7b8c00b5.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_7b8c00b5.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_7b8c00b5.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

hand_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_7b8c00b5.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_7b8c00b5.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

mini_sight_a79e647f.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_a79e647f.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

reflex_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_7b8c00b5.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_c30e79ca.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_c30e79ca.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_7b8c00b5.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_7b8c00b5.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_7b8c00b5.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_f01faf37.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_f01faf37.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_a79e647f.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_a79e647f.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

steyr_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

z_point_7b8c00b5.name: Z-Point
z_point_7b8c00b5.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_7b8c00b5.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_7b8c00b5.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

ta33_acog_7b8c00b5.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_7b8c00b5.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

furro_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_7b8c00b5.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_7b8c00b5.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_7b8c00b5.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_7b8c00b5.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_7b8c00b5.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_7b8c00b5.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_7b8c00b5.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_7b8c00b5.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

backup_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_7b8c00b5.name: M145
m145_7b8c00b5.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_7b8c00b5.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

maglite_7b8c00b5.name: Maglite
maglite_7b8c00b5.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

mro_sight_7b8c00b5.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_7b8c00b5.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_7b8c00b5.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_7b8c00b5.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_7b8c00b5.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_7b8c00b5.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mbus_sight_7b8c00b5.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_7b8c00b5.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

dcl_120_7b8c00b5.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_7b8c00b5.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

barska_electro_7b8c00b5.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_7b8c00b5.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

pka_s_7b8c00b5.name: PKA-S
pka_s_7b8c00b5.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

coyote_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_7b8c00b5.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

c79_7b8c00b5.name: C79
c79_7b8c00b5.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

aac_flip_up_sight_7b8c00b5.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

kousaku_oled_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_7b8c00b5.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

eotech_xps2_7b8c00b5.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_7b8c00b5.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

okp_7_7b8c00b5.name: OKP-7
okp_7_7b8c00b5.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_7b8c00b5.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

mars_7b8c00b5.name: MARS
mars_7b8c00b5.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

pilad_3_7b8c00b5.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_7b8c00b5.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

amt_terminator_7b8c00b5.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_7b8c00b5.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

vcog_6x_scope_7b8c00b5.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_7b8c00b5.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

pk_a_7b8c00b5.name: PK-A
pk_a_7b8c00b5.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_552_7b8c00b5.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_7b8c00b5.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

h_k_sight_7b8c00b5.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

hensoldt_3x_sight_485636c9.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_485636c9.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

kel_tec_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_7b8c00b5.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

microdot_mini_7b8c00b5.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_7b8c00b5.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

delta_sight_a79e647f.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_a79e647f.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_c30e79ca.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_c30e79ca.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

eotech_m40_7b8c00b5.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_7b8c00b5.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

diopter_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

kousaku_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_7b8c00b5.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

animu_sight_7b8c00b5.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

buis_sight_7b8c00b5.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_7b8c00b5.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_7b8c00b5.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_7b8c00b5.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_7b8c00b5.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_7b8c00b5.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

iwi_sight_7b8c00b5.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_7b8c00b5.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_7b8c00b5.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_7b8c00b5.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

ump_9_conversion_3baf969e.name: UMP 9 Conversion
ump_9_conversion_3baf969e.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your PDX-45 into the PDX-9.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired.

ump_40_conversion_02e27624.name: UMP .40 Conversion
ump_40_conversion_02e27624.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your PDX-45 into the PDX-40.
Stats adjusted accordingly to the caliber being fired.

msg90_308_conversion_322459b0.name: MSG90 308 Conversion
msg90_308_conversion_322459b0.info:
Load your JG-90 with .308 Winchester.
Giving a familiar 10 round magazine, Your JG-90 now has the benefits of the .308 cartridge which include faster velocities and the ability to kill to the head. Alongside being a whole lot lighter.

suppressor_2d61ccad.name: Suppressor..?
suppressor_2d61ccad.info:
Wait, what are you doing? Stop, this literally doesn't give you any benefit. Why are you like this?
(It does nothing but pitch up your fire sound. Do not buy).

vss_762_conv_0836ded6.name: VSS 762 Conv
vss_762_conv_0836ded6.info:
Changes the ammotype fired from your VSS VINTOREZ to 7.62x39mm.
This retools your weapon to be a lot like the civilian model produced by Molot Arms, that suppressor is not doing anything, bucko.

short_barrel_dmr_4d32d413.name: Short Barrel (DMR)
short_barrel_dmr_4d32d413.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

vpo_366_slugs_e549cd60.name: VPO .366 (Slugs)
vpo_366_slugs_e549cd60.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

vpo_366_buckshot_2499472b.name: VPO .366 (Buckshot)
vpo_366_buckshot_2499472b.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM (Buckshot).
By Zarovian law this makes your gun a shotgun because of the smoothbore barrel.

plague_insight_2caabb33.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_2caabb33.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

canted_iron_sight_02b57b50.name: Canted Iron Sight
canted_iron_sight_02b57b50.info:
Adds an additional set of iron sights at 45°, allowing users to quickly switch from a high powered optic to iron sights for favorable performance in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_delta_sight_02b57b50.name: Canted Delta Sight
canted_delta_sight_02b57b50.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45° for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

saiga_545_conversion_f223309d.name: Saiga 545 Conversion
saiga_545_conversion_f223309d.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.45x39mm with a 45 round magazine!
Lowers recoil, increases fire rate, magazine capacity and bullet speed while keeping a good range performance but comes at a cost of close range damage, penetration and some handling!

saiga_762_conversion_10935a96.name: Saiga 762 Conversion
saiga_762_conversion_10935a96.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 7.62x39mm with a 30rd magazine!
Keeps damage high especially to the torso while also increasing your fire rate, but lowers overall damage and penetration!

saiga_223_conversion_10935a96.name: Saiga 223 Conversion
saiga_223_conversion_10935a96.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in .223 Rem. with a 40 round magazine!
Uses some ''legal'' modifications to the receiver to turn your SAR fully automatic. Treat this as an assault rifle with an extended magazine!

saiga_220_russian_conversion_10935a96.name: Saiga 220 Russian Conversion
saiga_220_russian_conversion_10935a96.info:
Chambers your Saiga SAR in 5.6x39mm, a 5.6mm projectile from necked down 7.62x39mm brass!
Excellent bullet speed with improved damage falloff, very lethal headshot damage and more penetration than 7.62x39mm but lowers your close range performance!

long_barrel_dmr_7ab30245.name: Long Barrel (DMR)
long_barrel_dmr_7ab30245.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and handling speeds. Worse movement.

223_remington_98449be8.name: .223 Remington
223_remington_98449be8.info: Standard military-grade 5.56x45mm ammunition. Weaker than the specialized Mk 262 rounds, but has slightly improved recoil and comes with a larger magazine.

5_56x45_shellshock_mk12_fe4bfba9.name: 5.56x45 Shellshock (MK12)
5_56x45_shellshock_mk12_fe4bfba9.info: An extremely high-pressure 5.56x45mm cartridge made from a nickel alloy, designed to provide nearly 30% additional velocity to the cartridge and improve long-range ballistics. Slightly higher recoil, but better headshot performance.

svk12e_7_62_conversion_01c6352c.name: SVK12E 7.62 Conversion
svk12e_7_62_conversion_01c6352c.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for 7.62x51mm NATO, intended for the export market. The SVK-12E foregos the trigger group of the 7.62x54mmR variant for a unique 2-round burst only trigger designed to improve shot accuracy at mid-range through volume of fire. It is dubiously effective.

Somewhat reduced damage, but overall improved recoil control..

svk12e_12_7_conversion_b58b8678.name: SVK12E 12.7 Conversion
svk12e_12_7_conversion_b58b8678.info:
A rechambering of the SVK-12 for the relatively uncommon 12.7x55mm ammo type, typically used by special forces and police units for higher stopping power. Like many of the other AK-12 prototype variants, no real credible info exists on the development of this rifle in this chambering.

Very high damage with somewhat low muzzle velocity..

long_barrel_dmr_f1ab98e5.name: Long Barrel (DMR)
long_barrel_dmr_f1ab98e5.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and handling speeds. Worse movement.

g28_308_conversion_69910abc.name: G28 308 Conversion
g28_308_conversion_69910abc.info: Load your M28 with .308 Winchester, turning it into the civilian M28Z model. Uses a lower-capacity magazine but packs a stronger punch while improving overall handling somewhat.

pm_ii_ultrashort_f0b3a6af.name: PM II Ultrashort
pm_ii_ultrashort_f0b3a6af.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

mp7_sight_8f126574.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_8f126574.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_8f126574.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_8f126574.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_8f126574.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_8f126574.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_8f126574.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_8f126574.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

elfx_sight_8f126574.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_8f126574.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

mro_sight_8f126574.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_8f126574.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_8f126574.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_8f126574.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

peak01_sight_8f126574.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_8f126574.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_8f126574.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_8f126574.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_8f126574.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_8f126574.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

socom_buis_sight_8f126574.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_8f126574.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

braced_stock_59e32bb6.name: Braced Stock
braced_stock_59e32bb6.info: A braced stock with an ergonomic design that makes it faster to aim down the sights, while also improving gun sway while moving and while aiming down the sights. This stock also improves breath time on scopes and scope sway.

extended_magazine_d230cf2e.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_d230cf2e.info:
A larger 60 round drum magazine.
Increases your magazine capacity at the cost of handling, mobility and reload time.

223_remington_c934c609.name: .223 Remington
223_remington_c934c609.info:
Civilian version of the 5.56x45mm NATO military round.

Reduces recoil at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and a little bit of penetration and suppression.
Also slightly boosts aim speed!

Decreases camera recoil.
+2.5% Aiming speed.
-7% Min damage.
-25% Max range.
-8% Penetration and Suppression.

reduced_magazine_4869a405.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_4869a405.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

regulator_5_56_bthp_89db2ffb.name: REGULATOR 5.56 BTHP
regulator_5_56_bthp_89db2ffb.info:
Chambers your Regulator in .223 BTHP, a hollow point cartridge used for high-precision sport shooting.
Comes with a 15-round magazine offering more mobility, handling and a faster reload while having great damage towards headshots but body damage becomes poor at range.

regulator_7_62x39_6cb7e72d.name: REGULATOR 7.62x39
regulator_7_62x39_6cb7e72d.info: Converts your REGULATOR to fire 7.62x39mm, improving damage and consistency at the expense of recoil control and velocity.

sl8_binary_d0115b68.name: SL8 Binary
sl8_binary_d0115b68.info:
Modify your PL8 with a binary trigger group.

Fires one round when you depress the trigger, and another when you release it. That's double the bullet for every trigger pull!

sl_8_300_conversion_202a5420.name: SL-8 .300 Conversion
sl_8_300_conversion_202a5420.info:
Load your PL8 with .300 Whisper, a subsonic cartridge with the same lineage as .300BLK.

Low velocity and relatively limited magazine capacity, but very powerful performance to the head and at longer ranges. The bulky suppressor provides perfect radar masking, but also makes your handling somewhat worse.

reduced_magazine_21043656.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_21043656.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

22_rat_shot_ruger_43fffcfb.name: .22 Rat Shot (Ruger)
22_rat_shot_ruger_43fffcfb.info:
Loads your gun with small .22 Rat Shot bullets, each firing 10 pellets with little spread!
Powerful up close, especially to the head but has very poor muzzle velocity, penetration and ranged performance!

22_super_colibri_fba5d3b5.name: .22 Super Colibri
22_super_colibri_fba5d3b5.info: Loads your .22LR rifle with Super Colibri rounds, which are the closest you'll get to a pellet gun with how pathetic the velocity is.

ssr_6_5_conversion_3f4ced41.name: SSR 6.5 Conversion
ssr_6_5_conversion_3f4ced41.info:
Transforms your gun into the ''MK20S'' firing 6.5mm Creedmoor!
Slightly shorter round that has better velocity, lower recoil and the ability to one shot head at all ranges!
Significantly worse anywhere outside the head and reduced penetration!

tcr_duplex_binary_b8d10cf3.name: TCR Duplex Binary
tcr_duplex_binary_b8d10cf3.info: A binary-trigger group allows you to fire your gun on a trigger pull and to fire again once you let go. Duplex rounds not included.

beowulf_458_conversion_6cea7446.name: Beowulf .458 Conversion
beowulf_458_conversion_6cea7446.info:
Loads your Neowulf TCR rifle with .458 SOCOM.

Lowers recoil and increases velocity at the cost of performance, but also doubles your magazine capacity.

tcr_5_56_conversion_d81e972b.name: TCR 5.56 Conversion
tcr_5_56_conversion_d81e972b.info:
The most common ammo type found in the warzone. Why you're putting it in a rifle designed for 12.7x42mm is beyond mortal understanding.
Perfect for getting that civilian firearm feeling!

malcolm_3x_scope_0a47d479.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_0a47d479.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

plague_insight_f577a902.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_f577a902.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

dbp88_e672abbf.name: DBP88
dbp88_e672abbf.info:
A variant of 5.8x42mm designed specifically for squad automatic weapons and designated marksman rifles.

Utilizes a heavy steel core extending your range and penetration at the cost of close range performance, camera recoil control and bullet speed!

cs_os15_b5e4adb9.name: CS/OS15
cs_os15_b5e4adb9.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

aug_dmr_burst_group_cfb21ee1.name: AUG DMR Burst Group
aug_dmr_burst_group_cfb21ee1.info: Adds a 3-round burst trigger group to the UAR A3M2 for a unique trigger control flavor.

chainsaw_grip_dbeaa5b8.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_dbeaa5b8.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

a3m2_300_subsonic_b150a1c5.name: A3M2 300 Subsonic
a3m2_300_subsonic_b150a1c5.info: Uses subsonic .300 BLK ammo. Quieter firing sound with the ability to stay completely off the radar when equipped with a suppressor while offering improved damage performance at long ranges at the cost of poor muzzle velocity and reduced penetration!

a3m2_223_bthp_e23d7311.name: A3M2 223 BTHP
a3m2_223_bthp_e23d7311.info:
Chambers your UAR A3M2 in .223 Rem BTHP, a hollow point cartridge used for high-precision sport shooting.
Comes with a 10-round magazine offering more mobility, handling and a faster reload while having great damage towards headshots but body damage becomes poor at range.

extended_magazine_980d7641.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_980d7641.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

reduced_magazine_15b57963.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_15b57963.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

svu_a_conversion_kit_bd51bcbe.name: SVU-A Conversion Kit
