svu_a_conversion_kit_bd51bcbe.info: Change the internals of your SVU sniper rifle into that of the SVU-A with an extended magazine. Treat it as a hard to control battle rifle (especially in auto which should only be used for emergencies)...

ars_suppressor_3d9e753d.name: ARS Suppressor
ars_suppressor_3d9e753d.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

x_ring_3d9e753d.name: X-Ring
x_ring_3d9e753d.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

suppressor_3d9e753d.name: Suppressor
suppressor_3d9e753d.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

r2_suppressor_3d9e753d.name: R2 Suppressor
r2_suppressor_3d9e753d.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

oil_filter_3d9e753d.name: Oil Filter
oil_filter_3d9e753d.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

muffler_3d9e753d.name: Muffler
muffler_3d9e753d.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and reduce RPM by 10%.

compensator_3d9e753d.name: Compensator
compensator_3d9e753d.info:
A compensating muzzle device.
40% less horizontal recoil variance
15% more vertical muzzle kick and variance
25% more muzzle climb
Slightly worse hipfire spread and stability.

muzzle_booster_3d9e753d.name: Muzzle Booster
muzzle_booster_3d9e753d.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

loudener_3d9e753d.name: Loudener
loudener_3d9e753d.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

flash_hider_3d9e753d.name: Flash Hider
flash_hider_3d9e753d.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

muzzle_brake_3d9e753d.name: Muzzle Brake
muzzle_brake_3d9e753d.info:
A standard muzzle device which reduces vertical recoil climb by dispersing muzzle gases horizontally.

40% reduction in vertical kick
15% increase to vertical stability
15% less vertical rotational recoil
20% less muzzle climb

15% more horizontal recoil variance

halbek_device_3d9e753d.name: Halbek Device
halbek_device_3d9e753d.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

pbs_4_suppressor_3d9e753d.name: PBS-4 Suppressor
pbs_4_suppressor_3d9e753d.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

pbs_1_suppressor_3d9e753d.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_3d9e753d.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

t_brake_3d9e753d.name: T-Brake
t_brake_3d9e753d.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

chainsaw_grip_db47cecc.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_db47cecc.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

svu_953_conversion_81adc9f6.name: SVU 953 Conversion
svu_953_conversion_81adc9f6.info:
Load your SVU with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A much large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

anti_sight_d15aceaf.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_d15aceaf.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

klassik_lm_eafa400e.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_eafa400e.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

h_k_export_sight_d15aceaf.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_d15aceaf.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

mp7_sight_d15aceaf.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_d15aceaf.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_d15aceaf.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

tac_c_note_427b0643.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_427b0643.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

eotech_552_427b0643.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_427b0643.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_427b0643.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_427b0643.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

leupold_m8_6x_063d00e0.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_063d00e0.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

quick_release_sight_d15aceaf.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_d15aceaf.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

sagittarius_40x_70af344e.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_70af344e.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

half_ring_sight_d15aceaf.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_d15aceaf.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_d15aceaf.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_d15aceaf.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_427b0643.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_427b0643.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_3a1d44c1.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_3a1d44c1.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_427b0643.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_427b0643.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

microdot_mini_427b0643.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_427b0643.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

izhmash_sight_d15aceaf.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_d15aceaf.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

mars_427b0643.name: MARS
mars_427b0643.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

kousaku_oled_sight_427b0643.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_427b0643.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_427b0643.name: Z-Point
z_point_427b0643.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_427b0643.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_427b0643.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_d15aceaf.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_d15aceaf.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_d15aceaf.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_d15aceaf.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

furro_sight_d15aceaf.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_d15aceaf.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

pilad_3_427b0643.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_427b0643.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

kobra_ekp_sight_427b0643.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_427b0643.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_427b0643.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_427b0643.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_427b0643.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_427b0643.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

leupold_mark_4_b735f359.name: Leupold Mark 4
leupold_mark_4_b735f359.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

peak02_sight_d15aceaf.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_d15aceaf.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_d15aceaf.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

super_slim_sight_d15aceaf.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_d15aceaf.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

troy_flip_up_sight_d15aceaf.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_d15aceaf.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

animu_sight_d15aceaf.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_d15aceaf.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

pso_12_7_1774156d.name: PSO-12.7
pso_12_7_1774156d.info:
A Zarovian large caliber scope that debuted on the VKS rifle.

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

mini_sight_427b0643.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_427b0643.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

pso_1_scope_f55d39a6.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_f55d39a6.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

1200m_sight_d15aceaf.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

handmade_sight_427b0643.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_427b0643.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

diopter_sight_d15aceaf.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

maglite_427b0643.name: Maglite
maglite_427b0643.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

peak01_sight_d15aceaf.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_d15aceaf.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

pk_a_427b0643.name: PK-A
pk_a_427b0643.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_xps2_427b0643.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_427b0643.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

mro_sight_427b0643.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_427b0643.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_427b0643.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_427b0643.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

double_open_sight_d15aceaf.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_d15aceaf.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_d15aceaf.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sako_backup_sight_d15aceaf.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_d15aceaf.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_d15aceaf.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_d15aceaf.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

carry_handle_sight_d15aceaf.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_d15aceaf.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

dcl_120_427b0643.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_427b0643.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

oeg_427b0643.name: OEG
oeg_427b0643.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

pka_s_427b0643.name: PKA-S
pka_s_427b0643.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

barska_electro_427b0643.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_427b0643.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

okp_7_427b0643.name: OKP-7
okp_7_427b0643.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kom_10x42_f62a02f7.name: KOM 10x42
kom_10x42_f62a02f7.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

cs_os15_21672542.name: CS/OS15
cs_os15_21672542.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

coyote_sight_427b0643.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_427b0643.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

steyr_sight_d15aceaf.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

diopter_sight_open_d15aceaf.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_d15aceaf.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

aac_flip_up_sight_d15aceaf.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

kousaku_sight_427b0643.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_427b0643.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

eotech_m40_427b0643.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_427b0643.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

mbus_gen_3_sight_d15aceaf.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_d15aceaf.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_d15aceaf.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_d15aceaf.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_d15aceaf.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

amt_terminator_427b0643.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_427b0643.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

iwi_sight_d15aceaf.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_d15aceaf.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

h_k_sight_d15aceaf.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_d864088d.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_d864088d.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

kel_tec_sight_d15aceaf.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_d15aceaf.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

uh_gen1_427b0643.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_427b0643.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

delta_sight_427b0643.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_427b0643.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_d15aceaf.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_d15aceaf.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

malcolm_3x_scope_467ecd8b.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_467ecd8b.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

hd_n_4_16x44_2173ef97.name: HD-N 4-16x44
hd_n_4_16x44_2173ef97.info:
Full zoom: 12.0x
Alt zoom: 4.0x

A scope with a fairly unusual adjustment dial design. Possesses improved scope sway over other similar scopes, but is somewhat more unwieldy to use.

socom_buis_sight_d15aceaf.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_d15aceaf.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

buis_sight_d15aceaf.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_d15aceaf.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_427b0643.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_427b0643.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_427b0643.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_427b0643.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

leupold_m8_2x_913c1cbe.name: Leupold M8-2x
leupold_m8_2x_913c1cbe.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

microdot_srs_427b0643.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_427b0643.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

short_barrel_pistol_95210b4e.name: Short Barrel (PISTOL)
short_barrel_pistol_95210b4e.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

chainsaw_grip_64a6fd18.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_64a6fd18.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

spr_308_conv_e4b95063.name: SPR .308 Conv
spr_308_conv_e4b95063.info:
Uses .308 Winchester, a stronger round with higher bullet speed, penetration, improved damage ranges and better head/torso damage!
Slight increase in camera recoil but also exclusively uses 10 round magazines, you will however get better walk speed, handling and a faster reload!

spr_extended_mag_27827b11.name: SPR Extended Mag
spr_extended_mag_27827b11.info:
A 30 round magazine for your FAL! Allowing it to last longer in battle but your reload time will be even longer than it already is!
Lower walkspeed, reserve and handling!

spr_drum_mag_96685f1d.name: SPR Drum Mag
spr_drum_mag_96685f1d.info: 50rd X-FAL drum magazine! Gives you a significant amount of ammo but reloads slow and will lower your walkspeed and handling!

sa58_243_conversion_bdf9edfb.name: SA58 .243 Conversion
sa58_243_conversion_bdf9edfb.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your FAL into .243 Win.
A shorter round popular for sport shooting with a higher muzzle velocity, lower recoil and improved damage over distance at the cost of weaker close range performance and penetration.

extended_magazine_512b8d73.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_512b8d73.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

m21_6_5_99c71774.name: M21 6.5
m21_6_5_99c71774.info:
Loads your M21 with 6.5mm Creedmoor.
Featuring a 20 round magazine, your M21 has its performance affected due 6.5mm. However, you suffer from weaker headshot damage and overall modifier reductions.

m198_duplex_d3f46896.name: M198 Duplex
m198_duplex_d3f46896.info:
Loads your rifle with 7.62x51mm M198 duplex ammunition. Designed to improve hit probability, the ammunition fires two smaller bullets with every pull of the trigger.

Unfortunately, the smaller bullets tumble at longer ranges negating any sort of advantage offered by the additional projectiles.

malcolm_6x_scope_904b8087.name: Malcolm 6x Scope
malcolm_6x_scope_904b8087.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Long version of the Malcolm scope design.

depleted_uranium_59d32299.name: Depleted Uranium
depleted_uranium_59d32299.info:
Changes your ammunition to rounds with a depleted uranium core.
Aside from the usual rounds created for 20mm or 30mm guns, small amounts of it were made in .308 Winchester. For some strange reason depleted uranium has the quality of self sharpening when in contact with something. Very high bullet velocity and more penetration than you know what to do with.
Physically cannot work with suppressors.

mk11_500_conversion_49a98ea6.name: MK11 500 Conversion
mk11_500_conversion_49a98ea6.info:
Convert your MK11 to fire .500 Phantom. Made specifically for the AR10 platform.
Very slow bullet, increased recoil, but with a dramatic power increase.

plague_insight_231d92cb.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_231d92cb.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

improved_choke_eeb2e5b0.name: Improved Choke
improved_choke_eeb2e5b0.info:
Chokes are cylinders attached to the barrel to tighten the spread. This one is the least constrictive of the chokes, offering little gain but little drawback. Perfect for pursuitin' them upland birds!
Don't ask how it works with slugs, okay?

duckbill_choke_a2660cb7.name: Duckbill Choke
duckbill_choke_a2660cb7.info:
This choke just doesn't tighten spread, it does it horizontally.
Lower velocity, tighter vertical spread, more horizontal spread.

modified_choke_1530d28a.name: Modified Choke
modified_choke_1530d28a.info:
The middle ground of the chokes, offering more bang for your buck(shot)! Better benefits, but also worse losses. Perfect for huntin' some waterfouls.
Don't ask how it works with slugs, okay?

slugs_aac11a15.name: Slugs
slugs_aac11a15.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

s_12_full_auto_conversion_4d14039d.name: S-12 Full-Auto Conversion
s_12_full_auto_conversion_4d14039d.info:
Change the internals of your Saiga-12 to make it able to fire in full automatic!
Extremely fast fire rate but hard to control!
Loses out on accuracy and damage range.

flechette_a55dba01.name: Flechette
flechette_a55dba01.info:
Changes your shot load to flechettes, small dart projectiles specially desgined to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover but less effective against limbs.

rubber_pellets_eaafdf80.name: Rubber Pellets
rubber_pellets_eaafdf80.info: Shotgun shells loaded with rubber buckshot. Less than lethal isn't the same as non-lethal, and you're about to prove that...

s_12u_50_conversion_4c1ab9f8.name: S-12U 50 Conversion
s_12u_50_conversion_4c1ab9f8.info:
Load your Saiga-12U with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- ok, there is no way you're going to get anything working this way...

extended_magazine_a2266cfd.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_a2266cfd.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

birdshot_51e46869.name: Birdshot
birdshot_51e46869.info:
Changes your shot load to birdshot: a large quantity of small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse -- but significantly less great at dealing with modern body armor.

Significantly reduced penetration and performance when hitting the torso, but significantly more pellets.

canted_iron_sight_767f0750.name: Canted Iron Sight
canted_iron_sight_767f0750.info:
Adds an additional set of iron sights at 45°, allowing users to quickly switch from a high powered optic to iron sights for favorable performance in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_delta_sight_efa21e06.name: Canted Delta Sight
canted_delta_sight_efa21e06.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45° for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

ta01_acog_c2881d6f.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_c2881d6f.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

diopter_sight_open_c2881d6f.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_c2881d6f.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

anti_sight_c2881d6f.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_c2881d6f.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_c2881d6f.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_c2881d6f.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

hand_sight_c2881d6f.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_c2881d6f.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_c2881d6f.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_c2881d6f.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

mini_sight_e95bf171.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_e95bf171.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

reflex_sight_c2881d6f.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_c2881d6f.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_c2881d6f.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_c2881d6f.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

dual_aperture_sight_c2881d6f.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_c2881d6f.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_c2881d6f.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_c2881d6f.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_00c08c05.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_00c08c05.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_e95bf171.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_e95bf171.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_c2881d6f.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_c2881d6f.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

steyr_sight_c2881d6f.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

z_point_c2881d6f.name: Z-Point
z_point_c2881d6f.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_c2881d6f.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_c2881d6f.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

ta33_acog_c2881d6f.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_c2881d6f.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

furro_sight_c2881d6f.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_c2881d6f.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_c2881d6f.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_c2881d6f.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_c2881d6f.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_c2881d6f.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_c2881d6f.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_c2881d6f.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_c2881d6f.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_c2881d6f.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_c2881d6f.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_c2881d6f.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

backup_sight_c2881d6f.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_c2881d6f.name: M145
m145_c2881d6f.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_c2881d6f.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

maglite_c2881d6f.name: Maglite
maglite_c2881d6f.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

mro_sight_c2881d6f.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_c2881d6f.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_c2881d6f.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_c2881d6f.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_c2881d6f.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_c2881d6f.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_c2881d6f.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_c2881d6f.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_c2881d6f.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mbus_sight_c2881d6f.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_c2881d6f.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

dcl_120_c2881d6f.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_c2881d6f.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

barska_electro_c2881d6f.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_c2881d6f.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

pka_s_c2881d6f.name: PKA-S
pka_s_c2881d6f.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

coyote_sight_c2881d6f.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_c2881d6f.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

c79_c2881d6f.name: C79
c79_c2881d6f.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

aac_flip_up_sight_c2881d6f.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

kousaku_oled_sight_c2881d6f.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_c2881d6f.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

eotech_xps2_c2881d6f.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_c2881d6f.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

okp_7_c2881d6f.name: OKP-7
okp_7_c2881d6f.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_c2881d6f.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

mars_c2881d6f.name: MARS
mars_c2881d6f.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

pilad_3_c2881d6f.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_c2881d6f.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

amt_terminator_c2881d6f.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_c2881d6f.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

vcog_6x_scope_c2881d6f.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_c2881d6f.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

pk_a_c2881d6f.name: PK-A
pk_a_c2881d6f.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_552_c2881d6f.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_c2881d6f.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

h_k_sight_c2881d6f.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

hensoldt_3x_sight_cf526f46.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_cf526f46.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

kel_tec_sight_c2881d6f.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_c2881d6f.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

microdot_mini_c2881d6f.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_c2881d6f.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

delta_sight_e95bf171.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_e95bf171.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

eotech_m40_c2881d6f.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_c2881d6f.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

diopter_sight_c2881d6f.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

kousaku_sight_c2881d6f.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_c2881d6f.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

animu_sight_c2881d6f.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_c2881d6f.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

buis_sight_c2881d6f.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_c2881d6f.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_c2881d6f.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_c2881d6f.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_c2881d6f.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_c2881d6f.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

iwi_sight_c2881d6f.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_c2881d6f.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_c2881d6f.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_c2881d6f.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

short_barrel_sniper_78acb5df.name: Short Barrel (SNIPER)
short_barrel_sniper_78acb5df.info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and handling. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet range, penetration, and velocity.

sass_358_conversion_9dd4a340.name: SASS 358 Conversion
sass_358_conversion_9dd4a340.info:
An alternate ammo type for the SASS 308.
 The .358 Winchester cartridge gives your SASS weapon more power close up towards an enemies torso, trading long range performance. A perfect panic backup.

plague_insight_853306e7.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_853306e7.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

full_choke_335e19b3.name: Full Choke
full_choke_335e19b3.info: The choke with the tighest constriction, offering the tightest spread of pellets. Great for long range precision shots, but beware of missing your shots up close.

muffler_alt_2639559d.name: Muffler (Alt)
muffler_alt_2639559d.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and in this case, will not affect firerate.

oil_filter_alt_f4fd5944.name: Oil Filter (Alt)
oil_filter_alt_f4fd5944.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

diverter_525b29cf.name: Diverter
diverter_525b29cf.info: The kind of choke that was made when someone looked at duckbill and didn't think it was enough. Further decreases your vertical spread but increases the horizontal spread even more than before!

paradox_choke_1c0e0c8f.name: Paradox Choke
paradox_choke_1c0e0c8f.info:
Otherwise known as a ''spreader''.
A strange but simple choke that is simply an extension to the barrel with rifling.
Unlike other choke this one works great with slugs!

minislugs_b9df2e5a.name: Minislugs
minislugs_b9df2e5a.info:
Changes your shot load to minislugs.
Short, stumpy 1¾ inch shotgun shells that aid in recoil control. Increases capacity if held in a tube by a few shells due to a shorter length. Not as high damage as full size slugs but travels a little faster with faster action and reloading.

minishell_8dfaeace.name: Minishell
minishell_8dfaeace.info:
Changes your shot load to minishells.
Short, stumpy 1¾ inch shotgun shells that aid in recoil control. Increases capacity if held in a tube by a few shells due to a shorter length. Poorer damage due to being filled with #1 buckshot. Tighter spread with faster action and reloading.

extended_tube_b5776311.name: Extended Tube
extended_tube_b5776311.info: A longer magazine for tube-shotguns, increases magazine capacity with lower overall handling.

traditional_pump_8d83a84a.name: Traditional Pump
traditional_pump_8d83a84a.info: Swap your Super Shorty's regular foregrip with a more traditional pump based action. Improves aim speeds, but slightly worsens hipfire and equip speeds.

boom_stock_1f0c105e.name: Boom Stock
boom_stock_1f0c105e.info: Reinstalls the stock to your SAWED-OFF, improving camera kick recovery and reducing overall aimed kick.

unfolded_leaf_sight_6fd9b46b.name: Unfolded Leaf Sight
unfolded_leaf_sight_6fd9b46b.info: Raise your leaf sight on your weapon. Leaf sights are hinged sights that can be raised up or down and adjusted to account for targets in range.

short_barrel_shotgun_954b6f55.name: Short Barrel (SHOTGUN)
short_barrel_shotgun_954b6f55.info:
A short, cut down barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

flechette_m79_74e9e25e.name: Flechette (M79)
flechette_m79_74e9e25e.info:
Changes your shot load to a M1001 40mm high velocity canister cartridge filled with a ton of flechette darts!
Highly effective against body armor and enemies behind cover!

exotic_slugs_m79_cdb6ac56.name: Exotic Slugs (M79)
exotic_slugs_m79_cdb6ac56.info:
Changes your shot load to an exotic 12 gauge slug housed in an adapter!
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head.

buckshot_m79_bc16dff6.name: Buckshot (M79)
buckshot_m79_bc16dff6.info:
Changes your shot load to a M576 40mm Buckshot shell, firing 20 destructive pellets from your grenade launcher!
Lower velocity but larger overall damage.

sponge_m79_8428c374.name: Sponge (M79)
sponge_m79_8428c374.info:
Changes your shot load to a 40mm Sponge Grenade, a large projectile produced to disable or confuse a single target (for riot control).
Powerful and able to down an opponent instantly at any range but suffers from extremely low muzzle velocity!

armor_piercing_5084bc63.name: Armor Piercing
armor_piercing_5084bc63.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

410_beehive_m79_2a7ebf1d.name: 410 Beehive (M79)
410_beehive_m79_2a7ebf1d.info:
Changes your shot load to .410 bore housed in a four slotted hornet's nest shell (16 pellets).
Less power and ammo, but more range, speed, and pellets per shot.

remove_stock_874bd9a8.name: Remove Stock
remove_stock_874bd9a8.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

plague_insight_992d2c33.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_992d2c33.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

e_shotgun_light_discs_d32225a8.name: e Shotgun Light Discs
e_shotgun_light_discs_d32225a8.info: Lightweight 'pancakes' that improve the bullet speed but decrease accuracy, supppresion, and increases spread.

e_shotgun_heavy_discs_d32225a8.name: e Shotgun Heavy Discs
e_shotgun_heavy_discs_d32225a8.info: Improves the spread with heavier 'pancakes', with stronger suppression. Range is more evenly spread. Bullets drop faster.

e_shotgun_penny_conversion_d32225a8.name: e Shotgun Penny Conversion
e_shotgun_penny_conversion_d32225a8.info: Instead of large discs you loaded the magazine with pennies. That's one way to spend your money... your reserve ammo now equates to about 3 dollars.

e_shotgun_hds_a1b1c402.name: e Shotgun HDS
e_shotgun_hds_a1b1c402.info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for home defence scenarios.
Weapon is locked to burst fire with adjusted performance.

e_shotgun_ccs_b5cf75aa.name: e Shotgun CCS
e_shotgun_ccs_b5cf75aa.info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for crowd control scenarios.
Weapon is locked to automatic fire with adjusted performance.

anti_sight_ff511900.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_ff511900.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_ff511900.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_ff511900.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

mp7_sight_ff511900.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_ff511900.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_ff511900.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_ff511900.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_ff511900.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

eotech_552_cafad470.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_cafad470.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_cafad470.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_cafad470.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_ff511900.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_ff511900.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_ff511900.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_ff511900.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_ff511900.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_ff511900.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_cafad470.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_cafad470.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_00fa4c44.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_00fa4c44.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_cafad470.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_cafad470.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

microdot_mini_cafad470.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_cafad470.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

furro_sight_ff511900.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_ff511900.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

kousaku_oled_sight_cafad470.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_cafad470.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_cafad470.name: Z-Point
z_point_cafad470.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_cafad470.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_cafad470.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_ff511900.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_ff511900.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_ff511900.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_ff511900.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

mars_cafad470.name: MARS
mars_cafad470.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

pilad_3_cafad470.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_cafad470.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

kobra_ekp_sight_cafad470.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_cafad470.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_cafad470.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_cafad470.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_cafad470.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_cafad470.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

izhmash_sight_ff511900.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_ff511900.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

peak02_sight_ff511900.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_ff511900.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_ff511900.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

mini_sight_cafad470.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_cafad470.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

troy_flip_up_sight_ff511900.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_ff511900.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

tac_c_note_cafad470.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_cafad470.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

handmade_sight_cafad470.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_cafad470.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

maglite_cafad470.name: Maglite
maglite_cafad470.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

animu_sight_ff511900.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_ff511900.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

kalashnikov_sight_ff511900.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

eotech_xps2_cafad470.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_cafad470.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

mro_sight_cafad470.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_cafad470.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_cafad470.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_cafad470.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_cafad470.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_cafad470.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_ff511900.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_ff511900.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

sako_backup_sight_ff511900.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_ff511900.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

diopter_sight_ff511900.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

mbus_sight_ff511900.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_ff511900.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

pka_s_cafad470.name: PKA-S
pka_s_cafad470.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

dcl_120_cafad470.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_cafad470.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

carry_handle_sight_ff511900.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_ff511900.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

oeg_cafad470.name: OEG
oeg_cafad470.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

barska_electro_cafad470.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_cafad470.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

okp_7_cafad470.name: OKP-7
okp_7_cafad470.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

coyote_sight_cafad470.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_cafad470.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

eotech_m40_cafad470.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_cafad470.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

diopter_sight_open_ff511900.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_ff511900.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

peak01_sight_ff511900.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_ff511900.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

aac_flip_up_sight_ff511900.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

kousaku_sight_cafad470.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_cafad470.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

mbus_gen_3_sight_ff511900.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_ff511900.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_ff511900.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_ff511900.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_ff511900.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

amt_terminator_cafad470.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_cafad470.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

steyr_sight_ff511900.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

pk_a_cafad470.name: PK-A
pk_a_cafad470.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

h_k_sight_ff511900.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_46abe22e.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_46abe22e.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

kel_tec_sight_ff511900.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_ff511900.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

iwi_sight_ff511900.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_ff511900.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

delta_sight_cafad470.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_cafad470.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_ff511900.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_ff511900.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

1200m_sight_ff511900.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

socom_buis_sight_ff511900.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_ff511900.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

buis_sight_ff511900.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_ff511900.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_cafad470.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_cafad470.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_cafad470.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_cafad470.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

microdot_srs_cafad470.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_cafad470.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

m903_slap_0b4f4f4c.name: M903 SLAP
m903_slap_0b4f4f4c.info:
Nothing can stop you now.
Saboted light armor penetrator rounds made specifically to penetrate as many walls of armor as physically possible. Reduces overall damage, but up bullet speed and penetration.

17_wildcat_aa9b851f.name: .17 Wildcat
17_wildcat_aa9b851f.info:
Why would you do this...?

Wildcat .50 BMG cartridge made to fire a tiny little .17 caliber bullet.
The speed of the bullet is unmatched.

dust_shot_e6c3ad0c.name: Dust Shot
dust_shot_e6c3ad0c.info:
So instead of using standard .50 BMG rounds, you are using .50 BMG rat shot. Why would you load your rifle with rat shot? What kind of rats are you against?
I don't see really big rats...

416_barrett_886fbc81.name: .416 Barrett
416_barrett_886fbc81.info:
Proprietary bottlenecked centrefire rifle cartridge designed in 2005. It is an alternative to the .50 BMG cartidge.
Faster muzzle velocity but reduced range effectiveness.

mp7_sight_cf0cad51.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_cf0cad51.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_cf0cad51.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_cf0cad51.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_cf0cad51.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_cf0cad51.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_cf0cad51.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_cf0cad51.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

peak01_sight_cf0cad51.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_cf0cad51.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_cf0cad51.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_cf0cad51.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_cf0cad51.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_cf0cad51.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

socom_buis_sight_cf0cad51.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_cf0cad51.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

short_barrel_shotgun_395421fb.name: Short Barrel (SHOTGUN)
short_barrel_shotgun_395421fb.info:
A short, cut down barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

extended_tube_1c4c76b2.name: Extended Tube
extended_tube_1c4c76b2.info:
A longer magazine for tube-shotguns!
Increases magazine capacity with lower overall handling.
Also comes with a traditional pump, reducing your fire rate!

stakeout_ii_grip_63a2b437.name: Stakeout II Grip
stakeout_ii_grip_63a2b437.info:
A sawn off stakeout grip for your M37!
Improves aim, equip and sprint transition speed, and increases walkspeed.
However, increases recoil and weapon sway due to the lack of stock.

teufort_grip_b06604bf.name: Teufort Grip
teufort_grip_b06604bf.info:
A specialized short grip straight out of Teufort!
Improves aim, equip and sprint transition speed, and increases walkspeed.
However, increases recoil and weapon sway due to the lack of stock.
And if that don't work: Use more gun.

m903_slap_8cb84802.name: M903 SLAP
m903_slap_8cb84802.info:
Nothing can stop you now.
Saboted light armor penetrator rounds made specifically to penetrate as many walls of armor as physically possible. Reduces overall damage, but up bullet speed and penetration.

thunder_squeezebore_eb0c9a1b.name: Thunder Squeezebore
thunder_squeezebore_eb0c9a1b.info: Swaps out your THUNDER's ammunition with squeezebore rounds, giving it multiple projectiles at the cost of accuracy and damage potential at range.

ta01_acog_3c8a6598.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_3c8a6598.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_9552f398.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_9552f398.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

klassik_lm_ceddea8d.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_ceddea8d.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

pm_ii_ultrashort_3c8a6598.name: PM II Ultrashort
pm_ii_ultrashort_3c8a6598.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

h_k_export_sight_9552f398.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_9552f398.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_9a51114d.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_9a51114d.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_9552f398.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

animu_sight_9552f398.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_9552f398.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

super_slim_sight_9552f398.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_9552f398.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

pso_12_7_3c8a6598.name: PSO-12.7
pso_12_7_3c8a6598.info:
A Zarovian large caliber scope that debuted on the VKS rifle.

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

troy_flip_up_sight_9552f398.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_9552f398.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

leupold_m8_6x_9e17e193.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_9e17e193.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

quick_release_sight_9552f398.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_3c8a6598.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_3c8a6598.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_9552f398.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

sagittarius_40x_3c8a6598.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

half_ring_sight_9552f398.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_9552f398.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_9552f398.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_9552f398.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_9552f398.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_9552f398.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_f78df8e2.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_f78df8e2.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

leupold_mark_4_ceddea8d.name: Leupold Mark 4
leupold_mark_4_ceddea8d.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

izhmash_sight_9552f398.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_9552f398.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

nxs_5_5_22_ceddea8d.name: NXS 5.5-22
nxs_5_5_22_ceddea8d.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

leupold_m8_2x_5bb7d6f3.name: Leupold M8-2x
leupold_m8_2x_5bb7d6f3.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.
