kousaku_oled_sight_9552f398.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_9552f398.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_9552f398.name: Z-Point
z_point_9552f398.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_9552f398.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_9552f398.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_9552f398.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_9552f398.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_9552f398.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_9552f398.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

ta33_acog_3c8a6598.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

pm_ii_ceddea8d.name: PM II
pm_ii_ceddea8d.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

elfx_sight_9552f398.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_9552f398.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

acog_scope_3c8a6598.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_3c8a6598.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

ddhb_reflex_9552f398.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_9552f398.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

kobra_ekp_sight_9552f398.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_9552f398.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

buis_sight_9552f398.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

comp_aimpoint_9552f398.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_9552f398.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_9552f398.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_9552f398.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_3c8a6598.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

microdot_mini_9552f398.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_9552f398.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

global_offensive_scope_3c8a6598.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_3c8a6598.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_9552f398.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_9552f398.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_9552f398.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

deltapoint_sight_9552f398.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_9552f398.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

tango_msr_1_8x_3c8a6598.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_3c8a6598.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

reflex_sight_9552f398.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_9552f398.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

m145_3c8a6598.name: M145
m145_3c8a6598.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

eotech_552_9552f398.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_9552f398.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

uh_gen1_9552f398.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_9552f398.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

kel_tec_sight_9552f398.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_9552f398.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

vcog_8x_scope_3c8a6598.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

hand_sight_9552f398.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_9552f398.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

1200m_sight_9552f398.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

handmade_sight_9552f398.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_9552f398.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

eotech_xps2_9552f398.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_9552f398.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

maglite_9552f398.name: Maglite
maglite_9552f398.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

reflector_scope_3c8a6598.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_3c8a6598.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

sidewinder_ed_ceddea8d.name: SIDEWINDER ED
sidewinder_ed_ceddea8d.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

iwi_sight_9552f398.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_9552f398.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

mro_sight_9552f398.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_9552f398.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_9552f398.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_9552f398.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

hensoldt_3x_sight_3c8a6598.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

double_open_sight_9552f398.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_9552f398.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kom_10x42_ceddea8d.name: KOM 10x42
kom_10x42_ceddea8d.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

diopter_sight_9552f398.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

mbus_sight_9552f398.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_9552f398.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

dcl_120_9552f398.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_9552f398.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

fal_sight_9552f398.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_9552f398.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

pso_1m2_scope_0a1068b9.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_0a1068b9.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_3c8a6598.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_3c8a6598.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

coyote_sight_9552f398.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_9552f398.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

barska_electro_9552f398.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_9552f398.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

mbus_gen_3_sight_9552f398.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_9552f398.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

steyr_sight_9552f398.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

pka_s_9552f398.name: PKA-S
pka_s_9552f398.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

cs_os15_3c8a6598.name: CS/OS15
cs_os15_3c8a6598.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

susat_scope_3c8a6598.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

eotech_m40_9552f398.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_9552f398.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

c79_3c8a6598.name: C79
c79_3c8a6598.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

kousaku_sight_9552f398.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_9552f398.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

peak01_sight_9552f398.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_9552f398.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

aac_flip_up_sight_9552f398.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

diopter_sight_open_9552f398.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_9552f398.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

eotech_vudu_1_10_3c8a6598.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_3c8a6598.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_9552f398.name: OKP-7
okp_7_9552f398.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_9552f398.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

oeg_9552f398.name: OEG
oeg_9552f398.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

carry_handle_sight_9552f398.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_9552f398.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_9552f398.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_9552f398.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

sako_backup_sight_9552f398.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_9552f398.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

pk_a_9552f398.name: PK-A
pk_a_9552f398.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

kalashnikov_sight_9552f398.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

h_k_sight_9552f398.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_9552f398.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_2a648791.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_2a648791.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_3c8a6598.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_3c8a6598.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

tac_c_note_9552f398.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_9552f398.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

delta_sight_9552f398.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_9552f398.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_9552f398.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_9552f398.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

pso_1_scope_9a51114d.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_9a51114d.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

mini_sight_9552f398.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_9552f398.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

hd_n_4_16x44_3c8a6598.name: HD-N 4-16x44
hd_n_4_16x44_3c8a6598.info:
Full zoom: 12.0x
Alt zoom: 4.0x

A scope with a fairly unusual adjustment dial design. Possesses improved scope sway over other similar scopes, but is somewhat more unwieldy to use.

socom_buis_sight_9552f398.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_9552f398.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_3c8a6598.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_3c8a6598.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_9552f398.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_9552f398.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_9552f398.name: MARS
mars_9552f398.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

furro_sight_9552f398.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_9552f398.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

microdot_srs_9552f398.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_9552f398.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

front_post_a6e10979.name: Front Post
front_post_a6e10979.info:
Attach a front post to your 3-line rifle.
Optional and free!

obrez_long_barrel_70206c95.name: Obrez Long Barrel
obrez_long_barrel_70206c95.info: Fit your Obrez with an extended barrel, improving muzzle velocity but affecting other areas of the weapons performance.

obrez_410_220b9e1c.name: OBREZ 410
obrez_410_220b9e1c.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT (OBREZ) into a modern day FROLOVKA OBREZ that fires 410 bore rounds!

obrez_8mm_conversion_d0db07c1.name: Obrez 8mm Conversion
obrez_8mm_conversion_d0db07c1.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that makes your Obrez Pistol fire the larger 8x50mmR cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a certain range. It does not perform as well at range, among other faults of the cartridge...

extended_magazine_7869ac68.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_7869ac68.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

obrez_stock_4b802fe2.name: Obrez Stock
obrez_stock_4b802fe2.info: Reattach the stock to the OBREZ in order to decrease the recoil kick, at the cost of some other areas.

straight_pull_bolt_5a5ca2bb.name: Straight Pull Bolt
straight_pull_bolt_5a5ca2bb.info:
Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all your chakras.
Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, can cycle freely, have a lot less weapon sway and can hold breath for longer while scoping.
Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

carry_handle_grip_362e7dd7.name: Carry Handle Grip
carry_handle_grip_362e7dd7.info: A peculiar mounting of the M16's carry handle, often done to prevent it from getting lost. I guess it works as a grip though?

ar_7_62x39_conversion_6a0352c8.name: AR 7.62x39 Conversion
ar_7_62x39_conversion_6a0352c8.info: A high-precision rifle round designed to give the AR-15 platform performance somewhat comparable to 7.62x51mm, but with around half of the recoil impulse. The larger bullet is still able to load into the AR-15's magazines, but with a lower maximum capacity.

ar_25_45_conversion_0d991fb8.name: AR 25-45 Conversion
ar_25_45_conversion_0d991fb8.info:
Loads your AR-15 with .25-45 Sharps.
 This uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

elfx_sight_2867e322.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_2867e322.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

mro_sight_2867e322.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_2867e322.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_2867e322.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_2867e322.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

socom_buis_sight_1fe75285.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_1fe75285.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

full_stock_5d80c9c5.name: Full Stock
full_stock_5d80c9c5.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

long_barrel_c7_7e910384.name: Long Barrel (C7)
long_barrel_c7_7e910384.info:
Extended barrel and large hanguard found on the DIEMACO LSW.
Worse mobility with greater recoil control and greatly extended ranges. Slower firerate.

ar_20_tact_conversion_d195f57c.name: AR 20 Tact Conversion
ar_20_tact_conversion_d195f57c.info:
Load your Diemaco rifle with .20 Tactical.
Uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. But you'll be punished if shots are missed.

mp7_sight_ab15850e.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_ab15850e.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_ab15850e.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_ab15850e.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_ab15850e.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_ab15850e.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_ab15850e.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_ab15850e.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

mro_sight_ab15850e.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_ab15850e.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_ab15850e.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_ab15850e.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

peak01_sight_ab15850e.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_ab15850e.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_ab15850e.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_ab15850e.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_ab15850e.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_ab15850e.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

socom_buis_sight_ab15850e.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_ab15850e.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

elfx_sight_ab15850e.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_ab15850e.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

spear_lt_5_56_335d95d8.name: SPEAR LT 5.56
spear_lt_5_56_335d95d8.info: Loads your gun with 5.56x45mm NATO, making it significantly more controllable at the cost of damage and penetration.

folded_grip_382c8139.name: Folded Grip
folded_grip_382c8139.info:
Fold up the integral grip of your weapon.
Provides small aimspeed and walkspeed benefits with poorer hipfire.

aug_9mm_conversion_9919a2c3.name: AUG 9MM Conversion
aug_9mm_conversion_9919a2c3.info:
Converts your UAR A1 into the F88T training rifle using .22 LR!
Low damage to non-headshots while significantly lowering recoil, reload time and quicker handling.

ta01_acog_a18d20e3.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

zf69_scope_7c8467e4.name: ZF69 Scope
zf69_scope_7c8467e4.info: A Nomensland fixed-power precision riflescope used as the primary optic for the UAR HBAR-T configuration.

anti_sight_3357346f.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_3357346f.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_3357346f.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_3357346f.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_a18d20e3.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_a18d20e3.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_3357346f.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_3357346f.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_3357346f.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

tac_c_note_a18d20e3.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_a18d20e3.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

eotech_552_a18d20e3.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_a18d20e3.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_a18d20e3.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_a18d20e3.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_3357346f.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_a18d20e3.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_a18d20e3.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_3357346f.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_3357346f.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_3357346f.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_3357346f.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_3357346f.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_a18d20e3.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_a18d20e3.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_a18d20e3.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_a18d20e3.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_a18d20e3.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_a18d20e3.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_3357346f.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_3357346f.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_a18d20e3.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_a18d20e3.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_a18d20e3.name: Z-Point
z_point_a18d20e3.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_a18d20e3.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_a18d20e3.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_3357346f.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_3357346f.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_3357346f.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_3357346f.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_a18d20e3.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_a18d20e3.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

furro_sight_3357346f.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_3357346f.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_a18d20e3.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_a18d20e3.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_a18d20e3.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_a18d20e3.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_a18d20e3.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_a18d20e3.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_a18d20e3.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_a18d20e3.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_a18d20e3.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_a18d20e3.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_a18d20e3.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_3357346f.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_3357346f.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_3357346f.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_a18d20e3.name: M145
m145_a18d20e3.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_3357346f.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

ta33_acog_a18d20e3.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

elfx_sight_a18d20e3.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_a18d20e3.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

vcog_8x_scope_a18d20e3.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

ddhb_reflex_a18d20e3.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_a18d20e3.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

tango_msr_1_8x_a18d20e3.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_a18d20e3.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_a18d20e3.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_a18d20e3.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

buis_sight_3357346f.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

maglite_a18d20e3.name: Maglite
maglite_a18d20e3.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

iwi_sight_3357346f.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_3357346f.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

kalashnikov_sight_3357346f.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

animu_sight_3357346f.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_3357346f.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

mro_sight_a18d20e3.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_a18d20e3.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

reflector_scope_a18d20e3.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_a18d20e3.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

sro_sight_a18d20e3.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_a18d20e3.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_a18d20e3.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_a18d20e3.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_3357346f.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_3357346f.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

vcog_6x_scope_a18d20e3.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

sako_backup_sight_3357346f.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_3357346f.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_3357346f.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_3357346f.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

dcl_120_a18d20e3.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_a18d20e3.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

susat_scope_a18d20e3.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

pso_1m2_scope_a18d20e3.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_a18d20e3.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_a18d20e3.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_a18d20e3.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

kel_tec_sight_3357346f.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_3357346f.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

barska_electro_a18d20e3.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_a18d20e3.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

mini_sight_a18d20e3.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_a18d20e3.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

diopter_sight_open_3357346f.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_3357346f.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

pka_s_a18d20e3.name: PKA-S
pka_s_a18d20e3.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

steyr_sight_aa561ec3.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_aa561ec3.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

coyote_sight_a18d20e3.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_a18d20e3.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

eotech_xps2_a18d20e3.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_a18d20e3.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

c79_a18d20e3.name: C79
c79_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

oeg_a18d20e3.name: OEG
oeg_a18d20e3.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

peak01_sight_3357346f.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_3357346f.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

kousaku_sight_a18d20e3.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_a18d20e3.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

mbus_gen_3_sight_3357346f.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_3357346f.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

eotech_vudu_1_10_a18d20e3.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_a18d20e3.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_a18d20e3.name: OKP-7
okp_7_a18d20e3.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_3357346f.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_3357346f.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_3357346f.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_aa561ec3.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_aa561ec3.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_a18d20e3.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_a18d20e3.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

aac_flip_up_sight_3357346f.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

pk_a_a18d20e3.name: PK-A
pk_a_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_m40_a18d20e3.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_a18d20e3.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

h_k_sight_3357346f.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_a18d20e3.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_a18d20e3.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_a18d20e3.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_a18d20e3.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

super_slim_sight_3357346f.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_3357346f.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

delta_sight_a18d20e3.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_a18d20e3.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_3357346f.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_3357346f.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

troy_flip_up_sight_3357346f.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_3357346f.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

hensoldt_3x_sight_a18d20e3.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_a18d20e3.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

diopter_sight_3357346f.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_3357346f.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

socom_buis_sight_3357346f.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_3357346f.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_a18d20e3.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_a18d20e3.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_a18d20e3.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_a18d20e3.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_a18d20e3.name: MARS
mars_a18d20e3.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

microdot_mini_a18d20e3.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_a18d20e3.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

microdot_srs_a18d20e3.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_a18d20e3.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

muzzle_booster_5933dd06.name: Muzzle Booster
muzzle_booster_5933dd06.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

ta01_acog_562fcb4b.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_562fcb4b.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_562fcb4b.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_562fcb4b.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

pu_1_scope_562fcb4b.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_562fcb4b.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

eotech_552_562fcb4b.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_562fcb4b.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_562fcb4b.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_562fcb4b.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

ff_3x_nv_562fcb4b.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_562fcb4b.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

ta44_acog_562fcb4b.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_562fcb4b.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_562fcb4b.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_562fcb4b.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_562fcb4b.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_562fcb4b.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

kousaku_oled_sight_562fcb4b.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_562fcb4b.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_562fcb4b.name: Z-Point
z_point_562fcb4b.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_562fcb4b.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_562fcb4b.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

pso_1_scope_562fcb4b.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_562fcb4b.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

acog_scope_562fcb4b.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_562fcb4b.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_562fcb4b.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_562fcb4b.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_562fcb4b.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_562fcb4b.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_562fcb4b.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_562fcb4b.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_562fcb4b.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_562fcb4b.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_562fcb4b.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_562fcb4b.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

m145_562fcb4b.name: M145
m145_562fcb4b.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

vcog_8x_scope_562fcb4b.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_562fcb4b.info:

ta33_acog_562fcb4b.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

tango_msr_1_8x_562fcb4b.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_562fcb4b.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_562fcb4b.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

elfx_sight_562fcb4b.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

ta01_acog_75d4c733.info:

h_k_export_sight_ba9d7192.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_75d4c733.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_ba9d7192.name: Super Slim Sight

ff_3x_nv_75d4c733.name: FF 3x NV

Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

half_ring_sight_ba9d7192.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_ba9d7192.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_ba9d7192.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_ba9d7192.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_75d4c733.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_75d4c733.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_75d4c733.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_75d4c733.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_75d4c733.name: DeltaPoint Sight

dcl_120_75d4c733.info:

susat_scope_75d4c733.info:

peak01_sight_ba9d7192.name: PEAK01 Sight

both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
