okp_7_75d4c733.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_ba9d7192.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_ba9d7192.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_ba9d7192.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_ba9d7192.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_ba9d7192.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_ba9d7192.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_75d4c733.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_75d4c733.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

mbus_gen_3_sight_ba9d7192.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_ba9d7192.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

pk_a_75d4c733.name: PK-A
pk_a_75d4c733.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

aac_flip_up_sight_ba9d7192.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_ba9d7192.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

h_k_sight_ba9d7192.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_ba9d7192.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_75d4c733.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_75d4c733.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_75d4c733.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_75d4c733.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_m40_75d4c733.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_75d4c733.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

full_ring_sight_ba9d7192.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_ba9d7192.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

tac_c_note_75d4c733.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_75d4c733.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

hensoldt_3x_sight_75d4c733.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_75d4c733.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

diopter_sight_ba9d7192.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_ba9d7192.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

socom_buis_sight_ba9d7192.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_ba9d7192.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_75d4c733.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_75d4c733.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_75d4c733.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_75d4c733.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_75d4c733.name: MARS
mars_75d4c733.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

iwi_sight_ba9d7192.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_ba9d7192.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

ctar_barrel_264c3d22.name: CTAR Barrel
ctar_barrel_264c3d22.info:
Shortened barrel for the TAR-21, this barrel makes your TAR-21 into the CTAR-21.

This barrel reduces your long range potential that is typical to the TAR-21 to favour close quarters performance.

tar_duplex_ammo_d7a96981.name: TAR Duplex Ammo
tar_duplex_ammo_d7a96981.info: Specialty Colt 5.56x45 ammo stuffed with 2 bullets stacked on eachother. Splits the stats, and uses a smaller magazine than normal. More powerful than you'd expect, and reloads swiftly.

extended_magazine_5bc272a6.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_5bc272a6.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

over_charge_m41a_58e72e94.name: Over Charge (M41A)
over_charge_m41a_58e72e94.info: Load your pulse rifle with overcharged ammo!

u1_31x71mm_grenades_fdb83d15.name: U1 31x71mm Grenades
u1_31x71mm_grenades_fdb83d15.info:
So you ever notice that underbarrel grenade launcher you have? Well don't question it now, I am letting you use it.

just ignore how buggy the first shell insert is, ok?

ta01_acog_0b31b995.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_0b31b995.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_0b31b995.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_0b31b995.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_0b31b995.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_0b31b995.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_0b31b995.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_0b31b995.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_0b31b995.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_0b31b995.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_0b31b995.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_0b31b995.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_0b31b995.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_0b31b995.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_0b31b995.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

eotech_552_0b31b995.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_0b31b995.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_0b31b995.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_0b31b995.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_0b31b995.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_0b31b995.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_0b31b995.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_0b31b995.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_0b31b995.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_0b31b995.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_0b31b995.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_0b31b995.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_0b31b995.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_0b31b995.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_68f33946.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_68f33946.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_0b31b995.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_0b31b995.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_0b31b995.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_0b31b995.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_0b31b995.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_0b31b995.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_0b31b995.name: Z-Point
z_point_0b31b995.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_0b31b995.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_0b31b995.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_0b31b995.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_0b31b995.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_0b31b995.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_0b31b995.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_0b31b995.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_0b31b995.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

furro_sight_0b31b995.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_0b31b995.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_0b31b995.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_0b31b995.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_0b31b995.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_0b31b995.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_0b31b995.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_0b31b995.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_0b31b995.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_0b31b995.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_0b31b995.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_0b31b995.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_0b31b995.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_0b31b995.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_0b31b995.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_0b31b995.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_0b31b995.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_0b31b995.name: M145
m145_0b31b995.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_0b31b995.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

vcog_8x_scope_0b31b995.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_0b31b995.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

ta33_acog_0b31b995.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_0b31b995.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

tango_msr_1_8x_0b31b995.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_0b31b995.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_0b31b995.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_0b31b995.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

elfx_sight_0b31b995.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_0b31b995.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

maglite_0b31b995.name: Maglite
maglite_0b31b995.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

ddhb_reflex_0b31b995.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_0b31b995.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

buis_sight_0b31b995.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

microdot_mini_0b31b995.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_0b31b995.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

mro_sight_0b31b995.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_0b31b995.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

kalashnikov_sight_0b31b995.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sro_sight_0b31b995.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_0b31b995.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_0b31b995.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_0b31b995.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_0b31b995.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_0b31b995.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

animu_sight_0b31b995.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_0b31b995.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

sako_backup_sight_0b31b995.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_0b31b995.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_0b31b995.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_0b31b995.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

reflector_scope_0b31b995.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_0b31b995.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

dcl_120_0b31b995.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_0b31b995.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

troy_flip_up_sight_0b31b995.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_0b31b995.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

pso_1m2_scope_0b31b995.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_0b31b995.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_0b31b995.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_0b31b995.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

mini_sight_0b31b995.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_0b31b995.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

barska_electro_0b31b995.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_0b31b995.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

susat_scope_0b31b995.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_0b31b995.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

kel_tec_sight_0b31b995.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_0b31b995.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

pka_s_0b31b995.name: PKA-S
pka_s_0b31b995.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

diopter_sight_open_0b31b995.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_0b31b995.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

coyote_sight_0b31b995.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_0b31b995.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

kousaku_sight_0b31b995.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_0b31b995.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

c79_0b31b995.name: C79
c79_0b31b995.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

steyr_sight_0b31b995.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

peak01_sight_0b31b995.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_0b31b995.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

eotech_xps2_0b31b995.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_0b31b995.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

oeg_0b31b995.name: OEG
oeg_0b31b995.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_vudu_1_10_0b31b995.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_0b31b995.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_0b31b995.name: OKP-7
okp_7_0b31b995.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_0b31b995.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_0b31b995.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_0b31b995.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_0b31b995.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_0b31b995.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_0b31b995.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_0b31b995.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

mbus_gen_3_sight_0b31b995.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_0b31b995.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

pk_a_0b31b995.name: PK-A
pk_a_0b31b995.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

aac_flip_up_sight_0b31b995.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

h_k_sight_0b31b995.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_0b31b995.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_0b31b995.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_0b31b995.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_0b31b995.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_0b31b995.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_m40_0b31b995.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_0b31b995.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

delta_sight_0b31b995.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_0b31b995.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_0b31b995.name: Full Ring Sight

Model submitted by Rialag.

socom_buis_sight_0b31b995.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_0b31b995.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

mars_0b31b995.name: MARS

iwi_sight_0b31b995.name: IWI Sight

microdot_srs_0b31b995.name: Microdot SRS

Model by Makosushi.

half_ring_sight_ac795a0c.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

ak_19_6_02mm_mag_d573d02b.info:
Converts your AK-19 to fire 6.02x41mm - a highly experimental round designed in response to the Grand Federation NGSW program and 6.8x51mm ammo.
Intended as a universal replacement for 5.45x39 and 7.62x39, the AK-22 represents a hypothetical universal AK rifle. Very little else is known about the program, and it was likely shelved due to logistical costs.
Improves damage performance and penetration at the cost of recoil control.

aek_556_conversion_accecb66.info:
Converts your AEK-971 to fire 5.56x45mm turning it into the AEK-972!
Improved range damage while slightly lowering accuracy and damage up close.

muzzle_booster_03e68356.info:
8% RPM increase.

an_7_62x39_conversion_b867051a.info: Changes the ammotype fired to 7.62x39mm. Based on the prototyping / dummy model of the AN94 that theoretically fired 7.62x39mm. Expect AK-like traits such more power and recoil.

An experimental heavy barrel and bipod for the XM16E1, allowing for excellent sustained fire & recoil control. Never adopted at scale.

Reduces rate of fire while improving recoil and ranged performance.

m16a1_m855_309a8f72.info:
Load your M16A1 with green-tipped M855 5.56x45mm ammo.

Later used due to being more favourable than M193, M855 has much greater penetration potential than the M193.

However M855 has erratic performance when fired in the M16A1 as bullets tumble in the air.

anti_sight_ba0cba3e.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_ba0cba3e.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_ba0cba3e.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

ff_3x_nv_ba0cba3e.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_ba0cba3e.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_ba0cba3e.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_ba0cba3e.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_ba0cba3e.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_ba0cba3e.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_ba0cba3e.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_ba0cba3e.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_ba0cba3e.name: Z-Point
z_point_ba0cba3e.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_ba0cba3e.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_ba0cba3e.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_ba0cba3e.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_ba0cba3e.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_ba0cba3e.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_ba0cba3e.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

furro_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_ba0cba3e.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_ba0cba3e.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_ba0cba3e.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_ba0cba3e.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_ba0cba3e.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_ba0cba3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_ba0cba3e.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_ba0cba3e.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_ba0cba3e.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_ba0cba3e.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_ba0cba3e.name: M145
m145_ba0cba3e.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_ba0cba3e.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

ta33_acog_ba0cba3e.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_ba0cba3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

vcog_8x_scope_ba0cba3e.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_ba0cba3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

elfx_sight_ba0cba3e.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

tango_msr_1_8x_ba0cba3e.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_ba0cba3e.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_ba0cba3e.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

ddhb_reflex_ba0cba3e.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_ba0cba3e.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

maglite_ba0cba3e.name: Maglite
maglite_ba0cba3e.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

buis_sight_ba0cba3e.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

microdot_mini_ba0cba3e.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_ba0cba3e.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

kalashnikov_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mro_sight_ba0cba3e.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_ba0cba3e.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

animu_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

sro_sight_ba0cba3e.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_ba0cba3e.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_ba0cba3e.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

reflector_scope_ba0cba3e.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_ba0cba3e.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

diopter_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

mbus_sight_ba0cba3e.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_ba0cba3e.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

sako_backup_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

dcl_120_ba0cba3e.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_ba0cba3e.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

mini_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_ba0cba3e.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

pso_1m2_scope_ba0cba3e.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_ba0cba3e.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_ba0cba3e.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_ba0cba3e.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

susat_scope_ba0cba3e.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_ba0cba3e.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

barska_electro_ba0cba3e.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_ba0cba3e.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

kel_tec_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_ba0cba3e.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

diopter_sight_open_ba0cba3e.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_ba0cba3e.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

pka_s_ba0cba3e.name: PKA-S
pka_s_ba0cba3e.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

eotech_m40_ba0cba3e.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_ba0cba3e.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

coyote_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

steyr_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

c79_ba0cba3e.name: C79
c79_ba0cba3e.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

eotech_xps2_ba0cba3e.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_ba0cba3e.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

peak01_sight_ba0cba3e.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_ba0cba3e.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

oeg_ba0cba3e.name: OEG
oeg_ba0cba3e.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

mbus_gen_3_sight_ba0cba3e.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_ba0cba3e.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

eotech_vudu_1_10_ba0cba3e.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_ba0cba3e.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_ba0cba3e.name: OKP-7
okp_7_ba0cba3e.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_ba0cba3e.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_ba0cba3e.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_ba0cba3e.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_ba0cba3e.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_ba0cba3e.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_ba0cba3e.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

aac_flip_up_sight_ba0cba3e.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

pk_a_ba0cba3e.name: PK-A
pk_a_ba0cba3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

kousaku_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

h_k_sight_ba0cba3e.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_ba0cba3e.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_ba0cba3e.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

valorise_irons_ba0cba3e.name: Valorise Irons
valorise_irons_ba0cba3e.info: Iron sights from the FAMAS Valorise configuration.

hensoldt_z24_ba0cba3e.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_ba0cba3e.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

delta_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_ba0cba3e.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

tac_c_note_ba0cba3e.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_ba0cba3e.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

hensoldt_3x_sight_7fb0296e.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_7fb0296e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

reflex_sight_ba0cba3e.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_ba0cba3e.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

socom_buis_sight_ba0cba3e.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_ba0cba3e.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_ba0cba3e.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_ba0cba3e.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_ba0cba3e.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_ba0cba3e.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_ba0cba3e.name: MARS
mars_ba0cba3e.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

iwi_sight_ba0cba3e.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_ba0cba3e.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_ba0cba3e.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_ba0cba3e.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

potato_grip_f31dcd12.name: Potato Grip
potato_grip_f31dcd12.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

romanian_grip_f31dcd12.name: Romanian Grip
romanian_grip_f31dcd12.info:
A sturdy tactical foregrip that improves gun stability and vertical camera recoil but has worse horizontal recoil control, handling and mobility while aiming.

[GAIN]
-20% Translation recoil.
-10% Vertical camera body (X) recoil.
-10% Vertical camera Body (X) recoil climb.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-20% Idle & Walk sway.
-25% Scope sway.

[LOSS]
+10% Horizontal camera body (Y) recoil.
-5% Walk speed while aiming.
-10% Aiming/Equipping/Sprinting transition speeds.

folding_grip_f31dcd12.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_f31dcd12.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

angled_grip_f31dcd12.name: Angled Grip
angled_grip_f31dcd12.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
5% faster aiming speeds
8% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces equip speeds by 5%

vertical_grip_f31dcd12.name: Vertical Grip
vertical_grip_f31dcd12.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

[LOSS]
- +12% Camera Body horizontal (Y) recoil.
-5% aim/equip speed.

chainsaw_grip_4a4348a9.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_4a4348a9.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

stubby_grip_f31dcd12.name: Stubby Grip
stubby_grip_f31dcd12.info:
A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

15% better weapon sway
15% less muzzle climb and muzzle kick
8% less gun rotational recoil
20% less rearward gun kick
10% better hipfire stability
6% more horizontal gun shake
10% less aiming walkspeed
5% worse equip speed

sideways_grip_f31dcd12.name: Sideways Grip
sideways_grip_f31dcd12.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased hipfire spread.Decreased camera body YZ recoil and variance.Slightly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Slightly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation recoil.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

skeleton_grip_f31dcd12.name: Skeleton Grip
skeleton_grip_f31dcd12.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

pistol_grip_f31dcd12.name: Pistol Grip
pistol_grip_f31dcd12.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

hk337_300_conversion_323f5125.name: HK337 .300 Conversion
hk337_300_conversion_323f5125.info:
Converts your M416 to fire 6.8x43mm SPC!The 6.8mm Special Purpose Cartridge is an intermediate rifle cartridge developed to possibly replace 5.56x45mm.
While it offered superior lethality up close with minimal loss of magazine capacity and negligible increase in recoil, it began to falter at longer ranges and was dropped due to logistical and cost issues.

canted_delta_sight_dfe44268.name: Canted Delta Sight
canted_delta_sight_dfe44268.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45° for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_acog_scope_dfe44268.name: Canted Acog Scope
canted_acog_scope_dfe44268.info:
Adds an additional Acog scope at 45° for those moments you really just need a second scope.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

g36_300_conversion_6dbecce5.name: G36 .300 Conversion
g36_300_conversion_6dbecce5.info: Load your AR36 with .300 Blackout. It offers improved close range performance at the cost of recoil control and performance at longer ranges.

anti_sight_3d041000.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_3d041000.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_df996e7f.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_df996e7f.info: The carry handle iron sight present on the AR36C.

mp7_sight_3d041000.name: MP7 Sight

elfx_sight_c85b32dd.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

tango_msr_1_8x_c85b32dd.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_c85b32dd.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_c85b32dd.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_c85b32dd.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

ddhb_reflex_c85b32dd.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_c85b32dd.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

maglite_c85b32dd.name: Maglite
maglite_c85b32dd.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

buis_sight_c85b32dd.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_c85b32dd.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

microdot_mini_c85b32dd.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_c85b32dd.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

kalashnikov_sight_c85b32dd.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_c85b32dd.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mro_sight_c85b32dd.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_c85b32dd.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

animu_sight_c85b32dd.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_c85b32dd.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

sro_sight_c85b32dd.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_c85b32dd.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_c85b32dd.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_c85b32dd.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_c85b32dd.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_c85b32dd.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

reflector_scope_c85b32dd.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_c85b32dd.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

diopter_sight_c85b32dd.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_c85b32dd.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

mbus_sight_c85b32dd.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_c85b32dd.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

sako_backup_sight_c85b32dd.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_c85b32dd.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

dcl_120_c85b32dd.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_c85b32dd.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

mini_sight_c85b32dd.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_c85b32dd.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

pso_1m2_scope_c85b32dd.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_c85b32dd.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_c85b32dd.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_c85b32dd.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

susat_scope_c85b32dd.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_c85b32dd.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

barska_electro_c85b32dd.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_c85b32dd.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

kel_tec_sight_c85b32dd.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_c85b32dd.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

diopter_sight_open_c85b32dd.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_c85b32dd.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

pka_s_c85b32dd.name: PKA-S
pka_s_c85b32dd.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

eotech_m40_c85b32dd.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_c85b32dd.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

coyote_sight_c85b32dd.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_c85b32dd.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

steyr_sight_c85b32dd.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_c85b32dd.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

c79_c85b32dd.name: C79
c79_c85b32dd.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

eotech_xps2_c85b32dd.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_c85b32dd.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

peak01_sight_c85b32dd.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_c85b32dd.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

oeg_c85b32dd.name: OEG
oeg_c85b32dd.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

mbus_gen_3_sight_c85b32dd.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_c85b32dd.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

eotech_vudu_1_10_c85b32dd.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_c85b32dd.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_c85b32dd.name: OKP-7
okp_7_c85b32dd.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_c85b32dd.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_c85b32dd.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_c85b32dd.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_c85b32dd.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_c85b32dd.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_c85b32dd.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_c85b32dd.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_c85b32dd.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

aac_flip_up_sight_c85b32dd.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_c85b32dd.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

pk_a_c85b32dd.name: PK-A
pk_a_c85b32dd.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

kousaku_sight_c85b32dd.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_c85b32dd.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

h_k_sight_c85b32dd.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_c85b32dd.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_c85b32dd.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_c85b32dd.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

valorise_irons_c85b32dd.name: Valorise Irons
valorise_irons_c85b32dd.info: Iron sights from the FAMAS Valorise configuration.

hensoldt_z24_c85b32dd.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_c85b32dd.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

delta_sight_c85b32dd.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_c85b32dd.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_c85b32dd.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_c85b32dd.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

tac_c_note_c85b32dd.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_c85b32dd.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

hensoldt_3x_sight_79c8ce6c.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_79c8ce6c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

reflex_sight_c85b32dd.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_c85b32dd.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

socom_buis_sight_c85b32dd.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_c85b32dd.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_c85b32dd.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_c85b32dd.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_c85b32dd.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_c85b32dd.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_c85b32dd.name: MARS
mars_c85b32dd.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

iwi_sight_c85b32dd.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_c85b32dd.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_c85b32dd.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_c85b32dd.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

scar_l_9mm_conversion_af9ed9ed.name: SCAR L 9mm Conversion
scar_l_9mm_conversion_af9ed9ed.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM to fire 9x19mm using a conversion kit.
Uses a 50rd drum magazine. Focusses on CQC by increasing the fire rate, close range damage and reducing the recoil but at the cost of ranged damage, bullet speed and penetration!

malcolm_6x_scope_9a7d8162.name: Malcolm 6x Scope
malcolm_6x_scope_9a7d8162.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Long version of the Malcolm scope design.

556_stg_0836ded6.name: 556 STG
556_stg_0836ded6.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your STG into 5.56x45mm NATO making it the ''STG-N'' with a 60 round casket magazine.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.
You have defiled history.

m231_wire_stock_86ec3c88.name: M231 Wire Stock
m231_wire_stock_86ec3c88.info: Aftermarket wire stock fitted onto your illegal firearm. Do you really expect this to help..?

heavy_buffer_fccda4ec.name: Heavy Buffer
heavy_buffer_fccda4ec.info:
A heavy buffer tube with a nested spring used in some early XM231 prototypes - dropping the rate of fire to only 200 rounds per minute.

Why would you use this? Why would you want to use this?

short_barrel_ar_1bb7b990.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_1bb7b990.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

m855_specialty_conversion_5e092178.name: M855 Specialty Conversion
m855_specialty_conversion_5e092178.info:
Load your M231 with M855 5.56x45mm NATO.
 housed in a modified 100-round Beta-C double drum. They tumble quickly after leaving the barrel, causing inaccuracies when firing. An aura of sadness surrounds this conversion. It's as if a fallen hero once wielded this weapon...

full_stock_ef615347.name: Full Stock
full_stock_ef615347.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

retract_stock_e35cb38e.name: Retract Stock
retract_stock_e35cb38e.info:
Fold in the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

remove_stock_7b17913d.name: Remove Stock
remove_stock_7b17913d.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

short_barrel_ar_5e550ceb.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_5e550ceb.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

ak12_bars_barrel_5e550ceb.name: AK12 BARS Barrel
ak12_bars_barrel_5e550ceb.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats. Three-round burst-fire becomes the main firing option, accuracy greatly improved with the BARS system.

bren_2_7_62x39mm_4d9ad8da.name: Bren 2 7.62x39mm
bren_2_7_62x39mm_4d9ad8da.info:
Converts your VZ.806 to fire 7.62x39mm!
Overall large increase in damage, penetration and suppression but at the cost of your fire rate, bullet speed and recoil!

integrated_bren3_f7851f80.name: Integrated BREN3
integrated_bren3_f7851f80.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the VZ.808 rifle. Increases close-range damage while reducing damage at range.
25 studs detection range.

bren_300_conversion_2bf38a79.name: BREN .300 Conversion
bren_300_conversion_2bf38a79.info:
Loads your VZ.808 with supersonic .300 AAC Blackout!
Improves close range damage and penetration for reduced damage ranges, muzzle velocity and slightly increased recoil!
Great with suppressors!

mp7_sight_c53a1550.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_c53a1550.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_c53a1550.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_c53a1550.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_c53a1550.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_c53a1550.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

m16a2_buffer_stock_0f020b80.info: Uses the buffer tube from a traditional M16A2 to significantly increase your fire rate, destabilizes your recoil and reduces damage performance!

colt_acr_m855_e872456d.info:
Uses M855 instead of Duplex rounds. More accurate than the base ammo!
Deals good damage to the torso and head, high bullet speed, good penetration and lower recoil but fires slow and not so good at dealing limb damage!

colt_acr_phase_1_duplex_896bcb24.info:
Uses experimental Phase-1 Duplex rounds, it's made of a tungsten core which has more penetration than your base ammo, but at the cost of limb and headshot damage, and your bullet speed!
Comes with a 20rd magazine improving your reload, walk and handling speed!

20 stud detection radius.

An integrally suppressed barrel based off the CAR-15SD!
Improves close range, hipfire spread and aim walkspeed but reduced ranged performance and bullet speed due to a shorter barrel!

ar_25_45_conversion_88cb1c7f.info:
Loads your AR-15 with .25-45 Sharps.
 This uses the classic 20-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

extended_magazine_4d40cae4.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.
