fal_sight_9081c841.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

mbus_gen_3_sight_9081c841.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_9081c841.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

socom_buis_sight_9081c841.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_9081c841.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

short_barrel_ar_be885ec8.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_be885ec8.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

ak109_bars_barrel_3279369c.name: AK109 BARS Barrel
ak109_bars_barrel_3279369c.info: A specialty barrel made with the Balanced Automatics Recoil System in it. It will have drastic effects on recoil and RPM, among other stats.

103_5_56_conversion_38c92575.name: 103 5.56 Conversion
103_5_56_conversion_38c92575.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AK-103 into 6.5mm Grendel.

Improves recoil, velocity, and penetration characteristics but has somewhat worse body damage.

retract_stock_cd0c8b7f.name: Retract Stock
retract_stock_cd0c8b7f.info:
Fold in the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

collapsible_stock_cd0c8b7f.name: Collapsible Stock
collapsible_stock_cd0c8b7f.info: Alternative lightweight stock with the ability to fold down or collapse. Lightens your weapon, but makes it slightly more front-heavy in the process - slightly increasing vertical gun rotation.

akm_366_slugs_66a83e3d.name: AKM .366 (Slugs)
akm_366_slugs_66a83e3d.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM ammunition.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are soft point rounds.

akm_366_buckshot_ff5c1528.name: AKM .366 (Buckshot)
akm_366_buckshot_ff5c1528.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

banana_0143e2f0.name: Banana
banana_0143e2f0.info: There's always bullets in the banana mag.

vks_suppressor_4a52bb7a.name: VKS Suppressor
vks_suppressor_4a52bb7a.info:
The iconic big suppressor for the VKS!
Excellent sound & radar masking while also improving bullet speed and penetration at the cost of some limb kill range and worse movement and handling.

potato_grip_3b87072d.name: Potato Grip
potato_grip_3b87072d.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

folding_grip_3b87072d.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_3b87072d.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

angled_grip_3b87072d.name: Angled Grip
angled_grip_3b87072d.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
5% faster aiming speeds
8% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces equip speeds by 5%

vertical_grip_3b87072d.name: Vertical Grip
vertical_grip_3b87072d.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

[LOSS]
- +12% Camera Body horizontal (Y) recoil.
-5% aim/equip speed.

chainsaw_grip_3b87072d.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_3b87072d.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

skeleton_grip_3b87072d.name: Skeleton Grip
skeleton_grip_3b87072d.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

stubby_grip_3b87072d.name: Stubby Grip
stubby_grip_3b87072d.info:
A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

15% better weapon sway
15% less muzzle climb and muzzle kick
8% less gun rotational recoil
20% less rearward gun kick
10% better hipfire stability
6% more horizontal gun shake
10% less aiming walkspeed
5% worse equip speed

sideways_grip_3b87072d.name: Sideways Grip
sideways_grip_3b87072d.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased hipfire spread.Decreased camera body YZ recoil and variance.Slightly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Slightly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation recoil.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

pistol_grip_3b87072d.name: Pistol Grip
pistol_grip_3b87072d.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

hera_cqr_grip_3b87072d.name: Hera CQR Grip
hera_cqr_grip_3b87072d.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased weapon rotation and translation recoil.Decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased camera body X recoil.Slightly decreased camera body YZ recoil.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation look sway speed.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

vks_12_7x55mm_vps_1bcfbaf3.name: VKS 12.7x55mm VPS
vks_12_7x55mm_vps_1bcfbaf3.info: Load your VKS with 12.7x55mm VPS armor piercing rounds: giving it significantly increased penetration, but halves your limb kill range while also lowering bullet speed and minimum damage due to overpenetration!

anti_sight_dba670bb.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_dba670bb.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_dba670bb.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_dba670bb.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

mp7_sight_dba670bb.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_dba670bb.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_dba670bb.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

tac_c_note_f63196bc.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_f63196bc.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

eotech_552_f63196bc.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_f63196bc.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_f63196bc.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_f63196bc.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_dba670bb.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_dba670bb.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_dba670bb.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_dba670bb.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_dba670bb.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_dba670bb.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_f63196bc.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_f63196bc.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_78d60263.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_78d60263.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_f63196bc.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_f63196bc.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

microdot_mini_eb492e3c.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_eb492e3c.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

izhmash_sight_dba670bb.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_dba670bb.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

mars_f63196bc.name: MARS
mars_f63196bc.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

kousaku_oled_sight_f63196bc.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_f63196bc.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_f63196bc.name: Z-Point
z_point_f63196bc.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_f63196bc.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_f63196bc.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_dba670bb.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_dba670bb.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_dba670bb.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_dba670bb.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

furro_sight_dba670bb.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_dba670bb.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

pilad_3_f63196bc.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_f63196bc.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

kobra_ekp_sight_f63196bc.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_f63196bc.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_eb492e3c.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_eb492e3c.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_f63196bc.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_f63196bc.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

peak02_sight_dba670bb.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_dba670bb.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_dba670bb.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

super_slim_sight_dba670bb.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_dba670bb.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

troy_flip_up_sight_dba670bb.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_dba670bb.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

animu_sight_dba670bb.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_dba670bb.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

mini_sight_f63196bc.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_f63196bc.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

1200m_sight_dba670bb.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

handmade_sight_f63196bc.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_f63196bc.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

diopter_sight_dba670bb.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

maglite_f63196bc.name: Maglite
maglite_f63196bc.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

peak01_sight_dba670bb.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_dba670bb.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

pk_a_f63196bc.name: PK-A
pk_a_f63196bc.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_xps2_eb492e3c.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_eb492e3c.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

mro_sight_f63196bc.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_f63196bc.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_f63196bc.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_f63196bc.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

double_open_sight_dba670bb.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_dba670bb.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_dba670bb.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sako_backup_sight_dba670bb.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_dba670bb.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_dba670bb.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_dba670bb.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

carry_handle_sight_dba670bb.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_dba670bb.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

dcl_120_eb492e3c.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_eb492e3c.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

oeg_f63196bc.name: OEG
oeg_f63196bc.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

pka_s_f63196bc.name: PKA-S
pka_s_f63196bc.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

barska_electro_f63196bc.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_f63196bc.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

okp_7_f63196bc.name: OKP-7
okp_7_f63196bc.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

coyote_sight_f63196bc.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_f63196bc.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

steyr_sight_dba670bb.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

diopter_sight_open_dba670bb.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_dba670bb.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

aac_flip_up_sight_dba670bb.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

kousaku_sight_f63196bc.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_f63196bc.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

eotech_m40_eb492e3c.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_eb492e3c.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

mbus_gen_3_sight_dba670bb.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_dba670bb.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_dba670bb.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_dba670bb.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_dba670bb.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

amt_terminator_f63196bc.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_f63196bc.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

iwi_sight_dba670bb.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_dba670bb.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

h_k_sight_dba670bb.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_bf057693.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_bf057693.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

kel_tec_sight_dba670bb.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_dba670bb.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

uh_gen1_eb492e3c.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_eb492e3c.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

delta_sight_f63196bc.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_f63196bc.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_dba670bb.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_dba670bb.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

malcolm_3x_scope_18a83277.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_18a83277.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

socom_buis_sight_dba670bb.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_dba670bb.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

buis_sight_dba670bb.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_dba670bb.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_f63196bc.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_f63196bc.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_f63196bc.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_f63196bc.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

microdot_srs_eb492e3c.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_eb492e3c.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

maxim_silencer_286669eb.name: Maxim Silencer
maxim_silencer_286669eb.info:
The first successful suppressor design.
An old suppressor from 1909 that saw limited use on the M1903 Springfield. Being one of the first suppressors, it is not as effective as modern ones available to you, but does have its own range of benefits.

loudener_36f12f22.name: Loudener
loudener_36f12f22.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

air_service_barrel_56e0e232.name: Air Service Barrel
air_service_barrel_56e0e232.info: Barrel used on the Air Service M1903 Springfield rifle. Reduces weapon weight due to the lack of extra parts on the weapon, faster aimspeed.

air_service_mag_df2dd55a.name: Air Service Mag
air_service_mag_df2dd55a.info:
Fit your M1903 Springfield with a specialty magazine used in aircraft.
These were used as survival rifles in the instances of soliders becoming stranded after a crash. Very large magazine capacity with the expected downsides...

pedersen_device_37a09a04.name: Pedersen Device
pedersen_device_37a09a04.info:
The M1918 Pedersen Device was an experimental conversion for the M1903 firing the .30-18 Auto cartridge. Replacing a majority of your M1903 Springfields parts to allow it to fire in semi-automatic. Feeds from a large 40 round magazine.

Incompatible with the Marksman Kit.

pu_1_scope_89af0246.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_89af0246.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

plague_insight_08fb94ac.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_08fb94ac.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

malcolm_3x_scope_8ce30692.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_8ce30692.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

pso_1m2_scope_1ddf48a5.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_1ddf48a5.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

unertl_8x_scope_3c8a6598.name: Unertl 8x Scope
unertl_8x_scope_3c8a6598.info: The standard issue scope for the Springfield M1903. This absurdly long target scope was designed by John Unertl and was found to be the best for the requirements of the military at the time.

pso_1_scope_8ce30692.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_8ce30692.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

full_stock_d826e477.name: Full Stock
full_stock_d826e477.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

short_barrel_sniper_3279369c.name: Short Barrel (SNIPER)
short_barrel_sniper_3279369c.info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and handling. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet range, penetration, and velocity.

10_3_5mm_cbf029a7.name: 10/3.5mm
10_3_5mm_cbf029a7.info:
An obscure Zarovian cartridge that can be loaded in 7.62x54mmR weapons including your SVDS!
It is a dart encased in a sabot allowing it to fly incredibly fast with great potential in penetrating softer materials but not great at shooting limbs due to overpenetration!
Very powerful headshot damage and fast fire rate!

svds_953_conversion_ed088210.name: SVDS 953 Conversion
svds_953_conversion_ed088210.info:
Load your SVDS with 9.6x53mm LANCASTER.
 A large Zarovian caliber designed for the general public. Adjusted performance fitting for the round being fired.

ta01_acog_86c5f8cd.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_86c5f8cd.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_3f61d875.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_3f61d875.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

klassik_lm_535103c1.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_535103c1.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

pm_ii_ultrashort_86c5f8cd.name: PM II Ultrashort
pm_ii_ultrashort_86c5f8cd.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

h_k_export_sight_3f61d875.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_3f61d875.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_86c5f8cd.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_86c5f8cd.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_3f61d875.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

animu_sight_3f61d875.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_3f61d875.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

super_slim_sight_3f61d875.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_3f61d875.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

pso_12_7_86c5f8cd.name: PSO-12.7
pso_12_7_86c5f8cd.info:
A Zarovian large caliber scope that debuted on the VKS rifle.

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

troy_flip_up_sight_3f61d875.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_3f61d875.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

leupold_m8_6x_6b55bcb0.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_6b55bcb0.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

quick_release_sight_3f61d875.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_86c5f8cd.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_86c5f8cd.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_3f61d875.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

sagittarius_40x_86c5f8cd.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

half_ring_sight_3f61d875.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_3f61d875.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_3f61d875.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_3f61d875.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_3f61d875.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_3f61d875.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_23abeba5.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_23abeba5.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

leupold_mark_4_535103c1.name: Leupold Mark 4
leupold_mark_4_535103c1.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

izhmash_sight_3f61d875.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_3f61d875.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

nxs_5_5_22_535103c1.name: NXS 5.5-22
nxs_5_5_22_535103c1.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

leupold_m8_2x_5b9dc063.name: Leupold M8-2x
leupold_m8_2x_5b9dc063.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

kousaku_oled_sight_3f61d875.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_3f61d875.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_3f61d875.name: Z-Point
z_point_3f61d875.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_3f61d875.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_3f61d875.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_3f61d875.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_3f61d875.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_3f61d875.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_3f61d875.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

ta33_acog_86c5f8cd.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

pm_ii_535103c1.name: PM II
pm_ii_535103c1.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

elfx_sight_3f61d875.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_3f61d875.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

acog_scope_86c5f8cd.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_86c5f8cd.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

ddhb_reflex_3f61d875.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_3f61d875.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

kobra_ekp_sight_3f61d875.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_3f61d875.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

buis_sight_3f61d875.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

comp_aimpoint_3f61d875.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_3f61d875.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_3f61d875.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_3f61d875.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_86c5f8cd.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

microdot_mini_3f61d875.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_3f61d875.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

global_offensive_scope_86c5f8cd.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_86c5f8cd.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_3f61d875.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_3f61d875.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_3f61d875.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

deltapoint_sight_3f61d875.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_3f61d875.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

tango_msr_1_8x_86c5f8cd.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_86c5f8cd.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

reflex_sight_3f61d875.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_3f61d875.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

m145_86c5f8cd.name: M145
m145_86c5f8cd.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

eotech_552_3f61d875.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_3f61d875.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

uh_gen1_3f61d875.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_3f61d875.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

kel_tec_sight_3f61d875.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_3f61d875.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

vcog_8x_scope_86c5f8cd.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

hand_sight_3f61d875.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_3f61d875.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

1200m_sight_3f61d875.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

handmade_sight_3f61d875.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_3f61d875.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

eotech_xps2_3f61d875.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_3f61d875.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

maglite_3f61d875.name: Maglite
maglite_3f61d875.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

reflector_scope_86c5f8cd.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_86c5f8cd.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

sidewinder_ed_535103c1.name: SIDEWINDER ED
sidewinder_ed_535103c1.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

iwi_sight_3f61d875.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_3f61d875.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

mro_sight_3f61d875.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_3f61d875.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_3f61d875.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_3f61d875.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

hensoldt_3x_sight_86c5f8cd.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

double_open_sight_3f61d875.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_3f61d875.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kom_10x42_535103c1.name: KOM 10x42
kom_10x42_535103c1.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

diopter_sight_3f61d875.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

mbus_sight_3f61d875.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_3f61d875.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

dcl_120_3f61d875.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_3f61d875.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

fal_sight_3f61d875.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_3f61d875.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

pso_1m2_scope_3c8a6598.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_3c8a6598.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_86c5f8cd.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_86c5f8cd.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

coyote_sight_3f61d875.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_3f61d875.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

barska_electro_3f61d875.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_3f61d875.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

mbus_gen_3_sight_3f61d875.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_3f61d875.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

steyr_sight_3f61d875.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

pka_s_3f61d875.name: PKA-S
pka_s_3f61d875.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

cs_os15_86c5f8cd.name: CS/OS15
cs_os15_86c5f8cd.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

susat_scope_86c5f8cd.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

eotech_m40_3f61d875.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_3f61d875.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

c79_86c5f8cd.name: C79
c79_86c5f8cd.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

kousaku_sight_3f61d875.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_3f61d875.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

peak01_sight_3f61d875.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_3f61d875.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

aac_flip_up_sight_3f61d875.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

diopter_sight_open_3f61d875.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_3f61d875.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

eotech_vudu_1_10_86c5f8cd.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_86c5f8cd.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_3f61d875.name: OKP-7
okp_7_3f61d875.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_3f61d875.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

oeg_3f61d875.name: OEG
oeg_3f61d875.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

carry_handle_sight_3f61d875.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_3f61d875.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_3f61d875.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_3f61d875.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

sako_backup_sight_3f61d875.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_3f61d875.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

pk_a_3f61d875.name: PK-A
pk_a_3f61d875.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

kalashnikov_sight_3f61d875.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

h_k_sight_3f61d875.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_3f61d875.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_a241a872.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_a241a872.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_86c5f8cd.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_86c5f8cd.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

tac_c_note_3f61d875.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_3f61d875.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

delta_sight_3f61d875.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_3f61d875.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_3f61d875.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_3f61d875.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

straight_pull_bolt_2ec331ac.name: Straight Pull Bolt

Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all your chakras.
Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, can cycle freely, have a lot less weapon sway and can hold breath for longer while scoping.
Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

338_norma_62d621e5.name: .338 Norma

awm_308_conversion_8616aca6.name: AWM .308 Conversion

Perfect to counter terrorism!

peak02_sight_eb1b54ff.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

troy_flip_up_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_eb1b54ff.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

1200m_sight_eb1b54ff.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

peak01_sight_eb1b54ff.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_eb1b54ff.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

iwi_sight_eb1b54ff.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_eb1b54ff.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

double_open_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

carry_handle_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_eb1b54ff.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

sako_backup_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_eb1b54ff.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_eb1b54ff.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

diopter_sight_open_eb1b54ff.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_eb1b54ff.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

steyr_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

kalashnikov_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

aac_flip_up_sight_eb1b54ff.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

mbus_gen_3_sight_eb1b54ff.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_eb1b54ff.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_eb1b54ff.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_eb1b54ff.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_eb1b54ff.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

olympian_target_sight_d49d6aab.name: Olympian Target Sight
olympian_target_sight_d49d6aab.info: A targeting sight made specifically for the FT300. It technically isn't a scope, it's more like a zoomed in iron sight!

diopter_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

h_k_sight_eb1b54ff.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

kel_tec_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_eb1b54ff.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

hand_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_eb1b54ff.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

full_ring_sight_eb1b54ff.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_eb1b54ff.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

socom_buis_sight_eb1b54ff.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_eb1b54ff.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

buis_sight_eb1b54ff.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_eb1b54ff.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

remove_stock_df30fd1c.name: Remove Stock
remove_stock_df30fd1c.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

trg_260_10805d08.name: TRG 260
trg_260_10805d08.info: A conversion kit to transform your gun into the TRG-22, firing the .260 Remington cartridge. Less power, more maneuverability. Comes with a brand new bolt to make cycling much easier!

338_norma_trg_42_ea76e131.name: .338 Norma (TRG-42)
338_norma_trg_42_ea76e131.info: Loads your TRG with .338 Norma Magnum. This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length. While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

trg_375_376bd776.name: TRG 375
trg_375_376bd776.info: A conversion kit that transforms the gun into the TRG-S, firing the famed .30-06 cartridge. Trades performance at range for a significantly long one-shot kill to any part of the body.

ta01_acog_a96887a1.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_a96887a1.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_a96887a1.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_a96887a1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_7d878f91.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_7d878f91.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

klassik_lm_0e269902.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_0e269902.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

pm_ii_ultrashort_a96887a1.name: PM II Ultrashort
pm_ii_ultrashort_a96887a1.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

h_k_export_sight_7d878f91.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_7d878f91.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_d1a18d72.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_d1a18d72.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_7d878f91.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_7d878f91.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_7d878f91.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

tac_c_note_7d878f91.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_7d878f91.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

eotech_552_7d878f91.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_7d878f91.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_7d878f91.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_7d878f91.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

leupold_m8_6x_e77568c4.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_e77568c4.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

quick_release_sight_7d878f91.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_a96887a1.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_a96887a1.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_7d878f91.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

sagittarius_40x_a96887a1.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_a96887a1.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

half_ring_sight_7d878f91.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_7d878f91.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_7d878f91.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_7d878f91.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_7d878f91.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_7d878f91.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_c969ac5f.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_c969ac5f.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_7d878f91.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_7d878f91.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

microdot_mini_7d878f91.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_7d878f91.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

nxs_5_5_22_0e269902.name: NXS 5.5-22
nxs_5_5_22_0e269902.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

izhmash_sight_7d878f91.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_7d878f91.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

mars_7d878f91.name: MARS
mars_7d878f91.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

kousaku_oled_sight_7d878f91.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_7d878f91.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_7d878f91.name: Z-Point
z_point_7d878f91.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_7d878f91.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_7d878f91.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_7d878f91.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_7d878f91.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_7d878f91.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_7d878f91.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

ta33_acog_a96887a1.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_a96887a1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

furro_sight_7d878f91.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_7d878f91.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

pilad_3_7d878f91.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_7d878f91.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

acog_scope_a96887a1.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_a96887a1.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

pro_3_9x_scope_a96887a1.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_a96887a1.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

kobra_ekp_sight_7d878f91.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_7d878f91.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

pm_ii_f172514e.name: PM II
pm_ii_f172514e.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

comp_aimpoint_7d878f91.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_7d878f91.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_7d878f91.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_7d878f91.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_a96887a1.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_a96887a1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

leupold_mark_4_0e269902.name: Leupold Mark 4
leupold_mark_4_0e269902.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

global_offensive_scope_a96887a1.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_a96887a1.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_7d878f91.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_7d878f91.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_7d878f91.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

super_slim_sight_7d878f91.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_7d878f91.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

troy_flip_up_sight_7d878f91.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_7d878f91.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

animu_sight_7d878f91.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_7d878f91.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

m145_a96887a1.name: M145
m145_a96887a1.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

pso_12_7_a96887a1.name: PSO-12.7
pso_12_7_a96887a1.info:
A Zarovian large caliber scope that debuted on the VKS rifle.

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

mini_sight_7d878f91.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_7d878f91.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

hensoldt_z24_a96887a1.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_a96887a1.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

vcog_8x_scope_a96887a1.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_a96887a1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

pso_1_scope_a96887a1.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_a96887a1.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

1200m_sight_7d878f91.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

handmade_sight_7d878f91.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_7d878f91.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

diopter_sight_7d878f91.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

maglite_7d878f91.name: Maglite
maglite_7d878f91.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

peak01_sight_7d878f91.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_7d878f91.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

pk_a_7d878f91.name: PK-A
pk_a_7d878f91.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_xps2_7d878f91.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_7d878f91.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

mro_sight_7d878f91.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_7d878f91.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_7d878f91.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_7d878f91.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

hensoldt_3x_sight_a96887a1.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_a96887a1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

double_open_sight_7d878f91.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_7d878f91.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_7d878f91.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sako_backup_sight_7d878f91.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_7d878f91.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_7d878f91.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_7d878f91.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

carry_handle_sight_7d878f91.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_7d878f91.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

dcl_120_7d878f91.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_7d878f91.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

oeg_7d878f91.name: OEG
oeg_7d878f91.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

pso_1m2_scope_a96887a1.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_a96887a1.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_a96887a1.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_a96887a1.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

pka_s_7d878f91.name: PKA-S
pka_s_7d878f91.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

barska_electro_7d878f91.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_7d878f91.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

okp_7_7d878f91.name: OKP-7
okp_7_7d878f91.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

susat_scope_a96887a1.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_a96887a1.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

kom_10x42_0e269902.name: KOM 10x42
kom_10x42_0e269902.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

cs_os15_a96887a1.name: CS/OS15
cs_os15_a96887a1.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

coyote_sight_7d878f91.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_7d878f91.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

steyr_sight_7d878f91.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

c79_a96887a1.name: C79
c79_a96887a1.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

diopter_sight_open_7d878f91.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_7d878f91.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

aac_flip_up_sight_7d878f91.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

kousaku_sight_7d878f91.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_7d878f91.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

eotech_m40_7d878f91.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_7d878f91.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

eotech_vudu_1_10_a96887a1.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_a96887a1.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

mbus_gen_3_sight_7d878f91.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_7d878f91.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_7d878f91.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_7d878f91.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_7d878f91.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

amt_terminator_7d878f91.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_7d878f91.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

iwi_sight_7d878f91.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_7d878f91.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

sidewinder_ed_0e269902.name: SIDEWINDER ED
sidewinder_ed_0e269902.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

reflector_scope_a96887a1.name: Reflector Scope
