reflector_scope_a96887a1.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

h_k_sight_7d878f91.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_3591e88c.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_3591e88c.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

kel_tec_sight_7d878f91.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_7d878f91.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

uh_gen1_7d878f91.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_7d878f91.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

delta_sight_7d878f91.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_7d878f91.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_7d878f91.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_7d878f91.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

malcolm_3x_scope_d1a18d72.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_d1a18d72.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

tango_msr_1_8x_a96887a1.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_a96887a1.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

hd_n_4_16x44_a96887a1.name: HD-N 4-16x44
hd_n_4_16x44_a96887a1.info:
Full zoom: 12.0x
Alt zoom: 4.0x

A scope with a fairly unusual adjustment dial design. Possesses improved scope sway over other similar scopes, but is somewhat more unwieldy to use.

socom_buis_sight_7d878f91.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_7d878f91.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

buis_sight_7d878f91.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_7d878f91.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_7d878f91.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_7d878f91.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_7d878f91.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_7d878f91.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

leupold_m8_2x_2d3b3334.name: Leupold M8-2x
leupold_m8_2x_2d3b3334.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

microdot_srs_7d878f91.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_7d878f91.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

ft300_extended_magazine_905e9db6.name: FT300 Extended Magazine
ft300_extended_magazine_905e9db6.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 10 rounds combined with a straight pull bolt, but lessen certain mobility traits.

ft300_suppressor_209b0bd0.name: FT300 Suppressor
ft300_suppressor_209b0bd0.info: An integral suppressor for the FT300 competition rifle. Preserve damage, range and increases the torso multiplier in exchange for poorer velocity. Lower suppression radius.

short_barrel_sniper_0ddc3e20.name: Short Barrel (SNIPER)
short_barrel_sniper_0ddc3e20.info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and handling. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet range, penetration, and velocity.

long_barrel_sniper_0ddc3e20.name: Long Barrel (SNIPER)
long_barrel_sniper_0ddc3e20.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close overall handling and movement.

ft300_wood_furniture_c59ce729.name: FT300 Wood Furniture
ft300_wood_furniture_c59ce729.info:
Replaces the standard furniture of your weapon stock for something a bit more classic.
This wood furniture improves a variety of aspects of your weapon to allow it to be best suited for long range engagements.

olympic_forgrip_6e0b972b.name: Olympic Forgrip
olympic_forgrip_6e0b972b.info:
This grip is counterweighted to help improve how fast you can aim.
Ideal for taking aim at targets faster with small improvements to your sway and steady time, offset with hindered walkspeed while aiming.

ft300_6xc_f867d9dc.name: FT300 6XC
ft300_6xc_f867d9dc.info:
Load your FT300 with the 6XC wildcat cartridge.
Offering poorer close range performance to the .243 winchester cartridge, but it is preferred for long range usage with its slightly improved velocity and ranges due to weight and a faster reload and action time. Small increase to penetration.

ft300_308_4c58ef19.name: FT300 308
ft300_308_4c58ef19.info:
Load your FT300 with the .308 Winchester cartridge.
A heavier cartridge than .243 Winchester with a slightly lower velocity. More power with improved performance in long range, good if you want something between power for close range engagements and velocity for longer range engagements.

ft300_22lr_7d9b3749.name: FT300 22LR
ft300_22lr_7d9b3749.info:
Load your FT300 with the .22 Long Rifle cartridge.
This ammo type deals poorer damage in long range to the body and limbs, but still competes due to a fast reload and surprisingly high torso damage. Does not pair with the Marksman Kit and will always single load ammunition. No reserve ammo.

ft300_7_5_90be6fbf.name: FT300 7.5
ft300_7_5_90be6fbf.info:
Load your FT300 with the 7.5x55mm Swiss cartridge.
A heavier cartridge doing greater damage across range to an enemies torso, but travels slower with a slower reload. Higher penetration.

ta01_acog_3d8b738a.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_3d8b738a.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

diopter_sight_open_31d34bfd.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_31d34bfd.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

anti_sight_31d34bfd.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_31d34bfd.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

klassik_lm_38984301.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_38984301.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

pm_ii_ultrashort_3d8b738a.name: PM II Ultrashort
pm_ii_ultrashort_3d8b738a.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

h_k_export_sight_31d34bfd.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_31d34bfd.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_9d4c8f18.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_9d4c8f18.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_31d34bfd.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

animu_sight_31d34bfd.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_31d34bfd.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

tac_c_note_1b4fd382.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_1b4fd382.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

malcolm_3x_scope_c265d0c8.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_c265d0c8.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

reflex_sight_1b4fd382.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_1b4fd382.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

leupold_m8_6x_82542f28.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_82542f28.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

quick_release_sight_31d34bfd.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_9d0a2c7c.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_9d0a2c7c.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_31d34bfd.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

sagittarius_40x_84fa6950.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_84fa6950.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

half_ring_sight_31d34bfd.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_31d34bfd.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_31d34bfd.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_31d34bfd.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_1b4fd382.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_1b4fd382.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_ea933b9d.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_ea933b9d.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

leupold_mark_4_38984301.name: Leupold Mark 4
leupold_mark_4_38984301.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

kobra_sight_1b4fd382.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_1b4fd382.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

microdot_mini_1b4fd382.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_1b4fd382.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

leupold_m8_2x_5fe2a666.name: Leupold M8-2x
leupold_m8_2x_5fe2a666.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

mars_1b4fd382.name: MARS
mars_1b4fd382.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

pilad_3_1b4fd382.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_1b4fd382.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

kousaku_oled_sight_1b4fd382.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_1b4fd382.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_1b4fd382.name: Z-Point
z_point_1b4fd382.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_1b4fd382.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_1b4fd382.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_31d34bfd.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_31d34bfd.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_31d34bfd.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_31d34bfd.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

ta33_acog_9d0a2c7c.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_9d0a2c7c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

pm_ii_38984301.name: PM II
pm_ii_38984301.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

pro_3_9x_scope_3d8b738a.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_3d8b738a.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

acog_scope_3d8b738a.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_3d8b738a.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

reflector_scope_9d0a2c7c.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_9d0a2c7c.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

kobra_ekp_sight_1b4fd382.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_1b4fd382.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

deltapoint_sight_1b4fd382.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_1b4fd382.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

comp_aimpoint_1b4fd382.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_1b4fd382.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

nxs_5_5_22_38984301.name: NXS 5.5-22
nxs_5_5_22_38984301.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

ta11_acog_9d0a2c7c.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_9d0a2c7c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

mini_sight_1b4fd382.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_1b4fd382.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

global_offensive_scope_9d0a2c7c.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_9d0a2c7c.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_31d34bfd.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_31d34bfd.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_31d34bfd.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

tango_msr_1_8x_3d8b738a.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_3d8b738a.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

eotech_552_1b4fd382.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_1b4fd382.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

super_slim_sight_31d34bfd.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_31d34bfd.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

m145_3d8b738a.name: M145
m145_3d8b738a.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

pso_12_7_3d8b738a.name: PSO-12.7
pso_12_7_3d8b738a.info:
A Zarovian large caliber scope that debuted on the VKS rifle.

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

hensoldt_z24_3d8b738a.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_3d8b738a.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

pk_a_1b4fd382.name: PK-A
pk_a_1b4fd382.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

vcog_8x_scope_9d0a2c7c.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_9d0a2c7c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

eotech_xps2_1b4fd382.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_1b4fd382.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

1200m_sight_31d34bfd.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

handmade_sight_1b4fd382.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_1b4fd382.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

kalashnikov_sight_31d34bfd.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

maglite_1b4fd382.name: Maglite
maglite_1b4fd382.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

sidewinder_ed_38984301.name: SIDEWINDER ED
sidewinder_ed_38984301.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

iwi_sight_31d34bfd.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_31d34bfd.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

troy_flip_up_sight_31d34bfd.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_31d34bfd.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

mro_sight_1b4fd382.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_1b4fd382.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_1b4fd382.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_1b4fd382.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_1b4fd382.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_1b4fd382.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_31d34bfd.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_31d34bfd.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

sako_backup_sight_31d34bfd.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_31d34bfd.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_31d34bfd.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_31d34bfd.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

fal_sight_31d34bfd.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_31d34bfd.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

dcl_120_1b4fd382.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_1b4fd382.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

eotech_m40_1b4fd382.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_1b4fd382.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

pso_1m2_scope_3d8b738a.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_3d8b738a.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_3d8b738a.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_3d8b738a.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

mbus_gen_3_sight_31d34bfd.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_31d34bfd.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

barska_electro_1b4fd382.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_1b4fd382.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

kom_10x42_38984301.name: KOM 10x42
kom_10x42_38984301.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

izhmash_sight_31d34bfd.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_31d34bfd.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

pka_s_1b4fd382.name: PKA-S
pka_s_1b4fd382.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

cs_os15_3d8b738a.name: CS/OS15
cs_os15_3d8b738a.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

susat_scope_3d8b738a.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_3d8b738a.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

diopter_sight_31d34bfd.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

c79_3d8b738a.name: C79
c79_3d8b738a.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

aac_flip_up_sight_31d34bfd.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

peak01_sight_31d34bfd.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_31d34bfd.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

steyr_sight_31d34bfd.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

coyote_sight_1b4fd382.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_1b4fd382.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

eotech_vudu_1_10_3d8b738a.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_3d8b738a.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_1b4fd382.name: OKP-7
okp_7_1b4fd382.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_31d34bfd.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

oeg_1b4fd382.name: OEG
oeg_1b4fd382.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

carry_handle_sight_31d34bfd.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_31d34bfd.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_1b4fd382.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_1b4fd382.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

hensoldt_3x_sight_9d0a2c7c.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_9d0a2c7c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

olympian_target_sight_3029b2a2.name: Olympian Target Sight
olympian_target_sight_3029b2a2.info: A targeting sight made specifically for the FT300. It technically isn't a scope, it's more like a zoomed in iron sight!

h_k_sight_31d34bfd.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_9789215a.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_9789215a.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

kel_tec_sight_31d34bfd.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_31d34bfd.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

hand_sight_31d34bfd.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_31d34bfd.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

delta_sight_1b4fd382.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_1b4fd382.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_31d34bfd.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_31d34bfd.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

pso_1_scope_3d8b738a.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_3d8b738a.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

kousaku_sight_1b4fd382.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_1b4fd382.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

hd_n_4_16x44_3d8b738a.name: HD-N 4-16x44
hd_n_4_16x44_3d8b738a.info:
Full zoom: 12.0x
Alt zoom: 4.0x

A scope with a fairly unusual adjustment dial design. Possesses improved scope sway over other similar scopes, but is somewhat more unwieldy to use.

socom_buis_sight_31d34bfd.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_31d34bfd.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

buis_sight_31d34bfd.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_31d34bfd.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_1b4fd382.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_1b4fd382.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_1b4fd382.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_1b4fd382.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

furro_sight_31d34bfd.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_31d34bfd.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

microdot_srs_1b4fd382.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_1b4fd382.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

straight_pull_bolt_0e2c8aea.name: Straight Pull Bolt
straight_pull_bolt_0e2c8aea.info:
Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all your chakras.
Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, can cycle freely, have a lot less weapon sway and can hold breath for longer while scoping.
Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

short_barrel_sniper_d86ae4d5.name: Short Barrel (SNIPER)
short_barrel_sniper_d86ae4d5.info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and handling. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet range, penetration, and velocity.

k14_308_winchester_69ec338f.name: K14 .308 Winchester
k14_308_winchester_69ec338f.info:
Load your K14 with .308 Winchester.
Fitted with a 5 round magazine, the K14 gains more favourable sniper traits with additional reload speed, but less rounds are carried.

klassik_lm_a8c33c04.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_a8c33c04.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

leupold_m8_6x_0099830c.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_0099830c.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

sagittarius_40x_44f4ea3a.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_44f4ea3a.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

nxs_5_5_22_a8c33c04.name: NXS 5.5-22
nxs_5_5_22_a8c33c04.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

pm_ii_a8c33c04.name: PM II
pm_ii_a8c33c04.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

leupold_mark_4_a8c33c04.name: Leupold Mark 4
leupold_mark_4_a8c33c04.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

global_offensive_scope_44f4ea3a.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_44f4ea3a.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

pso_1_scope_44f4ea3a.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_44f4ea3a.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

pso_1m2_scope_44f4ea3a.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_44f4ea3a.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

kom_10x42_44f4ea3a.name: KOM 10x42
kom_10x42_44f4ea3a.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

sidewinder_ed_a8c33c04.name: SIDEWINDER ED
sidewinder_ed_a8c33c04.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

short_chop_fa1ba8bb.name: Short Chop
short_chop_fa1ba8bb.info: Equip your Fix with the Short Chop, a medium suppressor designed for the heavy caliber. Increases ranges, deadly quiet. Do not use to break boards. 30 Stud detection radius.

porq_chop_4031618f.name: PORQ Chop
porq_chop_4031618f.info: Equip your Fix with the PorQ Chop, a heavy suppressor designed for the heavy caliber. Reduced velocity, deadly quiet. Improves CQC Torso ranges. Do not eat.

tfix_308_815f4434.name: TFIX 308
tfix_308_815f4434.info: Swap your caliber over to .308 Win. Increases magazine capacity, velocity, and treats your rifle closer to a standard light sniper.

tfix_65cree_d3b9a30d.name: TFIX 65Cree
tfix_65cree_d3b9a30d.info: Swap your caliber over to 6.5 Creedmoor. Faster projectile velocity and improved performance at longer range.

straight_pull_bolt_ea0ea7e7.name: Straight Pull Bolt
straight_pull_bolt_ea0ea7e7.info:
Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all your chakras.
Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, can cycle freely, have a lot less weapon sway and can hold breath for longer while scoping.
Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

long_barrel_ntw_20_fcf218a1.name: Long Barrel (NTW-20)
long_barrel_ntw_20_fcf218a1.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

ntw_obrez_barrel_ee973e78.name: NTW Obrez Barrel
ntw_obrez_barrel_ee973e78.info: An even shorter barrel for the NTW-20, made by a deaf gunsmith. Provides an exaggerated version of the short barrel stats, good and bad. You are able to stand while aiming with this equipped.

chainsaw_grip_2645543d.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_2645543d.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

ntw_14_5_conversion_1356f97a.name: NTW 14.5 Conversion
ntw_14_5_conversion_1356f97a.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 14.5x114mm.

While the weapon itself isn't any lighter, the bolt is - allowing you to cycle the action significantly faster. The B-32 round has exceptional penetration and velocity, but loses one-shot kill potential at extreme ranges.

ntw_20_conversion_c4497e13.name: NTW 20 Conversion
ntw_20_conversion_c4497e13.info:
Load your NTW-20 with 20x110mm Hispano-Suiza.

Improves muzzle velocity and damage per shot, but reduces overall penetration.

ta01_acog_3140893c.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_3140893c.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_3140893c.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_3140893c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

klassik_lm_994a5030.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_994a5030.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

pm_ii_ultrashort_3140893c.name: PM II Ultrashort
pm_ii_ultrashort_3140893c.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3.5x

The Sm & Bender PM II Ultrashort is one of the world's shortest yet fully functional sniper scopes.
Due to its short design, it is easily suitable for semi-automatic rifles with short rails.

pu_1_scope_7179bc0f.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_7179bc0f.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

tac_c_note_b8a86750.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_b8a86750.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

malcolm_3x_scope_c4e0ace0.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_c4e0ace0.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

reflex_sight_f4ea9384.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_f4ea9384.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

leupold_m8_6x_848352a4.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_848352a4.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

ff_3x_nv_3140893c.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_3140893c.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

sagittarius_40x_6ff525a6.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_6ff525a6.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

ta44_acog_b8a86750.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_b8a86750.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_d870f6b8.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_d870f6b8.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_b8a86750.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_b8a86750.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

microdot_mini_f4ea9384.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_f4ea9384.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

reflector_scope_3140893c.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_3140893c.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

z_point_f4ea9384.name: Z-Point
z_point_f4ea9384.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_b8a86750.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_b8a86750.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

ta33_acog_3140893c.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_3140893c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

pm_ii_994a5030.name: PM II
pm_ii_994a5030.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

acog_scope_3140893c.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_3140893c.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_f4ea9384.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_f4ea9384.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_b8a86750.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_b8a86750.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_f4ea9384.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_f4ea9384.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_3140893c.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_3140893c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_3140893c.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_3140893c.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

m145_3140893c.name: M145
m145_3140893c.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

vcog_8x_scope_3140893c.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_3140893c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

tango_msr_1_8x_3140893c.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_3140893c.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_b8a86750.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_b8a86750.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

maglite_b8a86750.name: Maglite
maglite_b8a86750.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

mro_sight_b8a86750.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_b8a86750.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_b8a86750.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_b8a86750.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

hensoldt_3x_sight_3140893c.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_3140893c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

dcl_120_b8a86750.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_b8a86750.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

pso_1m2_scope_3140893c.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_3140893c.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_3140893c.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_3140893c.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

barska_electro_f4ea9384.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_f4ea9384.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

nxs_5_5_22_994a5030.name: NXS 5.5-22
nxs_5_5_22_994a5030.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

pka_s_b8a86750.name: PKA-S
pka_s_b8a86750.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

cs_os15_3140893c.name: CS/OS15
cs_os15_3140893c.info:
The CS/OS15 (8x-32x) is a Jinhanian variable zoom optic with a very simple crosshair used primarily as a long-range daytime optic on the CS/LS3 and CS/LS4 snipers.

It can be changed from a default zoom of 10x to an alternate zoom of 3.5x with the alt-aim key (T).

susat_scope_3140893c.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_3140893c.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

leupold_m8_2x_436d7283.name: Leupold M8-2x
leupold_m8_2x_436d7283.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

c79_3140893c.name: C79
c79_3140893c.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

mars_b8a86750.name: MARS
mars_b8a86750.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

pilad_3_f4ea9384.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_f4ea9384.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

pso_1_scope_3140893c.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_3140893c.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

pk_a_b8a86750.name: PK-A
pk_a_b8a86750.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_vudu_1_10_3140893c.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_3140893c.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_f4ea9384.name: OKP-7
okp_7_f4ea9384.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

mini_sight_f4ea9384.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_f4ea9384.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

oeg_b8a86750.name: OEG
oeg_b8a86750.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

amt_terminator_b8a86750.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_b8a86750.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

uh_gen1_b8a86750.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_b8a86750.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

eotech_xps2_b8a86750.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_b8a86750.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

pso_12_7_3140893c.name: PSO-12.7
pso_12_7_3140893c.info:
A Zarovian large caliber scope that debuted on the VKS rifle.

Its origins and information are still relatively unknown, but it appears to be designed to withstand large caliber rounds such as the 12.7x55mm cartridge. This name was chosen based on the existing PSO family name "Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky" (Optical Sniper Sight) and a reference to its caliber rating.

kousaku_sight_b8a86750.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_b8a86750.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

swarovski_scope_91165d25.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_91165d25.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_3140893c.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_3140893c.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

sidewinder_ed_994a5030.name: SIDEWINDER ED
sidewinder_ed_994a5030.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

delta_sight_f4ea9384.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_f4ea9384.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

eotech_552_b8a86750.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_b8a86750.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

coyote_sight_f4ea9384.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_f4ea9384.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

kom_10x42_994a5030.name: KOM 10x42
kom_10x42_994a5030.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

hd_n_4_16x44_3140893c.name: HD-N 4-16x44
hd_n_4_16x44_3140893c.info:
Full zoom: 12.0x
Alt zoom: 4.0x

A scope with a fairly unusual adjustment dial design. Possesses improved scope sway over other similar scopes, but is somewhat more unwieldy to use.

leupold_mark_4_994a5030.name: Leupold Mark 4
leupold_mark_4_994a5030.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

pro_3_9x_scope_3140893c.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_3140893c.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

ddhb_reflex_f4ea9384.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_f4ea9384.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_b8a86750.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_b8a86750.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

kousaku_oled_sight_b8a86750.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_b8a86750.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

microdot_srs_b8a86750.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_b8a86750.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

cheytac_cqb_barrel_cc7a335e.name: CheyTac CQB Barrel
cheytac_cqb_barrel_cc7a335e.info: Shortened homemade barrel modification for the M200 Intervention. Not suited for long range engagements.

375_cheytac_f2a31051.name: .375 CheyTac
375_cheytac_f2a31051.info:
Load your Intervention with .375 CheyTac.
The alternative ammo that the Intervention can be made to fire featuring faster muzzle velocity but reduced penetration and range.

anti_sight_f3ec5370.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_f3ec5370.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

klassik_lm_3544ac90.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_3544ac90.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

h_k_export_sight_f3ec5370.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_f3ec5370.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

mp7_sight_f3ec5370.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_f3ec5370.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_f3ec5370.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_f3ec5370.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

eotech_552_f3ec5370.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_f3ec5370.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_f3ec5370.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_f3ec5370.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

leupold_m8_6x_0c87170c.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_0c87170c.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

herstal_sight_f3ec5370.name: Herstal Sight

half_ring_sight_f3ec5370.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_f3ec5370.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_f3ec5370.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_f3ec5370.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

microdot_mini_f3ec5370.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_f3ec5370.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

acog_scope_0f9515f6.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_0f9515f6.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

izhmash_sight_f3ec5370.name: Izhmash Sight

kousaku_oled_sight_f3ec5370.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_f3ec5370.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

macro_p_1_f3ec5370.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_f3ec5370.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_f3ec5370.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_f3ec5370.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_f3ec5370.name: MBUS Pro Sight

furro_sight_f3ec5370.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_f3ec5370.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

comp_aimpoint_f3ec5370.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_f3ec5370.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

backup_sight_f3ec5370.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_f3ec5370.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

sako_backup_sight_f3ec5370.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_f3ec5370.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_f3ec5370.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

Model by Mako.

steyr_sight_f3ec5370.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

elfx_sight_f3ec5370.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_f3ec5370.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

microdot_srs_f3ec5370.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_f3ec5370.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

straight_pull_bolt_77856963.info:

Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

dsr_light_stock_03e623d5.info:

dsr_remove_mag_12aeb2ad.info:
Removes the front magazine from your gun to lower its weight, increasing mobility while aiming and handling speed.

m903_slap_560ea6ec.info:
Nothing can stop you now.

17_wildcat_c873c317.info:

Wildcat .50 BMG cartridge made to fire a tiny little .17 caliber bullet.

I don't see really big rats...

m107_reduced_magazine_f94bb11c.info:

m107_unfolded_bipod_2aea3bd2.name: M107 Unfolded Bipod
m107_unfolded_bipod_2aea3bd2.info:

When aimed in, cannot move and slows down unaiming speed but greatly decreases gun kick and improves accuracy!

r2_suppressor_66a80dbd.name: R2 Suppressor
r2_suppressor_66a80dbd.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

compensator_66a80dbd.name: Compensator
compensator_66a80dbd.info:
A compensating muzzle device.
40% less horizontal recoil variance
15% more vertical muzzle kick and variance
25% more muzzle climb
Slightly worse hipfire spread and stability.

muzzle_booster_66a80dbd.name: Muzzle Booster
muzzle_booster_66a80dbd.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

loudener_741a2be2.name: Loudener
loudener_741a2be2.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

pbs_4_suppressor_66a80dbd.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

x_ring_66a80dbd.name: X-Ring
x_ring_66a80dbd.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

ars_suppressor_66a80dbd.name: ARS Suppressor
ars_suppressor_66a80dbd.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

barrett_cqb_barrel_48a90e30.name: Barrett CQB Barrel
barrett_cqb_barrel_48a90e30.info:
A short CQB barrel for the M82A1M. Not suited for long range engagements.
Lowers maximum and minimum ranges required to torso kill, but also penetration and bullet speed. May not always be 100% accurate!
Improves walk speed and handling significantly!

halbek_device_66a80dbd.name: Halbek Device
halbek_device_66a80dbd.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

pbs_1_suppressor_66a80dbd.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_66a80dbd.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

oil_filter_66a80dbd.name: Oil Filter
oil_filter_66a80dbd.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

flash_hider_66a80dbd.name: Flash Hider
flash_hider_66a80dbd.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

muzzle_brake_66a80dbd.name: Muzzle Brake
muzzle_brake_66a80dbd.info:
A standard muzzle device which reduces vertical recoil climb by dispersing muzzle gases horizontally.

40% reduction in vertical kick
15% increase to vertical stability
15% less vertical rotational recoil
20% less muzzle climb

15% more horizontal recoil variance

long_barrel_sweetspot_48a90e30.name: Long Barrel (Sweetspot)

10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking

suppressor_66a80dbd.info:
70 stud detection radius.

Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

t_brake_66a80dbd.name: T-Brake
t_brake_66a80dbd.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.
