Introduces unique one shot kill ranges with its heavier grain projectile.

Greatly reduces the suppression effect so enemies will not know you are shooting at them.

pm_ii_89a5790b.name: PM II
pm_ii_89a5790b.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

extended_magazine_2aa91495.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_2aa91495.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

straight_pull_bolt_0cba9d8a.name: Straight Pull Bolt
straight_pull_bolt_0cba9d8a.info:
Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all your chakras.
Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, can cycle freely, have a lot less weapon sway and can hold breath for longer while scoping.
Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

r2_suppressor_edfde21f.name: R2 Suppressor
r2_suppressor_edfde21f.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

front_post_a73896a0.name: Front Post
front_post_a73896a0.info:
Attach a front post to your 3-line rifle.
Optional and free!

loudener_682ee409.name: Loudener
loudener_682ee409.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

halbek_device_edfde21f.name: Halbek Device
halbek_device_edfde21f.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

pbs_4_suppressor_edfde21f.name: PBS-4 Suppressor
pbs_4_suppressor_edfde21f.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

x_ring_edfde21f.name: X-Ring
x_ring_edfde21f.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

ars_suppressor_edfde21f.name: ARS Suppressor
ars_suppressor_edfde21f.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

short_barrel_sniper_c5aadbf9.name: Short Barrel (SNIPER)
short_barrel_sniper_c5aadbf9.info:
Lighter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed, mobility and handling. However, the barrel's length will hurt bullet range, penetration, and velocity.

pbs_1_suppressor_edfde21f.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_edfde21f.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

suppressor_edfde21f.name: Suppressor
suppressor_edfde21f.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

t_brake_edfde21f.name: T-Brake
t_brake_edfde21f.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

mosin_410_20a6967c.name: MOSIN 410
mosin_410_20a6967c.info:
You won't believe what Zarovian farmers are doing this time!
Convert your worn out MOSIN MAGANT into a modern day FROLOVKA that fires 410 bore rounds!

mosin_8mm_conversion_d0db07c1.name: Mosin 8mm Conversion
mosin_8mm_conversion_d0db07c1.info: A rare Stalowan / Alpenstahlan conversion that allows your Mosin-Nagant to fire the larger 8x50mmR Mannlicher cartridge, increasing the power enough to stop a man up to a decently far range. But the cartridge faults allow it to not keep standard sniper rifle traits too well.

klassik_lm_1d851e55.name: Klassik LM
klassik_lm_1d851e55.info:
Full zoom: 8x
Alt zoom: 3x

The Klassik LM 2.5-10x is the primary scope found on the WA2000. Also developed by Sm & Bender made for those who take their weapons to range, or prefer to go hunting.
Low sway with mediocre sway speed and average steady time.

pu_1_scope_ee40b364.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_ee40b364.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

leupold_m8_6x_0d66a977.name: Leupold M8-6x
leupold_m8_6x_0d66a977.info: The Leupold M8-6x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. It's renowned for its toughness.

leupold_mark_4_1d851e55.name: Leupold Mark 4
leupold_mark_4_1d851e55.info:
A Grand Federation variable-zoom optic which is somewhat lacking in features by modern optic standards. Nevertheless, it is considered reliable and can be found on numerous military rifles from the early 2000s.

10x blackscope with access to a 5x alt aim (T).

nxs_5_5_22_1d851e55.name: NXS 5.5-22
nxs_5_5_22_1d851e55.info: The NXS 5.5-22 is the scope found on the INTERVENTION. Developed by Nightforce optics it is one of their most proven optics as a long range rifle scope.

leupold_m8_2x_8721734f.name: Leupold M8-2x
leupold_m8_2x_8721734f.info: The Leupold M8-2x is a simple, modern, fixed-magnification scope for both hunters and armed forces alike. A smaller form factor means greater handling capability.

pm_ii_1d851e55.name: PM II
pm_ii_1d851e55.info: The Sm & Bender PM II is a 10x scope originally designed and intended for use on the AWM series of bolt action sniper rifles. It is the perfect choice for military and police forces looking for uncompromised accuracy.

sidewinder_ed_1d851e55.name: SIDEWINDER ED
sidewinder_ed_1d851e55.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

kom_10x42_1d851e55.name: KOM 10x42
kom_10x42_1d851e55.info: A modified version of the scope made by Kalinka Optics. Press T to shift to 3x zoom.

pso_1m2_scope_8300cb3e.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_8300cb3e.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

pso_1_scope_2409a542.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_2409a542.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

ta01_acog_69e5347c.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_69e5347c.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

diopter_sight_open_69e5347c.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_69e5347c.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

anti_sight_69e5347c.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_69e5347c.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_69e5347c.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_69e5347c.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

hand_sight_69e5347c.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_69e5347c.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_69e5347c.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_69e5347c.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

mini_sight_266eb31a.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_266eb31a.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

reflex_sight_69e5347c.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_69e5347c.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_69e5347c.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_69e5347c.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_d8cbfa80.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_d8cbfa80.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_69e5347c.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_69e5347c.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_69e5347c.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_69e5347c.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_358dc360.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_358dc360.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_266eb31a.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_266eb31a.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_69e5347c.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_69e5347c.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_69e5347c.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_69e5347c.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_69e5347c.name: Z-Point
z_point_69e5347c.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_69e5347c.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_69e5347c.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

ta33_acog_69e5347c.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_69e5347c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

furro_sight_69e5347c.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_69e5347c.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_69e5347c.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_69e5347c.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_69e5347c.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_69e5347c.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_69e5347c.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_69e5347c.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_69e5347c.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_69e5347c.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_69e5347c.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_69e5347c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

backup_sight_69e5347c.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_69e5347c.name: M145
m145_69e5347c.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_69e5347c.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

maglite_69e5347c.name: Maglite
maglite_69e5347c.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

mro_sight_69e5347c.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_69e5347c.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_69e5347c.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_69e5347c.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_69e5347c.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_69e5347c.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_69e5347c.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_69e5347c.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_69e5347c.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mbus_sight_69e5347c.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_69e5347c.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

dcl_120_69e5347c.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_69e5347c.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

barska_electro_69e5347c.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_69e5347c.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

pka_s_69e5347c.name: PKA-S
pka_s_69e5347c.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

coyote_sight_69e5347c.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_69e5347c.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

c79_69e5347c.name: C79
c79_69e5347c.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

aac_flip_up_sight_69e5347c.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

steyr_sight_69e5347c.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

eotech_xps2_69e5347c.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_69e5347c.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

mars_69e5347c.name: MARS
mars_69e5347c.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

okp_7_69e5347c.name: OKP-7
okp_7_69e5347c.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_69e5347c.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

pilad_3_69e5347c.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_69e5347c.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

carry_handle_sight_cc6b76ef.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_cc6b76ef.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_69e5347c.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_69e5347c.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

vcog_6x_scope_69e5347c.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_69e5347c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

pk_a_69e5347c.name: PK-A
pk_a_69e5347c.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_552_69e5347c.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_69e5347c.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

h_k_sight_69e5347c.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

hensoldt_3x_sight_f27afa15.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_f27afa15.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

kel_tec_sight_69e5347c.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_69e5347c.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

microdot_mini_69e5347c.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_69e5347c.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

delta_sight_266eb31a.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_266eb31a.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_d8cbfa80.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_d8cbfa80.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

eotech_m40_69e5347c.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_69e5347c.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

diopter_sight_69e5347c.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

kousaku_sight_69e5347c.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_69e5347c.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

animu_sight_69e5347c.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_69e5347c.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

buis_sight_69e5347c.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_69e5347c.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_69e5347c.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_69e5347c.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_69e5347c.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_69e5347c.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

iwi_sight_69e5347c.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_69e5347c.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_69e5347c.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_69e5347c.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

long_barrel_pistol_a1840911.name: Long Barrel (PISTOL)
long_barrel_pistol_a1840911.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

33rd_mag_1e43ed0a.name: 33rd Mag
33rd_mag_1e43ed0a.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G17 and G18. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

glock_stock_2_e6488bd0.name: Glock Stock 2
glock_stock_2_e6488bd0.info: A Grand Federation-made stock which folds over in front of your G-Series pistol. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

glock_stock_folded_6e0b972b.name: Glock Stock Folded
glock_stock_folded_6e0b972b.info: A Grand Federation-made stock which you have folded over in front of your G-Series pistol. Now you have a foregrip! Featuring similar attributes to the Angled Grip.

ta01_acog_99e6cd43.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_99e6cd43.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_99e6cd43.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_99e6cd43.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

maglite_99e6cd43.name: Maglite
maglite_99e6cd43.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

mro_sight_99e6cd43.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_99e6cd43.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_99e6cd43.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

hensoldt_3x_sight_eec57d7f.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_eec57d7f.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

eotech_552_99e6cd43.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_99e6cd43.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_99e6cd43.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_99e6cd43.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

dcl_120_99e6cd43.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_99e6cd43.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window.

barska_electro_99e6cd43.name: Barska Electro

ta44_acog_99e6cd43.name: TA44 Acog

coyote_sight_99e6cd43.name: Coyote Sight

pk_a_99e6cd43.name: PK-A

microdot_mini_68965e13.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_68965e13.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

sro_sight_68965e13.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_68965e13.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_68965e13.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_68965e13.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_68965e13.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_68965e13.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_68965e13.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_68965e13.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sako_backup_sight_68965e13.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_68965e13.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_68965e13.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_68965e13.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

animu_sight_68965e13.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_68965e13.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

dcl_120_68965e13.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_68965e13.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

reflector_scope_68965e13.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_68965e13.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

pso_1m2_scope_68965e13.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_68965e13.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_68965e13.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_68965e13.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

troy_flip_up_sight_68965e13.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_68965e13.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

barska_electro_68965e13.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_68965e13.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

mini_sight_68965e13.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_68965e13.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

susat_scope_68965e13.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_68965e13.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

pka_s_68965e13.name: PKA-S
pka_s_68965e13.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

kel_tec_sight_68965e13.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_68965e13.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

coyote_sight_68965e13.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_68965e13.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

diopter_sight_open_68965e13.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_68965e13.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

c79_68965e13.name: C79
c79_68965e13.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

kousaku_sight_68965e13.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_68965e13.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

peak01_sight_68965e13.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_68965e13.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

steyr_sight_68965e13.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_68965e13.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

eotech_xps2_68965e13.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_68965e13.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

eotech_vudu_1_10_68965e13.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_68965e13.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_68965e13.name: OKP-7
okp_7_68965e13.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_68965e13.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_68965e13.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_68965e13.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_68965e13.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

oeg_68965e13.name: OEG
oeg_68965e13.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

amt_terminator_68965e13.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_68965e13.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

mbus_gen_3_sight_68965e13.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_68965e13.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

pk_a_68965e13.name: PK-A
pk_a_68965e13.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

aac_flip_up_sight_68965e13.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_68965e13.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

h_k_sight_68965e13.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_68965e13.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_68965e13.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_68965e13.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_68965e13.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_68965e13.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_m40_68965e13.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_68965e13.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

delta_sight_68965e13.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_68965e13.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_68965e13.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_68965e13.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

tac_c_note_68965e13.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_68965e13.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

hensoldt_3x_sight_68965e13.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_68965e13.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

diopter_sight_68965e13.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_68965e13.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

socom_buis_sight_68965e13.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_68965e13.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_68965e13.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_68965e13.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_68965e13.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_68965e13.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_68965e13.name: MARS
mars_68965e13.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

iwi_sight_68965e13.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_68965e13.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_68965e13.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_68965e13.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

muzi_strike_3_5bc474c5.name: MUZI Strike-3
muzi_strike_3_5bc474c5.info:
Specially made 9x19mm shells loaded with three #1 buckshot pellets. Never made it past experimental stages... Until now.
If you're looking for a bullet hose, this is the ammo type for you.

muzi_45_acp_0c85a2af.name: MUZI 45 ACP
muzi_45_acp_0c85a2af.info: Convert your Micro Uzi into the civilian variant that fires .45 ACP in semi auto with stats to match the change.

full_stock_73748ce0.name: Full Stock
full_stock_73748ce0.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

r2_suppressor_4ef1d78d.name: R2 Suppressor
r2_suppressor_4ef1d78d.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

compensator_4ef1d78d.name: Compensator
compensator_4ef1d78d.info:
A compensating muzzle device.
40% less horizontal recoil variance
15% more vertical muzzle kick and variance
25% more muzzle climb
Slightly worse hipfire spread and stability.

muzzle_booster_4ef1d78d.name: Muzzle Booster
muzzle_booster_4ef1d78d.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

loudener_4ef1d78d.name: Loudener
loudener_4ef1d78d.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

flash_hider_4ef1d78d.name: Flash Hider
flash_hider_4ef1d78d.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

pbs_4_suppressor_4ef1d78d.name: PBS-4 Suppressor
pbs_4_suppressor_4ef1d78d.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

x_ring_4ef1d78d.name: X-Ring
x_ring_4ef1d78d.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

ars_suppressor_4ef1d78d.name: ARS Suppressor
ars_suppressor_4ef1d78d.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

osprey_suppressor_4ef1d78d.name: Osprey Suppressor
osprey_suppressor_4ef1d78d.info:
35 stud detection radius.

A light multi-caliber Western suppressor manufactured by SilencerCo for pistol caliber weaponry. Provides better hipfire accuracy, range, and exceptional masking, however aim accuracy is not affected.

muffler_4ef1d78d.name: Muffler
muffler_4ef1d78d.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and reduce RPM by 10%.

short_barrel_pistol_65cb8125.name: Short Barrel (PISTOL)
short_barrel_pistol_65cb8125.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

oil_filter_4ef1d78d.name: Oil Filter
oil_filter_4ef1d78d.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

muzzle_brake_4ef1d78d.name: Muzzle Brake
muzzle_brake_4ef1d78d.info:
A standard muzzle device which reduces vertical recoil climb by dispersing muzzle gases horizontally.

40% reduction in vertical kick
15% increase to vertical stability
15% less vertical rotational recoil
20% less muzzle climb

15% more horizontal recoil variance

suppressor_4ef1d78d.name: Suppressor
suppressor_4ef1d78d.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

halbek_device_4ef1d78d.name: Halbek Device
halbek_device_4ef1d78d.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

pbs_1_suppressor_4ef1d78d.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_4ef1d78d.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

t_brake_4ef1d78d.name: T-Brake
t_brake_4ef1d78d.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

aws_9mm_conversion_9161a5c3.name: AWS 9mm Conversion
aws_9mm_conversion_9161a5c3.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your AWS 1911 into 9x19mm.
A weaker but much more accurate round fired faster than you could imagine!
Comes in a 20 round magazine, and an extra spare mag!

blue_laser_df145561.name: Blue Laser
blue_laser_df145561.info:
A tactical blue laser designed to improve target acquisition speeds.

Improves aiming speed by 7%.

remove_stock_84983556.name: Remove Stock
remove_stock_84983556.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

laser_df145561.name: Laser
laser_df145561.info:
A red colored laser pointer.
Improves your gun transition speed when you start and stop sprinting.

green_laser_df145561.name: Green Laser
green_laser_df145561.info:
A large tactical green laser that helps improve gun stability.

20% less gun sway
7.5% better recoil recovery
3.5% slower equip speeds

yellow_laser_df145561.name: Yellow Laser
yellow_laser_df145561.info: A yellow-colored laser with a built-in IR illuminator. Improves weapon equip & unequip speeds, and slightly improves weapon sway.

flashlight_df145561.name: Flashlight
flashlight_df145561.info: A rugged, heavy-duty, high-powered flashlight that lights up dark environments. Don't leave home without one.

tri_laser_df145561.name: Tri Laser
tri_laser_df145561.info:
A triple laser pointer.
Improves hipfire damping and decreases your crosshair size & spread rate.

extended_magazine_77987654.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_77987654.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

ta01_acog_e8ea6e95.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_e8ea6e95.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_e8ea6e95.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_e8ea6e95.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

maglite_e8ea6e95.name: Maglite
maglite_e8ea6e95.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

mro_sight_e8ea6e95.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_e8ea6e95.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_e8ea6e95.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_e8ea6e95.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

hensoldt_3x_sight_d2ff9923.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_d2ff9923.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

eotech_552_e8ea6e95.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_e8ea6e95.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_e8ea6e95.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_e8ea6e95.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

dcl_120_e8ea6e95.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_e8ea6e95.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

barska_electro_e8ea6e95.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_e8ea6e95.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

pka_s_e8ea6e95.name: PKA-S
pka_s_e8ea6e95.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

ta44_acog_e8ea6e95.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_e8ea6e95.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

coyote_sight_e8ea6e95.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_e8ea6e95.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

c79_e8ea6e95.name: C79
c79_e8ea6e95.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

plague_insight_6df9c2ce.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_6df9c2ce.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_cdcf843b.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_cdcf843b.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

microdot_mini_e8ea6e95.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_e8ea6e95.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

amt_terminator_e8ea6e95.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_e8ea6e95.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

okp_7_e8ea6e95.name: OKP-7
okp_7_e8ea6e95.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

elfx_sight_e8ea6e95.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_e8ea6e95.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

kousaku_oled_sight_e8ea6e95.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_e8ea6e95.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_e8ea6e95.name: Z-Point
z_point_e8ea6e95.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_e8ea6e95.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_e8ea6e95.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

ddhb_reflex_e8ea6e95.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_e8ea6e95.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

pk_a_e8ea6e95.name: PK-A
pk_a_e8ea6e95.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

ta33_acog_e8ea6e95.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_e8ea6e95.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

kousaku_sight_e8ea6e95.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_e8ea6e95.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

eotech_xps2_e8ea6e95.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_e8ea6e95.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

acog_scope_e8ea6e95.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_e8ea6e95.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

delta_sight_cdcf843b.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_cdcf843b.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

kobra_ekp_sight_e8ea6e95.name: Kobra EKP Sight

barska_electro_4af79122.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

buis_sight_4af79122.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_4af79122.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

eotech_m40_4af79122.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_4af79122.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

pka_s_4af79122.name: PKA-S
pka_s_4af79122.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

iwi_sight_4af79122.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_4af79122.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

susat_scope_4af79122.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_4af79122.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

eotech_552_4af79122.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_4af79122.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

c79_4af79122.name: C79
c79_4af79122.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

animu_sight_4af79122.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_4af79122.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

peak01_sight_4af79122.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_4af79122.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

super_slim_sight_4af79122.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_4af79122.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

kel_tec_sight_4af79122.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_4af79122.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

eotech_vudu_1_10_4af79122.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_4af79122.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

mbus_gen_3_sight_4af79122.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_4af79122.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

kac_sight_4af79122.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_4af79122.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

oeg_4af79122.name: OEG
oeg_4af79122.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

carry_handle_sight_4af79122.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_4af79122.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_4af79122.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_4af79122.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

okp_7_4af79122.name: OKP-7
okp_7_4af79122.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

pk_a_4af79122.name: PK-A
pk_a_4af79122.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

kousaku_sight_4af79122.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_4af79122.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

eotech_xps2_4af79122.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_4af79122.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

swarovski_scope_4af79122.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_4af79122.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_4af79122.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_4af79122.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

fal_sight_4af79122.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_4af79122.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

delta_sight_4af79122.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_4af79122.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

aac_flip_up_sight_4af79122.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_4af79122.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

sako_backup_sight_4af79122.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_4af79122.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

reflex_sight_4af79122.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_4af79122.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

coyote_sight_4af79122.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_4af79122.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

socom_buis_sight_4af79122.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_4af79122.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_4af79122.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_4af79122.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_4af79122.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_4af79122.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_4af79122.name: MARS
mars_4af79122.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

kousaku_oled_sight_4af79122.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_4af79122.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

microdot_srs_4af79122.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_4af79122.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

short_barrel_ar_966db656.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_966db656.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

extended_magazine_a2bedcb0.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_a2bedcb0.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

beta_c_drum_mag_f69cad99.name: Beta C Drum Mag
beta_c_drum_mag_f69cad99.info:
A large 100 round Beta-C drum magazine!
Allows you to fire for a long time at the cost of walk walkspeed, your aim, sprint and equip transition speeds and increases reload time significantly!

rpk_75rd_drum_398e3cdc.name: RPK 75rd Drum
rpk_75rd_drum_398e3cdc.info: Replaces your 40rd magazine with a 75rd Drum Magazine! Significantly increases ammo capacity and reserve while also reducing vertical updrift thanks to the weight! Takes a while to reload and weighs down your firearm while also making horizontal recoil slightly less controllable!

ar_7_62x39_conversion_133abad5.name: AR 7.62x39 Conversion
ar_7_62x39_conversion_133abad5.info: A high-precision rifle round designed to give the AR-15 platform performance somewhat comparable to 7.62x51mm, but with around half of the recoil impulse. The larger bullet is still able to load into the AR-15's magazines, but with a lower maximum capacity.

colt_lmg_25_45_conversion_055b5d48.name: Colt LMG 25-45 Conversion
colt_lmg_25_45_conversion_055b5d48.info:
Loads your LSV M/04 with .20 Tactical.
This uses the typical 30-round magazines! Increases overall bullet performance, rewards accuracy. Decreases reload time, but you'll be punished even more if shots are missed.

ta01_acog_337e3e3e.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_337e3e3e.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

pu_1_scope_337e3e3e.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_337e3e3e.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_be3bee34.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_be3bee34.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

malcolm_3x_scope_4acba69c.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_4acba69c.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

ff_3x_nv_337e3e3e.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_337e3e3e.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

ta44_acog_337e3e3e.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_337e3e3e.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_337e3e3e.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_337e3e3e.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_337e3e3e.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_337e3e3e.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

z_point_337e3e3e.name: Z-Point
z_point_337e3e3e.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

super_small_sight_be3bee34.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_be3bee34.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_be3bee34.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_be3bee34.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_337e3e3e.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_337e3e3e.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

acog_scope_337e3e3e.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_337e3e3e.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_337e3e3e.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_337e3e3e.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_337e3e3e.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_337e3e3e.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_337e3e3e.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_337e3e3e.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_337e3e3e.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_337e3e3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_337e3e3e.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_337e3e3e.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_be3bee34.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_be3bee34.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

m145_337e3e3e.name: M145
m145_337e3e3e.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

ta33_acog_337e3e3e.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_337e3e3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

vcog_8x_scope_337e3e3e.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_337e3e3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

elfx_sight_337e3e3e.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_337e3e3e.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

tango_msr_1_8x_337e3e3e.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_337e3e3e.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_337e3e3e.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_337e3e3e.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

ddhb_reflex_337e3e3e.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_337e3e3e.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

maglite_337e3e3e.name: Maglite
maglite_337e3e3e.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

microdot_mini_337e3e3e.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_337e3e3e.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

mro_sight_337e3e3e.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_337e3e3e.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

eotech_552_337e3e3e.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_337e3e3e.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

sro_sight_337e3e3e.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_337e3e3e.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_337e3e3e.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_337e3e3e.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

tac_c_note_337e3e3e.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_337e3e3e.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

dcl_120_337e3e3e.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_337e3e3e.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

pso_1m2_scope_337e3e3e.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_337e3e3e.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_337e3e3e.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_337e3e3e.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

vcog_6x_scope_337e3e3e.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_337e3e3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

hensoldt_3x_sight_337e3e3e.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.
