reflector_scope_337e3e3e.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

collapsible_stock_f6f1b93b.name: Collapsible Stock
collapsible_stock_f6f1b93b.info: Alternative lightweight stock with the ability to fold down or collapse. Lightens your weapon, but makes it slightly more front-heavy in the process - slightly increasing vertical gun rotation.

long_barrel_ar_7e66ba4b.name: Long Barrel (AR)
long_barrel_ar_7e66ba4b.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

special_alexandrite_1c66b5ba.name: Special Alexandrite
special_alexandrite_1c66b5ba.info: Uses special Alexandrite inside a .308 casing! This gem magically allows you to alter your gun performance, starting at its normal performance, then flip the switch to make it fire at half the fire rate but significantly improves recoil! Additionally, this gem also boosts your velocity significantly and the thinner nature allows you to carry 50 extra rounds in your box, but it is not so good at suppression!

topaz_hunter_47656f4c.name: Topaz Hunter
topaz_hunter_47656f4c.info: Uses an energetic Topaz inside a .308 casing! This gem turns your gun into a belt fed DMR, dealing very high damage especially to the torso and head capable of one shotting in the torso up close and a guaranteed kill in the head at any range! Can only carry half the magazine capacity due to the thicker round but this improves overall handling aswell!

amethyst_stream_1c66b5ba.name: Amethyst Stream
amethyst_stream_1c66b5ba.info: Uses pure Amethyst inside a .308 casing! Magically converts your gun into a 10 round burst rapid firing storm gun, but has a lengthy cooldown due to overheating! Comes with 2 extra boxes of ammo!

subsonic_ruby_47656f4c.name: Subsonic Ruby
subsonic_ruby_47656f4c.info: Uses the soft heavy Ruby inside a .308 casing! Due to the softer nature of this gem, your gun is now subsonic and allows it to fire insanely fast! Or can be switched to fire slower for better accuracy! Sound, suppression and radar detection are fully masked and close range damage is increased but at the cost of heavy reduction in velocity and ranged performance!

sapphire_edge_491e3468.name: Sapphire Edge
sapphire_edge_491e3468.info: Uses the sharp edges of Sapphire inside a .308 casing! Magically reduces reload time and even more if it's empty while also being semi good at penetration and never loses power over range! However it does deal less damage up close, lower velocity and requires a lower fire rate to fire safely!

onyx_shards_892589cd.name: Onyx Shards
onyx_shards_892589cd.info: Uses a large Onyx gem inside a .308 casing! This thick stone breaks off instantly into many shards once fired, these shards are very sharp and pierce through a lot of material dealing high damage! These Onyx bullets are so thick that it requires manual rechambering and limits your box ammo quantity to only 20!

rare_painite_47656f4c.name: Rare Painite
rare_painite_47656f4c.info: Uses very rare Painite inside a .308 casing! This special gem truly inflicts the PAIN on your enemy by improving weapon performance and damage significantly without any visible drawbacks! However, due to how rare this gem is: you have only been able to bring 1 box of it! So if you run out, the fun is over!

emerald_beam_350d4898.name: Emerald Beam
emerald_beam_350d4898.info: Uses small Emerald rocks inside a .308 casing! These fly and accelerate extremely fast and nullifies all recoil to the point your gun is now a hitscan! Alongside that, doubles your magazine capacity with infinite reserve and a faster reload! However these rocks deal very little damage but ramp up a little over range!

quartz_storm_1c66b5ba.name: Quartz Storm
quartz_storm_1c66b5ba.info: Uses brittle Quartz inside a .308 casing! Easily breaks off when fired, resulting in 3 pieces flying wild and falls straight down like a brick at range! Very deadly damage up close but falls off hard and is weak at range!

diamond_point_f0a6a2e0.name: Diamond Point
diamond_point_f0a6a2e0.info: Uses very sharp Diamond points inside a .308 casing! These are very powerful at penetrating deep into hard surfaces and dealing massive damage to the body and head but weak against limbs due to overpenetration and requires a lower fire rate to fire safely!

malcolm_3x_scope_68121b03.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_68121b03.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

sagittarius_40x_0b31b995.name: Sagittarius 40x
sagittarius_40x_0b31b995.info:
Press T to zoom out to 10x.
A very large scope designed by Vector Optics for law enforcement and tactical use, this optics very high zoom allows you to get uncompromised view on enemies. Or, switch to 10x magnification for closer engagements.

plague_insight_0b31b995.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_0b31b995.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

mg36_300_conversion_1f3f1951.name: MG36 .300 Conversion
mg36_300_conversion_1f3f1951.info: Load your IAR36 with .300 BLK. Better performance up close, but generally worse at longer ranges.

m249_chainsaw_kit_9dac084f.name: M249 Chainsaw Kit
m249_chainsaw_kit_9dac084f.info:
Special chainsaw kit for the M249 SAW, greatly improving hipfire control, recoil and stability but can make aimed fire more difficult! Also lowers aim walkspeed and handling!
Cannot be combined with grips!

short_barrel_ar_0bcecee6.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_0bcecee6.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

potato_grip_e12181b6.name: Potato Grip
potato_grip_e12181b6.info:
A bulbous foregrip with an integrated flashlight accessory that is surprisingly effective and won't slide away.
Not for consumption.

[GAIN]
-10% Camera body recoil.
+5% Aiming walkspeed.
+5% Aiming speed.
Lights up dark areas.

[LOSS]
Flashlight is visible to enemies.

romanian_grip_e12181b6.name: Romanian Grip
romanian_grip_e12181b6.info:
A sturdy tactical foregrip that improves gun stability and vertical camera recoil but has worse horizontal recoil control, handling and mobility while aiming.

[GAIN]
-20% Translation recoil.
-10% Vertical camera body (X) recoil.
-10% Vertical camera Body (X) recoil climb.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-20% Idle & Walk sway.
-25% Scope sway.

[LOSS]
+10% Horizontal camera body (Y) recoil.
-5% Walk speed while aiming.
-10% Aiming/Equipping/Sprinting transition speeds.

folding_grip_e12181b6.name: Folding Grip
folding_grip_e12181b6.info:
A lightweight grip with the ability to fold up when not in use. Not as great at reducing recoil as other sturdier grips.

Reduces horizontal recoil variance by 10%.
Improves horizontal stability by 30%
Slightly improves rotational and translational recoil by 10%
12.5% improved equip and unequip speed
10% more weapon sway when moving
5% worse handling

angled_grip_e12181b6.name: Angled Grip
angled_grip_e12181b6.info:
An angled foregrip that doubles as a handstop, providing an extremely sturdy grip position while being relatively low profile.

Reduces translational recoil by 30%
Improves horizontal rotational recoil by 10%
Reduces gun sway by 20%
5% faster aiming speeds
8% faster sprint transition speeds
Increases gun kick by 10%
Reduces aiming walkspeed by 10%
Reduces equip speeds by 5%

vertical_grip_e12181b6.name: Vertical Grip
vertical_grip_e12181b6.info:
A standard vertical foregrip that fights against climbing recoil while improving hipfire but has worse horizontal recoil control and handling.

[GAIN]
- -8% Rotation X recoil.
- -20% Camera Body X rising recoil.
- -20% Rotational X rising recoil.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-30% Walk sway.
+10% Sprint transition speeds.

[LOSS]
- +12% Camera Body horizontal (Y) recoil.
-5% aim/equip speed.

chainsaw_grip_6566af21.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_6566af21.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

stubby_grip_e12181b6.name: Stubby Grip
stubby_grip_e12181b6.info:
A low-profile vertical grip designed to provide modest recoil benefits with minimal handling loss.

15% better weapon sway
15% less muzzle climb and muzzle kick
8% less gun rotational recoil
20% less rearward gun kick
10% better hipfire stability
6% more horizontal gun shake
10% less aiming walkspeed
5% worse equip speed

handstop_e12181b6.name: Handstop
handstop_e12181b6.info:
A low-profile handstop to help you maintain a stable firing position.

Lowers rearward kick by 25%, reduces rearward kick variance by 55%
Slightly improves horizontal and vertical translational recoil and kick
Slightly increases vertical and horizontal variance
10% faster sprint speeds
15% faster aim time
3% better aiming walkspeed
10% lower weapon sway when aiming down sights or scoped in

hera_cqr_grip_e12181b6.name: Hera CQR Grip
hera_cqr_grip_e12181b6.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased weapon rotation and translation recoil.Decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased camera body X recoil.Slightly decreased camera body YZ recoil.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation look sway speed.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

pistol_grip_e12181b6.name: Pistol Grip
pistol_grip_e12181b6.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

skeleton_grip_e12181b6.name: Skeleton Grip
skeleton_grip_e12181b6.info:
A skeletonized pistol grip that provides ergonomic improvements, but does little to help your recoil management.

15% improved gun sway
10% faster aiming speeds
15% faster sprint transition time
10% faster equip & unequip speeds
10% slower walkspeed while aiming
Slightly improved vertical gun kick
Slightly worse horizontal recoil variance

m249_unfolded_bipod_8c772461.name: M249 Unfolded Bipod
m249_unfolded_bipod_8c772461.info:
EXPERIMENTAL! May be scrapped!

Unfolds the bipod from your gun allowing you to mount it on the ground while crouching, prone or near a valid spot! Cannot aim otherwise!
When aimed in, cannot move and slows down unaiming speed but greatly decreases gun kick and improves accuracy!

sideways_grip_e12181b6.name: Sideways Grip
sideways_grip_e12181b6.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Decreased hipfire spread.Decreased camera body YZ recoil and variance.Slightly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Slightly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.

[Loss]
Decreased aim walkspeed.Slightly increased weapon rotation recoil.Decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

m249_30rd_stanag_ab3a7554.name: M249 30rd STANAG
m249_30rd_stanag_ab3a7554.info:
Loads your M249 SAW with a standard 30rd STANAG magazine, sacrificing a lot of ammo for a lot more mobility, faster handling and shorter reload time!
Very large ammo pool, slight decrease in vertical kick at the cost of some left bias kick due to the uneven weight.
Movement and handling is still heavier than a standard assault rifle!

m249_200rd_box_d64a5d10.name: M249 200rd Box
m249_200rd_box_d64a5d10.info:
A large 200 round box for the M249 SAW, this should let you last for a long while!
Comes at a significant cost of movement speed, handling and reload time due to the weight!

m249_60rd_casket_aef207b7.name: M249 60rd Casket
m249_60rd_casket_aef207b7.info:
Loads your M249 SAW with a 60rd STANAG casket magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Large ammo reserve pool, slight decrease in vertical kick at the cost of some left bias kick due to the uneven weight and will take longer to reload when empty!

30rd_stanag_d089a8c8.name: 30rd STANAG
30rd_stanag_d089a8c8.info: Load your rifle with a shorter 30rd STANAG magazine. Less rounds carried with greater mobility. Slightly more recoil as a result of losing weight on the weapon.

hamr_9mm_conversion_93a1e9b4.name: HAMR 9mm Conversion
hamr_9mm_conversion_93a1e9b4.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your HAMR IAR into 9x19mm using a conversion kit by Big Woods MFG.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

hamr_6_8spc_conversion_9b5507e2.name: HAMR 6.8SPC Conversion
hamr_6_8spc_conversion_9b5507e2.info: Change the ammunition fired from your HAMR IAR to 6.8x43mm SPC. Improved damage output at the cost of recoil control.

mgv176_folded_86ec3c88.name: MGV176 Folded
mgv176_folded_86ec3c88.info: Folds your stock. Adds to your vertical and horizontal recoil by 30%.

canted_animu_sight_baddaddf.name: Canted Animu Sight
canted_animu_sight_baddaddf.info:
Adds an additional Anti at 45° on the sidelines supporting you in the heat of battle, ready to help when she's needed!

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_acog_scope_baddaddf.name: Canted Acog Scope
canted_acog_scope_baddaddf.info:
Adds an additional Acog scope at 45° for those moments you really just need a second scope.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_furro_sight_baddaddf.name: Canted Furro Sight
canted_furro_sight_baddaddf.info:
Adds awn addwitional fuwwwy at 45° on the sidewines suwppowting u in the heat of battwe, weady to hewp when he's needed! OwO

Pwess T to toggwe between optics and these sights.

canted_delta_sight_baddaddf.name: Canted Delta Sight
canted_delta_sight_baddaddf.info:
Adds an additional delta sight at 45° for fast and clean target acquisition in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

canted_iron_sight_baddaddf.name: Canted Iron Sight
canted_iron_sight_baddaddf.info:
Adds an additional set of iron sights at 45°, allowing users to quickly switch from a high powered optic to iron sights for favorable performance in close-range engagements.

Press T to toggle between your optics and these sights.

x_ring_61879a8d.name: X-Ring
x_ring_61879a8d.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

compensator_61879a8d.name: Compensator
compensator_61879a8d.info:
A compensating muzzle device.
40% less horizontal recoil variance
15% more vertical muzzle kick and variance
25% more muzzle climb
Slightly worse hipfire spread and stability.

muzzle_booster_d2e68140.name: Muzzle Booster
muzzle_booster_d2e68140.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

loudener_61879a8d.name: Loudener
loudener_61879a8d.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

muzzle_brake_61879a8d.name: Muzzle Brake
muzzle_brake_61879a8d.info:
A standard muzzle device which reduces vertical recoil climb by dispersing muzzle gases horizontally.

40% reduction in vertical kick
15% increase to vertical stability
15% less vertical rotational recoil
20% less muzzle climb

15% more horizontal recoil variance

halbek_device_61879a8d.name: Halbek Device
halbek_device_61879a8d.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

t_brake_61879a8d.name: T-Brake
t_brake_61879a8d.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

short_barrel_ar_5f9641bf.name: Short Barrel (AR)
short_barrel_ar_5f9641bf.info:
Shortened barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

rpk_16_60rd_47833354.name: RPK-16 60rd
rpk_16_60rd_47833354.info:
Loads your RPK-16 with a 60rd magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Larger ammo reserve pool, slightly increased handling and mobility speeds but also slightly increased recoil from the reduced weight.

minislugs_4632f571.name: Minislugs
minislugs_4632f571.info:
Changes your shot load to minislugs.
Short, stumpy 1¾ inch shotgun shells that aid in recoil control. Increases capacity if held in a tube by a few shells due to a shorter length. Not as high damage as full size slugs but travels a little faster with faster action and reloading.

minishell_4632f571.name: Minishell
minishell_4632f571.info:
Changes your shot load to minishells.
Short, stumpy 1¾ inch shotgun shells that aid in recoil control. Increases capacity if held in a tube by a few shells due to a shorter length. Poorer damage due to being filled with #1 buckshot. Tighter spread with faster action and reloading.

long_barrel_shotgun_fa81d3eb.name: Long Barrel (SHOTGUN)
long_barrel_shotgun_fa81d3eb.info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

usas_12_semi_conversion_450523f7.name: USAS-12 Semi Conversion
usas_12_semi_conversion_450523f7.info:
Change the internals of your USAS-12 to make it able to fire in semi-automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less firerate. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

anti_sight_131188dc.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_131188dc.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_131188dc.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_131188dc.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

mp7_sight_131188dc.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_131188dc.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_131188dc.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_131188dc.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_131188dc.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

quick_release_sight_131188dc.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_131188dc.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_131188dc.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_131188dc.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_131188dc.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_131188dc.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

izhmash_sight_131188dc.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_131188dc.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

super_small_sight_131188dc.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_131188dc.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_131188dc.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_131188dc.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

furro_sight_131188dc.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_131188dc.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

peak02_sight_131188dc.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_131188dc.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_131188dc.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

1200m_sight_131188dc.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

buis_sight_131188dc.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

double_open_sight_131188dc.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_131188dc.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_131188dc.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sako_backup_sight_131188dc.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_131188dc.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_131188dc.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_131188dc.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

animu_sight_131188dc.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_131188dc.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

troy_flip_up_sight_131188dc.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_131188dc.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

kel_tec_sight_131188dc.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_131188dc.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

diopter_sight_open_131188dc.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_131188dc.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

peak01_sight_131188dc.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_131188dc.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

steyr_sight_131188dc.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

kac_sight_131188dc.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_131188dc.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_131188dc.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

mbus_gen_3_sight_131188dc.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_131188dc.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

aac_flip_up_sight_131188dc.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

h_k_sight_131188dc.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

full_ring_sight_131188dc.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_131188dc.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

diopter_sight_131188dc.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_131188dc.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

socom_buis_sight_131188dc.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_131188dc.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

iwi_sight_131188dc.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_131188dc.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

extended_tube_4245367c.name: Extended Tube
extended_tube_4245367c.info: A longer magazine for tube-shotguns, increases magazine capacity with lower overall handling.

remove_stock_03a03211.name: Remove Stock
remove_stock_03a03211.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

remove_stock_14e37997.name: Remove Stock
remove_stock_14e37997.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

short_barrel_shotgun_20283126.name: Short Barrel (SHOTGUN)
short_barrel_shotgun_20283126.info:
A short, cut down barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

ithaca_trench_barrel_8affd88b.name: ITHACA Trench Barrel
ithaca_trench_barrel_8affd88b.info:
An old trench barrel for your M37.
Increases spread but allows you to slamfire faster than usual! (Press T)
Provided you don't use this to grate cheese, this makes sweeping the trenches all the easier!

ithaca_extended_tube_1ec0b70d.name: ITHACA Extended Tube
ithaca_extended_tube_1ec0b70d.info:
A longer tube for your M37 that holds more shells!
Can hold up to 7 shells at the cost of lower walk speed and slower handling! Also holds less shells in reserve!

mp7_sight_6f224d3e.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_6f224d3e.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_6f224d3e.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_6f224d3e.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_6f224d3e.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_6f224d3e.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_6f224d3e.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_6f224d3e.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

peak01_sight_6f224d3e.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_6f224d3e.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

fal_sight_6f224d3e.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_6f224d3e.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

mbus_gen_3_sight_6f224d3e.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_6f224d3e.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

socom_buis_sight_6f224d3e.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_6f224d3e.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

chainsaw_grip_6ae5dc23.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_6ae5dc23.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

cobray_bolo_round_ad74d6d0.name: COBRAY Bolo Round
cobray_bolo_round_ad74d6d0.info:
Changes your shot load to a bolo.
Two large lead pellets joined together by a metal cable with incredible penetration potentional designed to rip through bodies.
High damage at range with very low spread but lacks in damage up close!

shortened_barrel_5b88d632.name: Shortened Barrel
shortened_barrel_5b88d632.info:
A short, cut down barrel for your SAIGA-12.
Better aim speed and hipfire control, but a multitude of stats change to befit any caliber to use in your gun.

plague_insight_794c9c28.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_794c9c28.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

extended_tube_a0df53ee.name: Extended Tube
extended_tube_a0df53ee.info: A longer magazine for tube-shotguns, increases magazine capacity with lower overall handling.

short_barrel_shotgun_eb71eac4.name: Short Barrel (SHOTGUN)
short_barrel_shotgun_eb71eac4.info:
A short, cut down barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

traditional_pump_99044915.name: Traditional Pump
traditional_pump_99044915.info: Swap your shorty's regular foregrip with a more traditional pump, decreases spread in exchange for a slower fire rate!

gs_slam_fire_63eb5909.name: GS Slam Fire
gs_slam_fire_63eb5909.info: Allows your Golden Shorty to slam fire at a fast rate by holding down the firing button at the cost of larger spread!

plague_insight_d51be6e9.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_d51be6e9.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

e_shotgun_ccs_3f91ff41.name: e Shotgun CCS
e_shotgun_ccs_3f91ff41.info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for crowd control scenarios.
Weapon is locked to automatic fire with adjusted performance.

ksg_25_extension_492b076f.name: KSG 25 Extension
ksg_25_extension_492b076f.info:
Lengthened barrel and tube(s) specially designed to make the KSG 25.
Works like a mix of extended tube and the longer barrel.
May impede speed, including aim, reload, and movement...

aa_12_semi_conversion_4e4a1618.name: AA-12 Semi Conversion
aa_12_semi_conversion_4e4a1618.info:
Change the internals of your AA-12 to make it able to fire in semi automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less rpm. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

long_barrel_shotgun_91654f23.name: Long Barrel (SHOTGUN)
long_barrel_shotgun_91654f23.info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

20rd_drum_d1a7a15a.name: 20rd Drum
20rd_drum_d1a7a15a.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 20 rounds. Slightly reduces spare rounds carried, slightly slower reload speed.

ta01_acog_4fe9eeee.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_4fe9eeee.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_4fe9eeee.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_4fe9eeee.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_4fe9eeee.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

pu_1_scope_4fe9eeee.name: PU-1 Scope
pu_1_scope_4fe9eeee.info: The PU-1 Scope is a vintage Zarovian medium power optic used primarily during WWII. It has a fixed magnification and remains popular even after the war, with a simple post-and-bar reticle.

mp7_sight_4fe9eeee.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

hand_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_4fe9eeee.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

eotech_552_4fe9eeee.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_4fe9eeee.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_4fe9eeee.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

ff_3x_nv_4fe9eeee.name: FF 3x NV
ff_3x_nv_4fe9eeee.info:
Who needs light where your going... 👀.
Firefield 3x42 Gen.1 night vision scope modified to allow for adjustable zoom levels. Press T to enter the lower zoom mode.

herstal_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_4fe9eeee.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_4fe9eeee.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_4fe9eeee.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_5d59a9eb.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_5d59a9eb.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_4fe9eeee.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_4fe9eeee.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_4fe9eeee.name: Z-Point
z_point_4fe9eeee.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_4fe9eeee.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_4fe9eeee.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

super_small_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_4fe9eeee.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_4fe9eeee.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

pso_1_scope_4fe9eeee.name: PSO-1 Scope
pso_1_scope_4fe9eeee.info: The PSO-1 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) -  is a fixed power telescopic sight originally designed for the Dragunov SVD, proving to be popular with Zarovian sharpshooters.

furro_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_4fe9eeee.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_4fe9eeee.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_4fe9eeee.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_4fe9eeee.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_4fe9eeee.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

global_offensive_scope_4fe9eeee.name: Global Offensive Scope
global_offensive_scope_4fe9eeee.info:
Expertly crafted 10x scope made for elite special operations organizations. Requires slow movement to stay precise.
Press T to use the alternate aim style.

Model by Rialag

peak02_sight_4fe9eeee.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_4fe9eeee.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

backup_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_4fe9eeee.name: M145
m145_4fe9eeee.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_4fe9eeee.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

vcog_8x_scope_4fe9eeee.name: Vcog 8x Scope
vcog_8x_scope_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

ta33_acog_4fe9eeee.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

tango_msr_1_8x_4fe9eeee.name: Tango MSR 1-8x
tango_msr_1_8x_4fe9eeee.info: A 1-6x LPVO optic commonly used on the M7 NGSW.

handmade_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Handmade Sight
handmade_sight_4fe9eeee.info:
The best optic in the game. Nothing can compare to this cardboard mounted sight made in your garage. 
(Disclaminer: Not actually the best sight in the game.)

elfx_sight_4fe9eeee.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

maglite_4fe9eeee.name: Maglite
maglite_4fe9eeee.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

ddhb_reflex_4fe9eeee.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_4fe9eeee.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

buis_sight_4fe9eeee.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

microdot_mini_4fe9eeee.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_4fe9eeee.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

mro_sight_4fe9eeee.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_4fe9eeee.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

kalashnikov_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

sro_sight_4fe9eeee.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_4fe9eeee.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_4fe9eeee.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

animu_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

sako_backup_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Sako Backup Sight
sako_backup_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Alternate iron sights found on the TRG-42. Similar in design to the more common MBUS, but with a surprising amount of zoom thanks to the hidden binoculars you're using while looking through the sights.

mbus_sight_4fe9eeee.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_4fe9eeee.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

reflector_scope_4fe9eeee.name: Reflector Scope
reflector_scope_4fe9eeee.info: The optical bulky scope used on the GERAT 90 experimental rifle. If used on any other firearm besides the GERAT 90 it is a modified version to fit on rails.

dcl_120_4fe9eeee.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_4fe9eeee.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

troy_flip_up_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Troy Flip Up Sight
troy_flip_up_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A set of flip-up iron sights adjustable for windage and elevation. Does not come with a horse-shaped siege engine.

pso_1m2_scope_4fe9eeee.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_4fe9eeee.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

electra_5x_4fe9eeee.name: Electra 5x
electra_5x_4fe9eeee.info:
1-3x cross reticle sight with integrated picatinny rails to mount an extra laser accessory for faster than average optic sight acquisition.
Model by Makosushi.

mini_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_4fe9eeee.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

barska_electro_4fe9eeee.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_4fe9eeee.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

susat_scope_4fe9eeee.name: SUSAT Scope
susat_scope_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The Sight Unit Small Arms, Trilux, or SUSAT, is a 4× telescopic sight, with tritium-powered illumination utilised at dusk or dawn. It also features a back-up iron sight.

kel_tec_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_4fe9eeee.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

pka_s_4fe9eeee.name: PKA-S
pka_s_4fe9eeee.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

diopter_sight_open_4fe9eeee.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_4fe9eeee.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

coyote_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

kousaku_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

c79_4fe9eeee.name: C79
c79_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

steyr_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

peak01_sight_4fe9eeee.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_4fe9eeee.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

eotech_xps2_4fe9eeee.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_4fe9eeee.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

oeg_4fe9eeee.name: OEG
oeg_4fe9eeee.info:
''A long time ago, in a galaxy not far away at all'' The OEG comes from the 1970's That said it's quite a bit different in use from the modern sight. 
both eyes have to remain open to use this sight making it somewhat unique in use.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_vudu_1_10_4fe9eeee.name: EOTech Vudu 1-10
eotech_vudu_1_10_4fe9eeee.info: A FFP (First Focal Plane) LPVO designed with every weapon in mind. Features a large speed ring reticle at 1x and detailed zoom-in reticle at 10x. Great target acquisition with easy to read reticles for close and medium ranged applications.

okp_7_4fe9eeee.name: OKP-7
okp_7_4fe9eeee.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_4fe9eeee.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

fal_sight_4fe9eeee.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_4fe9eeee.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

carry_handle_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Carry Handle Sight
carry_handle_sight_4fe9eeee.info: The rail-mounted version of the carry handle sight found on the M16 family of weapons.

amt_terminator_4fe9eeee.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_4fe9eeee.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

mbus_gen_3_sight_4fe9eeee.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_4fe9eeee.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

pk_a_4fe9eeee.name: PK-A
pk_a_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

aac_flip_up_sight_4fe9eeee.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

h_k_sight_4fe9eeee.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

swarovski_scope_4fe9eeee.name: Swarovski Scope
swarovski_scope_4fe9eeee.info: CQC version of the scope mounted on the UAR rifle family.

hensoldt_z24_4fe9eeee.name: Hensoldt Z24
hensoldt_z24_4fe9eeee.info:
Eisenmark's engineering brings you this stellar optic. 4x zoom with no breath mechanics with a familiar looking reticle.
Model by Makosushi.

eotech_m40_4fe9eeee.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_4fe9eeee.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

delta_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_4fe9eeee.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

tac_c_note_4fe9eeee.name: Tac C Note
tac_c_note_4fe9eeee.info:
A premium one-piece iron sight rapid targeting solution. Use this because you have a $100 bill to throw at something that does not have batteries. A perfect hammering block in emergencies should you take this off with its quick detach system.

Model submitted by Rialag.

hensoldt_3x_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_4fe9eeee.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

diopter_sight_4fe9eeee.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_4fe9eeee.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

socom_buis_sight_4fe9eeee.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_4fe9eeee.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

pro_3_9x_scope_4fe9eeee.name: PRO 3-9x Scope
pro_3_9x_scope_4fe9eeee.info:
A 9x zoom day optic with an integral quick-release mount typically found on the Jinhanian QBU-88. It does not possess an illuminated crosshair.

It was replaced in service by the 6-24x44 tactical scope in the mid-2000s.

pilad_3_4fe9eeee.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_4fe9eeee.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_4fe9eeee.name: MARS
mars_4fe9eeee.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

iwi_sight_4fe9eeee.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_4fe9eeee.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_4fe9eeee.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_4fe9eeee.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

remove_stock_7e8bd900.name: Remove Stock
remove_stock_7e8bd900.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

full_stock_5c943427.name: Full Stock
full_stock_5c943427.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

long_barrel_shotgun_3279369c.name: Long Barrel (SHOTGUN)
long_barrel_shotgun_3279369c.info:
Longer barrel best suited for longer range, perfect for sporting purposes.
Better range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

barrikada_cd8eeda6.name: Barrikada
barrikada_cd8eeda6.info: Changes your shot load to Barrikada. Known as 'Barricade' in English, fire a large solid steel projectile much like a slug with the capabilities of destroying a cars engine block at up to 100 meters. Increased projectile speed with high damage to the head at range. Incredible penetration potential.

ks_harpoon_2133dcda.name: KS HARPOON
ks_harpoon_2133dcda.info:
Muzzle load a harpoon into your KS-23M.
 Ignoring the lack of the rope typically attached, this uses an overpressured blank shell to propel the harpoon way over yonder!

volna_r_2d218080.name: Volna-R
volna_r_2d218080.info: Changes your shot load to Volna-R. Known as 'Wave' in English, fire a single large rubber slug used for less than lethal purposes. But less than lethal is still lethal, and a large 23mm rubber ball is about to prove that with incredibly high damage to the body and limbs, but the actual rubber slug itself travels slowly.

ks_4g_b34eefd8.name: KS 4G
ks_4g_b34eefd8.info:
An incredibly large shotgun shell typically used for shooting waterfowl or big game in long range. Typically sold in the civilian market. Almost guaranteed to take multiple targets in a single shot!
Contains a large wide-spread amount of pellets with higher penetration with reduced damage, but powerful enough to annihilate anything in your path!
Takes extra time and care to rechamber!

shrapnel_25_4eb7acff.name: Shrapnel-25
shrapnel_25_4eb7acff.info: Changes your shot load to Shrapnel-25. Saboted 23mm shells designed to keep the buckshot close to the center of the barrel making shots at range much easier to hit consistently. Reduces spread dramatically but lowers individual pellet damage.

short_barrel_shotgun_5e550ceb.name: Short Barrel (SHOTGUN)
short_barrel_shotgun_5e550ceb.info:
A short, cut down barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

dbv_30_06_conversion_0876c702.name: DBV 30-06 Conversion
dbv_30_06_conversion_0876c702.info:
A 30-06 conversion kit for the AK-12/76, with a rifled barrel and bolt capable of handling the new round. A popular sporting cartridge, the 30-06 round packs a powerful punch at all ranges.

Very high damage with a below average rate of fire.

dbv_410_conversion_7b21678c.name: DBV .410 Conversion
dbv_410_conversion_7b21678c.info:
A conversion kit for the .410 shotgun round using a modified trigger group designed to fire in two-round bursts.

Reduced pellet count, but with increased damage per pellet, magazine capacity, and overall rate of fire.

lengthened_barrel_3279369c.name: Lengthened Barrel
lengthened_barrel_3279369c.info:
Extended barrel for your SAIGA-12.
Better range and bullet speed, but a multitude of stats change to befit any caliber to use in your gun. Worse movement.

shortened_barrel_3279369c.name: Shortened Barrel
shortened_barrel_3279369c.info:
A short, cut down barrel for your SAIGA-12.
Better aim speed and hipfire control, but a multitude of stats change to befit any caliber to use in your gun.

s_12_full_auto_conversion_fa240e58.name: S-12 Full-Auto Conversion
s_12_full_auto_conversion_fa240e58.info:
Change the internals of your Saiga-12 to make it able to fire in full automatic!
Extremely fast fire rate but hard to control!
Loses out on accuracy and damage range.

s_12_50_conversion_d0274092.name: S-12 50 Conversion
s_12_50_conversion_d0274092.info:
Load your Saiga-12 with .50 BMG.
 Adjusted performance fitting for th- wait why are you doing this? Like, I get you changed the barrel and everything but... Either way, eat your heart out, AK Guy!

dt_olympian_stock_4d51d801.name: DT Olympian Stock
dt_olympian_stock_4d51d801.info: Adjustable stock found on the DT11 PRO. It will certainly cushion the recoil but you will not lose out on mobility. However aiming is slower.

dt_sporting_stock_24fdf44e.name: DT Sporting Stock
dt_sporting_stock_24fdf44e.info: A sturdy stock found on the DT11 ACS. It will certainly aid in recoil control for any situation, but the weight may become a hinderance for movement.

sawed_off_barrel_a5b27c97.name: Sawed Off Barrel
sawed_off_barrel_a5b27c97.info:
A super short sawed-off barrel for your DT11 shotgun.
Further improves close range performance, reloads are a breeze but spread is massively increased.

suppressor_dt11_3279369c.name: Suppressor (DT11)
suppressor_dt11_3279369c.info: Integral Suppressor for your competition shotgun. Preserves range and damage and the weight reduces felt weapon recoil. With small velocity, spread and weight penalties.

combat_barrel_dt11_65b67c9b.name: Combat Barrel (DT11)
combat_barrel_dt11_65b67c9b.info: A medium length barrel perfect for just about any engagement in normal circumstances. Improves close range performance slightly, speeds reload time and increases spread.

000_buckshot_f3b01cf3.name: #000 Buckshot
000_buckshot_f3b01cf3.info:
Changes your shot load to #000 buckshot, one the largest diameter pellets commercially available, perfect for hunting and for self defence.
Large pellets dealing high damage to enemies, with greater spread and penetration but lower pellet velocity.

bolo_round_e5040b86.name: Bolo Round
bolo_round_e5040b86.info:
Changes your shot load to a bolo.
Two large lead pellets joined together by a metal cable with incredible penetration potentional designed to rip through bodies.
High damage at range with very low spread but lacks in damage up close!

3_shell_73211d48.name: 3½ Shell
3_shell_73211d48.info:
Changes your shot load to 3½ inch buckshot shells.
8 pellets of #00 buckshot in a 3½ inch super-duper magnum shell packed to the brim with as much powder as you could possibly want.
Increases velocity making hitting targets in range easier. Yes, it's actually called a super-duper magnum.

dt_siege_sight_ff8e815c.name: DT Siege Sight
dt_siege_sight_ff8e815c.info: The perfect sight for takin' down them no good dirty scoundrels held up in that thar' darn house!

dt11_target_sight_01fda203.name: DT11 Target Sight
dt11_target_sight_01fda203.info: An elevated sight typically used for target shootin'.

m14_6_5_f932d2a1.name: M14 6.5
m14_6_5_f932d2a1.info:
Loads your M14 with 6.5mm Creedmoor.
This cartridge offers your M14 more assault rifle characteristics such as lower damage, alongside a 30 round magazine. Slight improvements to penetration, velocity and recoil.

scar_h_10rd_eca4d10f.name: SCAR-H 10rd
scar_h_10rd_eca4d10f.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the MK17 SOCOM, ammo conservation will be harder in exchange for better reload time and some weight improvements.

scar_h_7_62_conversion_687af356.name: SCAR-H 7.62 Conversion
scar_h_7_62_conversion_687af356.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MK17 SOCOM into 6.5 Creedmoor.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

drum_magazine_06dc9f56.name: Drum Magazine
drum_magazine_06dc9f56.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold many more rounds. This heavy magazine greatly reduces spare rounds carried, slows reload and handling speed, and slows your walkspeed, but at least you'll feel like a mobster.

plague_insight_c612479f.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_c612479f.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

chainsaw_grip_905b92ee.name: Chainsaw Grip
chainsaw_grip_905b92ee.info:
[Experimental Concept]

[Gain]
Greatly decreased hipfire and aiming walksway.Greatly decreased weapon rotation look sway.Greatly decreased hipfire spreadDecreased weapon rotation recoilDecreased camera body recoil

[Loss]
Increased weapon translation recoilGreatly decreased aim walkspeed.Greatly decreased aim, sprint, and equip transition speeds.

henry_big_boy_conversion_5c8c20c6.name: Henry Big Boy Conversion
henry_big_boy_conversion_5c8c20c6.info:
Load your Henry 45-70 with .357 Magnum, making it the Henry Big Boy.
Bring back nostalgia of an era you were not even born in.

henry_30_30_conversion_b40276e1.name: Henry 30-30 Conversion
henry_30_30_conversion_b40276e1.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 30-30, firing .30-30 Winchester.
Holds an extra round of ammunition with more accuracy, but less performance in some areas. Faster action.

henry_410_conversion_970855e8.name: Henry 410 Conversion
henry_410_conversion_970855e8.info:
Converts your Henry 45-70 into the Henry 410, firing .410 bore.
Immense power in close range and good accuracy, but faulters strongly at range.

plus_p_d2641c1e.name: Plus P
plus_p_d2641c1e.info:
Overpacked with powder, these rounds aim to make your bullets fly faster, penetrate surfaces better, and increase suppression.
Harder to control.

malcolm_3x_scope_92747964.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_92747964.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

sidewinder_ed_6b6934ca.name: SIDEWINDER ED
sidewinder_ed_6b6934ca.info: The Sidewinder ED is the optic found on the HECATE II. It is an optic developed by Hawkes Optics and, hence it's name includes a signuature sidewinder on the side of the optic.

shak_12_heavy_suppressor_56fe78f5.name: SHAK-12 Heavy Suppressor
shak_12_heavy_suppressor_56fe78f5.info: A heavyweight suppressor for the ShAK-12 which provides excellent masking & sound suppression as well as improved recoil at the cost of handling.

shak_12_light_suppressor_744a99df.name: SHAK-12 Light Suppressor
shak_12_light_suppressor_744a99df.info: A lightweight suppressor designed for the ShAK-12. Reduces sound signature and slightly reduces gun performance. Poor masking range.

shak_12_7x55mm_lp_7950125e.name: SHAK 12.7x55mm LP
shak_12_7x55mm_lp_7950125e.info: Swaps your ammunition to 12.7x55mm LP supersonic ammo: a lightweight bullet that increases your muzzle velocity significantly while reducing damage. Comes with a 20-round extended magazine for more traditional battle rifle performance.

shak_12_7x55mm_dp_225979b1.name: SHAK 12.7x55mm DP
shak_12_7x55mm_dp_225979b1.info: Swaps your ammunition load to a duplex bullet! Fires two smaller, weaker projectiles that hit hard up close, but lose out on damage and accuracy at range.

shak_12_7x55mm_bp_75670011.name: SHAK 12.7x55mm BP
shak_12_7x55mm_bp_75670011.info: Load your ShAK-12 with 12.7x55mm BP armor piercing rounds: giving it significantly increased penetration and performance to the torso, but reduced performance to the head.

falo_50_41_drum_80e44672.name: FALO 50.41 Drum
falo_50_41_drum_80e44672.info: 50rd X-FAL drum magazine! Gives you the true FAL LMG experience by giving you 50 rounds of ammo! But reloads slow and will lower your walkspeed and handling.

fal_50_reduced_magazine_896bcb24.name: FAL 50 Reduced Magazine
fal_50_reduced_magazine_896bcb24.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the FAL, ammo conservation will be even harder but you will get rid of the very harsh downside of the FAL's reload time and some weight improvements.

mp7_sight_3ae904a4.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_3ae904a4.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

malcolm_3x_scope_a2316250.name: Malcolm 3x Scope
malcolm_3x_scope_a2316250.info: Take to the life of a cowboy like a horse takes to oats with this classic scope design. Short version of the Malcolm scope design.

plague_insight_95158286.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_95158286.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.

super_small_sight_3ae904a4.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_3ae904a4.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_3ae904a4.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_3ae904a4.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_3ae904a4.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_3ae904a4.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

mro_sight_3ae904a4.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_3ae904a4.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_3ae904a4.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_3ae904a4.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

peak01_sight_3ae904a4.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_3ae904a4.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_3ae904a4.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_3ae904a4.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_3ae904a4.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_3ae904a4.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

socom_buis_sight_3ae904a4.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_3ae904a4.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

elfx_sight_3ae904a4.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_3ae904a4.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

ft300_wood_furniture_19f4ee69.name: FT300 Wood Furniture
ft300_wood_furniture_19f4ee69.info:
Replaces the standard furniture of your weapon stock for something a bit more classic.
This wood furniture improves a variety of aspects of your weapon to allow it to be best suited for long range engagements.

retract_stock_6b8e84eb.name: Retract Stock
retract_stock_6b8e84eb.info:
Fold in the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

collapsible_stock_6b8e84eb.name: Collapsible Stock
collapsible_stock_6b8e84eb.info: Alternative lightweight stock with the ability to fold down or collapse. Lightens your weapon, but makes it slightly more front-heavy in the process - slightly increasing vertical gun rotation.

g3_45_acp_conversion_978404a8.name: G3 .45 ACP Conversion
g3_45_acp_conversion_978404a8.info:
Convert your STG-59H into .45 Super.
Changing the weapon to feed from Thompson magazines this conversion can also function with the CETME Model 58 due to it and the STG-59H's similarities. Feels like using a full size battle rifle, but in a PDW-type package.

slx_suppressor_aa391dc3.name: SLX Suppressor
slx_suppressor_aa391dc3.info:
20 stud detection radius.

The standard military suppressor for the M7.
Slightly increases damage ranges, bullet speed and lowers muzzle flip and muzzle climb at the cost of a bit more vertical camera recoil and slightly slower handling!

long_barrel_ar_7067a18b.name: Long Barrel (AR)
long_barrel_ar_7067a18b.info:
Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Better Range and bullet speed, but worse close range performance and aim speed. Worse movement.

223_remington_e2755579.name: .223 Remington
223_remington_e2755579.info: A 'reduced range' round for 6.8x51mm. Reduces overall weapon performance in order to improve recoil.

mcx_spear_7_62x51_52f9565d.name: MCX Spear 7.62x51
mcx_spear_7_62x51_52f9565d.info: Converts your M7 NGSW into the civilian model with a semi-auto only trigger group, firing 7.62x51mm NATO!

mcx_spear_6_5_creedmoor_a8300b99.name: MCX Spear 6.5 Creedmoor
mcx_spear_6_5_creedmoor_a8300b99.info: Converts your weapon to fire 6.5mm Creedmoor. Uses a 25rd magazine and improves recoil but lowers overall damage and penetration performance!

ak_308_gen_4_stock_2f7e4804.info:

Improved recoil management, but slightly increase aim and sprint transition times.

pistol_grip_6b8473c7.name: Pistol Grip
pistol_grip_6b8473c7.info:
A grip typically used for your trigger hand now mounted to the front of your gun!

20% less vertical rotational recoil.
8% less gun kick
10% less muzzle climb
15% less gun sway
10% better hipfire stability
10% worse handling and aiming walkspeed
12% more horizontal camera recoil

hera_cqr_grip_3520d04e.info:
[Experimental Concept]
