plague_insight_0d017bc6.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_0d017bc6.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

boombox_semi_group_4e87250d.name: BOOMBOX Semi Group
boombox_semi_group_4e87250d.info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your Doombox to be semi-automatic only!
Raises headshot & torso damage but reduces fire rate allowing you to play it like a subsonic DMR!

q_pork_chop_d3ff7200.name: Q Pork Chop
q_pork_chop_d3ff7200.info:
0 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor designed for large .30-cal magnum calibers. Deadly quiet. Improves damage ranges. Do not eat.

boombox_sd_suppressor_a17abf43.name: BOOMBOX SD Suppressor
boombox_sd_suppressor_a17abf43.info:
0 stud detection radius.

Uses a cut-off handguard with an integral suppressor.
Excellent radar & sound masking while mildly lowering weapon sway and recoil but slightly reduces handling speeds.
No effects on bullet speed, mobility or damage ranges!

reduced_magazine_549196ea.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_549196ea.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

reduced_magazine_8cf583c8.name: Reduced Magazine
reduced_magazine_8cf583c8.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

hcar_open_bolt_4d7c74f4.name: HCAR Open bolt
hcar_open_bolt_4d7c74f4.info: Converts your HCAR to be fully automatic but gives up the ability to shoot semi-automatic.

retract_stock_e7aac71c.name: Retract Stock
retract_stock_e7aac71c.info:
Fold in the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

full_stock_665a2432.name: Full Stock
full_stock_665a2432.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

rm277_8_6blk_conversion_9f2c61d6.name: RM277 8.6BLK Conversion
rm277_8_6blk_conversion_9f2c61d6.info:
Converts your RM 277 to fire the subsonic 8.6mm Blackout cartridge!
This quieter cartridge fully hides you from the radar while increasing your ranged damage!
Very low bullet speed with weaker damage up close while also reducing penetration and firerate somewhat.

rm277_7_62x51_conversion_3f892b69.name: RM277 7.62x51 Conversion
rm277_7_62x51_conversion_3f892b69.info:
Converts your RM 277 to fire 7.62x51mm NATO, a more traditional cartridge with a more traditional damage profile.

High damage with a simplified damage profile but decreases fire rate and muzzle velocity and increases recoil.

ecr_410_2b307f9b.name: ECR 410
ecr_410_2b307f9b.info: Convert your ECR to fire .410 bore, housing a 15 round magazine and strong firepower. Doesn't do well at range and struggles with maneuverability.

ecr_458_conversion_00ada721.name: ECR .458 Conversion
ecr_458_conversion_00ada721.info:
Loads your ECR with .458 SOCOM.
Lower damage, but significantly improved recoil and magazine capacity.

ecr_5_56_conversion_a0310c5a.name: ECR 5.56 Conversion
ecr_5_56_conversion_a0310c5a.info:
The most common ammo type found in the warzone. Why you're putting it in a rifle designed for 12.7x42mm is beyond mortal understanding.
Expect unforeseen consequences...

mp7_sight_a7831ea1.name: MP7 Sight
mp7_sight_a7831ea1.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing... Or so you thought.

super_small_sight_a7831ea1.name: Super Small Sight
super_small_sight_a7831ea1.info: A slim flip-down aperture iron sight found on the OTs-126.

mbus_pro_sight_a7831ea1.name: MBUS Pro Sight
mbus_pro_sight_a7831ea1.info: An advanced MBUS sight combining modern sight features such as toolless windage and elevation adjustment with a slim, low-profile footprint that is optimized for use on the M4A1/AR-15 platform.

peak02_sight_a7831ea1.name: PEAK02 Sight
peak02_sight_a7831ea1.info: 1.1x zoom. A lightweight, low-profile BUIS designed to be used in co-witness with taller optics. Unfortunately, you left your optic at home today.

peak01_sight_a7831ea1.name: PEAK01 Sight
peak01_sight_a7831ea1.info: 1.25x zoom. The PEAK01 BUIS is designed for use with the AR-15 platform, providing a modular base that replicates the feel of the M4A1's integrated front post & carry handle.

mbus_gen_3_sight_a7831ea1.name: MBUS Gen 3 Sight
mbus_gen_3_sight_a7831ea1.info: The third generation MBUS backup iron sights.

fal_sight_a7831ea1.name: FAL Sight
fal_sight_a7831ea1.info: 1.5x zoom. A rail-mounted version of the modified FAL iron sights found on the IMBEL IA2 rifles, and standard on the IA2 SMG.

socom_buis_sight_a7831ea1.name: SOCOM BUIS Sight
socom_buis_sight_a7831ea1.info: 1.2x zoom. The SOCOM backup iron sights are the rear sights found as a part of the SOCOM gen.1 kit, designed to work with the standard AR-15 gas block front post. Slim, efficient, simple.

romanian_grip_6b8473c7.name: Romanian Grip
romanian_grip_6b8473c7.info:
A sturdy tactical foregrip that improves gun stability and vertical camera recoil but has worse horizontal recoil control, handling and mobility while aiming.

[GAIN]
-20% Translation recoil.
-10% Vertical camera body (X) recoil.
-10% Vertical camera Body (X) recoil climb.
-10% Hipfire spread.
-20% Idle & Walk sway.
-25% Scope sway.

[LOSS]
+10% Horizontal camera body (Y) recoil.
-5% Walk speed while aiming.
-10% Aiming/Equipping/Sprinting transition speeds.

plague_insight_80593da6.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_80593da6.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

scar_h_6_8_spc_conversion_7dad3f08.name: SCAR-H 6.8 SPC Conversion
scar_h_6_8_spc_conversion_7dad3f08.info:
Converts your MK17 SOCOM to fire 6.8x43mm SPC using a MK16 lower receiver!
It was experimented by the Grand Federation back around 2011 with limited examples.
Offers above-average assault rifle performance with a standard 30rd magazine capacity and similar fire rate to the MK16 SOCOM!

fast_mag_2f6ad684.name: Fast Mag
fast_mag_2f6ad684.info: Swaps the gun's magazines to ones designed for speedier reloads, especially on empty. They typically use pull grips that make them easier to remove from pouches, but possess a slightly more awkward profile. Sprint transitions speeds are slightly worse.

scar_h_7_62_conversion_4c0dfb08.name: SCAR-H 7.62 Conversion
scar_h_7_62_conversion_4c0dfb08.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your MK17 SOCOM into 6.5 Creedmoor.
Adjusted performance befitting of the caliber it is firing.

scar_h_10rd_0b05d146.name: SCAR-H 10rd
scar_h_10rd_0b05d146.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the MK17 SOCOM, ammo conservation will be harder in exchange for better reload time and some weight improvements.

ta01_acog_70607fd1.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_70607fd1.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

vcog_6x_scope_70607fd1.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_70607fd1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

anti_sight_70607fd1.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_70607fd1.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_70607fd1.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_70607fd1.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

hand_sight_70607fd1.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_70607fd1.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_70607fd1.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_70607fd1.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

eotech_552_70607fd1.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_70607fd1.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

reflex_sight_70607fd1.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_70607fd1.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_70607fd1.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_70607fd1.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_48655448.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_48655448.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_70607fd1.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_70607fd1.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_70607fd1.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_70607fd1.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_7b921f94.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_7b921f94.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_a6cd635c.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_a6cd635c.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_70607fd1.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_70607fd1.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_70607fd1.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_70607fd1.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_70607fd1.name: Z-Point
z_point_70607fd1.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_70607fd1.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_70607fd1.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

ta33_acog_70607fd1.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_70607fd1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

furro_sight_70607fd1.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_70607fd1.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_70607fd1.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_70607fd1.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_70607fd1.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_70607fd1.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_70607fd1.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_70607fd1.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_70607fd1.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_70607fd1.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_70607fd1.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_70607fd1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

backup_sight_70607fd1.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_70607fd1.name: M145
m145_70607fd1.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_70607fd1.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

maglite_70607fd1.name: Maglite
maglite_70607fd1.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

mro_sight_70607fd1.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_70607fd1.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_70607fd1.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_70607fd1.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

hensoldt_3x_sight_c57ad659.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_c57ad659.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

double_open_sight_70607fd1.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_70607fd1.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_70607fd1.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mbus_sight_70607fd1.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_70607fd1.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

dcl_120_70607fd1.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_70607fd1.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

barska_electro_70607fd1.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_70607fd1.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

pka_s_70607fd1.name: PKA-S
pka_s_70607fd1.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

coyote_sight_70607fd1.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_70607fd1.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

c79_70607fd1.name: C79
c79_70607fd1.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

aac_flip_up_sight_70607fd1.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

steyr_sight_70607fd1.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

elfx_sight_70607fd1.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_70607fd1.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

okp_7_70607fd1.name: OKP-7
okp_7_70607fd1.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_70607fd1.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

ddhb_reflex_70607fd1.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_70607fd1.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

pk_a_70607fd1.name: PK-A
pk_a_70607fd1.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

amt_terminator_70607fd1.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_70607fd1.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

iwi_sight_70607fd1.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_70607fd1.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

eotech_xps2_70607fd1.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_70607fd1.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

animu_sight_70607fd1.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_70607fd1.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

h_k_sight_70607fd1.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

kousaku_sight_70607fd1.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_70607fd1.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

kel_tec_sight_70607fd1.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_70607fd1.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

diopter_sight_70607fd1.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

delta_sight_a6cd635c.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_a6cd635c.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_48655448.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_48655448.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

eotech_m40_70607fd1.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_70607fd1.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

microdot_mini_70607fd1.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_70607fd1.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

uh_gen1_70607fd1.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_70607fd1.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

mini_sight_a6cd635c.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_a6cd635c.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

buis_sight_70607fd1.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_70607fd1.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

pilad_3_70607fd1.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_70607fd1.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

mars_70607fd1.name: MARS
mars_70607fd1.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

diopter_sight_open_70607fd1.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_70607fd1.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

microdot_srs_70607fd1.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_70607fd1.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

ars_suppressor_b46e126e.name: ARS Suppressor
ars_suppressor_b46e126e.info:
A heavy suppressor improves range and reduces rotational recoil significantly due to its weight. Lowers mobility and handling due to its bulk.

Unfortunately this provides no effective sound suppression due being attached to a revolver.

pbs_1_suppressor_b46e126e.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_b46e126e.info:
A suppressor with compensated brake ports that provides has a significant improvement on recoil. Reduces handling and mobility due to its bulk.

Unfortunately this provides no effective sound suppression due being attached to a revolver.

r2_suppressor_b46e126e.name: R2 Suppressor
r2_suppressor_b46e126e.info:
A light suppressor that provides a minor reduction to recoil with minimal impact to handling.

Unfortunately this provides no effective sound suppression due being attached to a revolver.

pbs_4_suppressor_b46e126e.name: PBS-4 Suppressor
pbs_4_suppressor_b46e126e.info:
A medium suppressor that povides a small benefit to recoil while increasing range performance slightly.

Unfortunately this provides no effective sound suppression due being attached to a revolver.

long_barrel_rev_76ffc45f.name: Long Barrel (Rev)
long_barrel_rev_76ffc45f.info: Longer barrel design made for revolvers. Better range and accuracy. Worse handling and equip speed. Yee-haw...

suppressor_b46e126e.name: Suppressor
suppressor_b46e126e.info:
A general purpose balanced duty suppressor. It provides well-rounded recoil reductions with a trade-off in mobility and handling speeds.

Unfortunately this provides no effective sound suppression due being attached to a revolver.

snubnose_barrel_4913b7eb.name: Snubnose Barrel
snubnose_barrel_4913b7eb.info: Shorter barrel design made for revolvers that makes it easier to pull from a holster. Hurts bullet velocity and range.

integral_suppressor_goldhawk_ddf86012.name: Integral Suppressor (GOLDHAWK)
integral_suppressor_goldhawk_ddf86012.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the .300 BLK SCAR SC and intended for police usage.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walk speed and handling!

kac_stock_7e904ebf.name: KAC Stock
kac_stock_7e904ebf.info:
The R SQUARED stock taken off and placed onto the RH-44.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

long_barrel_rev_b0abf5c9.name: Long Barrel (Rev)
long_barrel_rev_b0abf5c9.info: Longer barrel design made for revolvers. Better range and accuracy. Worse handling and equip speed. Yee-haw...

44_special_fdeb11cc.name: .44 Special
44_special_fdeb11cc.info:
Specialty ammo made for the .44 magnum caliber with the intent of more controllable power.
Less recoil results in greater accuracy, however poorer ranges in exchange for retaining damage.

redhawk_45_colt_09129641.name: Redhawk 45 Colt
redhawk_45_colt_09129641.info: Convert your Redhawk 44 into a Redhawk 45, making it fire the 45 colt cartridge in single action! It will become much stronger in close range, but be slower and hampered at longer ranges.

1858_long_barrel_754faabd.name: 1858 Long Barrel
1858_long_barrel_754faabd.info: Long barrel designed specifically for the 1858 line of revolvers. Increases range and bullet velocity but with worse handling.

snubnose_barrel_58e2bf4c.name: Snubnose Barrel
snubnose_barrel_58e2bf4c.info: Shorter barrel design made for revolvers that makes it easier to pull from a holster. Hurts bullet velocity and range.

1858_snake_shot_9b17598f.name: 1858 Snake Shot
1858_snake_shot_9b17598f.info: Changes your shot load into a special purpose pellet-loaded 357 magnum round. Six almost buckshot sized pellets that are great for putting pesky soldier vermin.

36_caliber_na_0d402bcd.name: .36 Caliber NA
36_caliber_na_0d402bcd.info:
A conversion for 1858 model revolvers.
A smaller caliber meaning it will not deal as great of damage, but has faster firerate and velocity.

taurus_barrel_judge_ae3ffcca.name: Taurus Barrel (Judge)
taurus_barrel_judge_ae3ffcca.info:
The Taurus carbine kit barrel placed onto your revolver.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

judge_slugs_1830d2f6.name: Judge Slugs
judge_slugs_1830d2f6.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

birdshot_a29fbeef.name: Birdshot
birdshot_a29fbeef.info:
Changes your shot load to birdshot: a large quantity of small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse -- but significantly less great at dealing with modern body armor.

Significantly reduced penetration and performance when hitting the torso, but significantly more pellets.

taurus_stock_9d9c51b8.name: Taurus Stock
taurus_stock_9d9c51b8.info:
The Taurus carbine kit stock placed onto your revovler.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

rsh_9_conversion_086fac7b.name: RSH-9 Conversion
rsh_9_conversion_086fac7b.info:
A conversion for the RSH-12.
Trades off the stopping power of 12.7x55mm for the slightly better ballistics of 9x39mm SP, along with less recoil!
Changes the gun's name to the RSH-9!

rsh_12_gauge_6c791878.name: RSH 12 Gauge
rsh_12_gauge_6c791878.info: Loads your revolver in 28 Gauge shells effectively turning it into a full on shotgun revolver!

long_barrel_rev_a132270e.name: Long Barrel (Rev)
long_barrel_rev_a132270e.info: Longer barrel design made for revolvers. Better range and accuracy. Worse handling and equip speed. Yee-haw...

snubnose_barrel_6cdd3a70.name: Snubnose Barrel
snubnose_barrel_6cdd3a70.info: Shorter barrel design made for revolvers that makes it easier to pull from a holster. Hurts bullet velocity and range.

mateba_6_454_casull_93736f5f.name: Mateba 6 .454 Casull
mateba_6_454_casull_93736f5f.info: Chambers your Mateba Autorevolver in .454 Casull - giving it a massive increase in stopping power up close at the cost of having a lower rate of fire, increased recoil, and slightly worse handling.

speedloader_0836ded6.name: Speedloader
speedloader_0836ded6.info: A lightweight piece of kit that is perfect for making reloading revolvers a breeze. When you use all of your rounds in the cylinder, you can reload at a faster rate! However it comes at the cost of a slower reload when theres unspent rounds in the cylinder.

pso_1m2_scope_ba8a7f7f.name: PSO-1M2 Scope
pso_1m2_scope_ba8a7f7f.info: The PSO-1M2 - Pritsel Snaipersky Optichesky (Optical Sniper Sight) - is a modernized iteration of the PSO-1, which was originally designed for the SVD Dragunov.

short_barrel_rex_747b7972.name: Short Barrel REX
short_barrel_rex_747b7972.info: Reduce your barrel length to give yourself the legendary MP412 REX. Despite never reaching sales, it has seen the faces of battlefields across the world. You'll never be in bad company with this by your side!

longest_rex_998b295d.name: Longest REX
longest_rex_998b295d.info: Sometimes, all you need is a really long barrel. Sadly, y'ain't a ranger, but you do got this on your hip! Reduced muzzle flip with massively increased range so you can clear leather long before your opponent ever can.

integral_rex_4844caec.name: Integral REX
integral_rex_4844caec.info: A custom built Monarch barrel for the MP412. Tight tolerances and a near non-existent cylinder gap allows it to be fully suppressed. Dominate the competition and show everyone who is king. Decent masking range at the cost of a significantly reduced velocity.

snubnose_barrel_cadd0d56.name: Snubnose Barrel
snubnose_barrel_cadd0d56.info: Less is more when it comes to being snubby. Usually reserved for the Noir side of things, but it will certainly help when your stakeout goes south. Significantly reduced muzzle velocity.

long_barrel_rev_70004cd2.name: Long Barrel (Rev)
long_barrel_rev_70004cd2.info: Yee-Haw! Get yourself a horse-rider's barrel and start shootin'! Increased muzzle velocity means you can down that honcho on the far side of the town before he can get you!

rex_stock_8679834a.name: Rex Stock
rex_stock_8679834a.info: Custom built stock for the MP412. Based on the average pistol stock, it allows for greater stability while firing. For some reason this is considered a big no-no for some folks, however you are in an active warzone so that doesn't matter.

speedloader_70dbe998.name: Speedloader
speedloader_70dbe998.info: A lightweight piece of kit that is perfect for making reloading revolvers a breeze. When you use all of your rounds in the cylinder, you can reload at a faster rate! However it comes at the cost of a slower reload when theres unspent rounds in the cylinder.

taurus_barrel_cf8dd1e6.name: Taurus Barrel
taurus_barrel_cf8dd1e6.info:
The Taurus carbine kit barrel placed onto your revovler.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

extended_magazine_78d46fc3.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_78d46fc3.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

five_seven_full_auto_7ad709fd.name: Five-Seven Full Auto
five_seven_full_auto_7ad709fd.info: An aftermarket modification turning the gun into a full-auto machine gun - at the cost of rapidly dumping the contents of the magazine after pulling the trigger.

glock_switch_3032b966.name: Glock Switch
glock_switch_3032b966.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

integral_u416_08fafe72.name: Integral U416
integral_u416_08fafe72.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the U-527/22.

Improves performance at close range at the cost of ranged performance and velocity. Excellent masking.

u416_binary_d26529e1.name: U416 Binary
u416_binary_d26529e1.info:
Modify your U-527/22 to fit it with a binary trigger group.
A binary trigger fires one round when you hold down the trigger, but also fires again when you let go!
Increases fire rate but reduces headshot damage.

mini_sight_75f696ae.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_75f696ae.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

deltapoint_sight_75f696ae.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_75f696ae.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

barska_electro_a5f073f6.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_a5f073f6.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

coyote_sight_a5f073f6.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_a5f073f6.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

delta_sight_75f696ae.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_75f696ae.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

ddhb_reflex_a5f073f6.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_a5f073f6.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

long_barrel_sniper_f2aa55aa.name: Long Barrel (SNIPER)
long_barrel_sniper_f2aa55aa.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close overall handling and movement.

shoulder_stock_924e2999.name: Shoulder Stock
shoulder_stock_924e2999.info:
A pistol stock that helps to brace against recoil and maintain a more stable firing position.

Reduces muzzle flip and gun sway significantly, but overall worse handling.

target_weight_2bd3ceb3.name: Target Weight
target_weight_2bd3ceb3.info: Attach a weight to the front of the GSP's barrel to counter against the rising recoil for better accuracy, but at the cost of general maneuverability.

gsp_32_s_w_096fbd20.name: GSP 32 S&W
gsp_32_s_w_096fbd20.info: Convert your GSP into the GSP-C, firing the .32 S&W Long round. It is perfect for those who can't seem to land headshots.

gsp_rat_shot_d67ca3c0.name: GSP Rat Shot
gsp_rat_shot_d67ca3c0.info: Aiming? You don't need to do that. Just spitball tiny, almost harmless pellets at people until they ask you to stop. It cannot even properly cycle rounds, forcing you to manually cycle the bullets each shot.

10_round_gsh_18_77f54c59.name: 10 Round GSH-18
10_round_gsh_18_77f54c59.info: Swap your magazine for a reduced 10 round capacity magazine! Improves reload speed and handling!

45_rubber_gsh_18_be920f05.name: .45 RUBBER GSH-18
45_rubber_gsh_18_be920f05.info:
Loads your GSH-18 with .45 Rubber!
Increased damage overall and will always one shot to the head, but extremely poor penetrating power, suppression and velocity!
Requires manual rechambering!

short_barrel_shotgun_e010c4b0.name: Short Barrel (SHOTGUN)
short_barrel_shotgun_e010c4b0.info:
A short, cut down barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Better aim speed and hipfire control but worse range and bullet speed. Better movement.

gb_50_ae_conversion_77f54c59.name: GB .50 AE Conversion
gb_50_ae_conversion_77f54c59.info:
Load your GB-22 with .50 AE.
 This makes it a GB-50. The larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried.

gb_12g_conversion_a1e239d6.name: GB 12G Conversion
gb_12g_conversion_a1e239d6.info:
Somehow load your GB-22 with 12 gauge minishells.
 This makes it a GB-12.
More pellets for greater damage, but horrid muzzle velcoity and less ammunition carried.

gb_10mm_conversion_88a5403e.name: GB 10mm Conversion
gb_10mm_conversion_88a5403e.info:
Load your GB-22 with 10mm Auto.
 This makes it a GB-10, the larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried. Great velocity.

short_barrel_pistol_fd89a948.name: Short Barrel (PISTOL)
short_barrel_pistol_fd89a948.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

30rd_mag_g40_ea38bff6.name: 30rd Mag G40
30rd_mag_g40_ea38bff6.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G40. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

glock_stock_e6488bd0.name: Glock Stock
glock_stock_e6488bd0.info: An Eretz-Kedem stock for the G-series pistols. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

glock_switch_97f4ffcd.name: Glock Switch
glock_switch_97f4ffcd.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

long_barrel_pistol_8e41b644.name: Long Barrel (PISTOL)
long_barrel_pistol_8e41b644.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

26rd_mag_9c62a16a.name: 26rd Mag
26rd_mag_9c62a16a.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G21. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

glock_switch_3770bc1e.name: Glock Switch
glock_switch_3770bc1e.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

m45a1_dart_conversion_efe27276.name: M45A1 Dart Conversion
m45a1_dart_conversion_efe27276.info: Change the ammunition fired from your M45A1 into a single dart. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.

extended_magazine_33e0091d.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_33e0091d.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

olympian_target_sight_4cac05a9.name: Olympian Target Sight
olympian_target_sight_4cac05a9.info: A targeting sight made specifically for the FT300. It technically isn't a scope, it's more like a zoomed in iron sight!

9mm_major_fa1ec96e.name: 9mm Major
9mm_major_fa1ec96e.info:
An extremely high-pressure variant of 9x19mm used in competition shooting.

Higher recoil, velocity, and ranges.

long_barrel_pistol_0762a4d2.name: Long Barrel (PISTOL)
long_barrel_pistol_0762a4d2.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

22rd_mag_a4ac6e8a.name: 22rd Mag
22rd_mag_a4ac6e8a.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G23. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

tec_9_long_barrel_9d134a1b.name: Tec-9 Long Barrel
tec_9_long_barrel_9d134a1b.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

mini_sight_d621631e.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_d621631e.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

half_ring_sight_4dedee99.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_4dedee99.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

deltapoint_sight_d621631e.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_d621631e.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

barska_electro_357687b0.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_357687b0.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

coyote_sight_357687b0.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_357687b0.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

delta_sight_d621631e.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_d621631e.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_4dedee99.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_4dedee99.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

ddhb_reflex_357687b0.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_357687b0.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

extended_barrel_6df3e26c.name: Extended Barrel
extended_barrel_6df3e26c.info: Extends the barrel length, providing greater damage over range at the cost of handling.

deagle_44_357_0836ded6.name: Deagle 44 357
deagle_44_357_0836ded6.info:
Load your Desert Eagle L5 with .357 Magnum.
This ammunition makes your weapon more easier to control in exchange for less damage, but you gain better accuracy and reload speed.

automag_50_ae_conversion_88156568.name: AutoMag .50 AE Conversion
automag_50_ae_conversion_88156568.info:
Load your AutoMag with .50 Action Express.
This makes your AutoMag III into the .50 caliber AutoMag V using a 5-round magazine. Featuring stopping power similar to other .50 caliber handguns.

automag_45_winmag_conversion_0dc35471.name: AutoMag .45 WinMag Conversion
automag_45_winmag_conversion_0dc35471.info:
Load your AutoMag with .45 Winchester Magnum.
This makes your AutoMag III into the .45 caliber AutoMag IV. A more traditionally performing handgun cartridge with a lot of power still by comparison.

oil_filter_34d849af.name: Oil Filter
oil_filter_34d849af.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

ars_suppressor_34d849af.name: ARS Suppressor
ars_suppressor_34d849af.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

suppressor_34d849af.name: Suppressor
suppressor_34d849af.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

r2_suppressor_34d849af.name: R2 Suppressor
r2_suppressor_34d849af.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

halbek_device_34d849af.name: Halbek Device
halbek_device_34d849af.info: A device designed to mitigate recoil on the FAL platform, but for some reason it functionally 'inverts' recoil here! The halbek device causes your gun to recoil in a downwards manner to reduce muzzle climb. However its performance heavily depends on the gun.

muffler_34d849af.name: Muffler
muffler_34d849af.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and reduce RPM by 10%.

compensator_34d849af.name: Compensator
compensator_34d849af.info:
A compensating muzzle device.
40% less horizontal recoil variance
15% more vertical muzzle kick and variance
25% more muzzle climb
Slightly worse hipfire spread and stability.

muzzle_booster_34d849af.name: Muzzle Booster
muzzle_booster_34d849af.info:
8% RPM increase.
Increases the rate of fire by increasing recoil forces, but that also makes the recoil higher in general. Reduced suppression.

long_barrel_sniper_d8022489.name: Long Barrel (SNIPER)
long_barrel_sniper_d8022489.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close overall handling and movement.

loudener_34d849af.name: Loudener
loudener_34d849af.info: You may have originally believed this was used for Hollywood movies, NOPE! The loudener as its name suggests makes your gun LOUDER and makes the muzzle blast more concussive! Not just that, but it also increases your SUPPRESSION and reduces vertical recoil and muzzle velocity.

pbs_1_suppressor_34d849af.name: PBS-1 Suppressor
pbs_1_suppressor_34d849af.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

muzzle_brake_34d849af.name: Muzzle Brake
muzzle_brake_34d849af.info:
A standard muzzle device which reduces vertical recoil climb by dispersing muzzle gases horizontally.

40% reduction in vertical kick
15% increase to vertical stability
15% less vertical rotational recoil
20% less muzzle climb

15% more horizontal recoil variance

flash_hider_34d849af.name: Flash Hider
flash_hider_34d849af.info:
Eliminates the muzzle flash from unburnt propellants while firing by cooling and dispersing burning gases that exit the muzzle.

Improves visual recoil by 20%, hides the gun's flash, and provides a modest 60 stud minimap masking range.
Your minimap marker also fades 40% faster.
Very slightly improves hipfire stability.

pbs_4_suppressor_34d849af.name: PBS-4 Suppressor
pbs_4_suppressor_34d849af.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

x_ring_34d849af.name: X-Ring
x_ring_34d849af.info:
Unlike other muzzle attachments, this unusual device improves rotational recoil and gun displacement. Slightly higher felt camera recoil and a little less effective with hipfire.
Not very effective at blowing up moon-sized battlestations.

t_brake_34d849af.name: T-Brake
t_brake_34d849af.info: While not as effective as the compensator or muzzle brake at reducing specific recoil patterns, the T-brake reduces both vertical and horizontal camera recoil. This heavier brake also slightly reduces aiming speeds by 3% and increases your radar signature, making your radar blips last 50% longer.

osprey_suppressor_e0f2cdfb.name: Osprey Suppressor
osprey_suppressor_e0f2cdfb.info:
35 stud detection radius.

A light multi-caliber Western suppressor manufactured by SilencerCo for pistol caliber weaponry. Provides better hipfire accuracy, range, and exceptional masking, however aim accuracy is not affected.

spring_mod_aed021f5.name: Spring Mod
spring_mod_aed021f5.info: A spring modification that somehow miraculously doesn't jam every 2 shots, may have some unexpected side effects though.

zip_stock_8d6799e7.name: ZIP Stock
zip_stock_8d6799e7.info: Specially made stock for the ZIP 22. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

ta01_acog_02fcc3ab.name: TA01 Acog
ta01_acog_02fcc3ab.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The TA01 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. It features clean, sturdy backup iron sights on top of the traditional ACOG package.

diopter_sight_open_02fcc3ab.name: Diopter Sight Open
diopter_sight_open_02fcc3ab.info: Open iron sights found on the STG-59H family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted to have an open rear sight or to be a peep sight.

anti_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Anti Sight
anti_sight_02fcc3ab.info: The personal sight used by Anti, the war neko! Nya!!

h_k_export_sight_02fcc3ab.name: H&K Export Sight
h_k_export_sight_02fcc3ab.info: 1.2x zoom. Iron sights found on the civilian export versions of the AR36 series of weapons.

hand_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Hand Sight
hand_sight_02fcc3ab.info:
The hands that crafted the handmade sight made in plastic placed upon your gun to offer truly an unforgettable optic.
Protip: Aim for the very tip of the thumb.

super_slim_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Super Slim Sight
super_slim_sight_02fcc3ab.info: A slim iron sight designed for use with the C79 optic on the C7 & C8 rifles.

mini_sight_77d412b4.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_77d412b4.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

reflex_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Reflex Sight
reflex_sight_02fcc3ab.info: The Reflex is Trijicon's premiere illuminated sight that offers shooters the perfect combination of speed and precision under virtually any lighting conditions.

quick_release_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Quick-Release Sight
quick_release_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on the M416 family of weapons. The rear sight on this weapon features an adjustable flip sight as the rear iron sight, however good luck folding the front sight like the M416 or M417 can.

herstal_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Herstal Sight
herstal_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on the Grand Federation MK16 family of weapons designed by a well-known Belvaunian arms manufacturer. They are your standard flip sights which can be removed from the weapon if needed.

half_ring_sight_b601c060.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_b601c060.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

dual_aperture_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Dual Aperture Sight
dual_aperture_sight_02fcc3ab.info: 1.1x zoom. Dual-aperture flip-up irons with a unique diamond profile.

ta44_acog_02fcc3ab.name: TA44 Acog
ta44_acog_02fcc3ab.info: The TA44 ACOG is the one of the shortest of the ACOG family, but don't let that make you think it is the weakest. This thing has attitude and should never be underestimated.

plague_insight_2837aa64.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_2837aa64.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

deltapoint_sight_77d412b4.name: DeltaPoint Sight
deltapoint_sight_77d412b4.info: A modern compact handgun red dot for lightning quick sight acquisition. An improved larger viewing window over its predecessor while still maintaining incredible durability.

izhmash_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Izhmash Sight
izhmash_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Irons found on the AK12 family of weapons. These sights take a lot of what made the AK family of rifles sights great, but with a slightly more modern twist.

kousaku_oled_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Kousaku OLED Sight
kousaku_oled_sight_02fcc3ab.info: An OLED display built into a reflex sight that mimicks the function of iron sights, made by Kousaku Japan. Thank you Tetsugawa :)

z_point_02fcc3ab.name: Z-Point
z_point_02fcc3ab.info: An optic made by the legendary Zeiss AG, this tough reflex sight is designed for hunters who need lightning fast target acquisition and excellent precision.

macro_p_1_02fcc3ab.name: MACRO P-1
macro_p_1_02fcc3ab.info: The smallest professional grade enclosed system on the market. Made with precision in mind. Low zoom and a small dot.

ta33_acog_02fcc3ab.name: TA33 Acog
ta33_acog_02fcc3ab.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA33 ACOG is the logical evolution of the traditional ACOG. It provides an ample amount of magnification for law enforcement and military applications where precision is key.

furro_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Furro Sight
furro_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Youw pewsonaw fuwwy giving hew wove to suppowt you in combat. OwO

acog_scope_02fcc3ab.name: Acog Scope
acog_scope_02fcc3ab.info: The Trijicon Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight is a fixed power telescopic scope originally designed for the M16 and M4. It is the only choice for marksman shooters who accept no compromises.

kobra_ekp_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Kobra EKP Sight
kobra_ekp_sight_02fcc3ab.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens, this time with a sun cap!

comp_aimpoint_02fcc3ab.name: Comp Aimpoint
comp_aimpoint_02fcc3ab.info:
The Aimpoint CompM4 is a passive red dot collimator reflex sight which offers superior situational awareness by providing an uncluttered field of view.

Has slightly improved weapon sway compared to other low-power optics, but the bulk makes handling slightly worse.

kobra_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Kobra Sight
kobra_sight_02fcc3ab.info: A traditional Zarovian red dot combat optic using advanced laser-generated HUD technology to superimpose a reticle onto a filtered lens.

ta11_acog_02fcc3ab.name: TA11 Acog
ta11_acog_02fcc3ab.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The TA11 ACOG is a variant of the traditional ACOG. Marketed towards competiton shooters, the TA11 features a unique circular reticle.

backup_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Backup Sight
backup_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on the P90.

m145_02fcc3ab.name: M145
m145_02fcc3ab.info: The M145 Machine Gun Optic is a variant of the C79. It combines ELCAN's legendary robustness and optical expertise with a ballistically calibrated and LED-illuminated ranging reticle.

1200m_sight_02fcc3ab.name: 1200M Sight
1200m_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights from the JG-90, these irons are unique in terms of their magnification due to the windage setting they are at. Making it great for longer range usage. Strangely, the JG-90 never had these sights and only came standard with a scope.

maglite_02fcc3ab.name: Maglite
maglite_02fcc3ab.info: The future is bright, this 'optic' is a typical Maglite brand flashlight clapped to the top of your firearm. You must be a madman, not a blind madman though.

mro_sight_02fcc3ab.name: MRO Sight
mro_sight_02fcc3ab.info: The VRO is a miniature rifle sight designed to provide fast target acquisition while maintaining situational awareness.

sro_sight_02fcc3ab.name: SRO Sight
sro_sight_02fcc3ab.info: A small reflex sight designed primarily for pistols but, well, who said you had to use it on a pistol?

uh_gen1_02fcc3ab.name: UH Gen1
uh_gen1_02fcc3ab.info: A next generation sight that offers an incredibly fast holographic display to conquer every close-quarters situation.

double_open_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Double Open Sight
double_open_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Double aperture open circle ironsights. Purely custom design made by some rando in a workshop.

kalashnikov_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Kalashnikov Sight
kalashnikov_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on the AK family of weapons. These sights have been modified to fit onto picatinny rails and do not feature the ladder style sights of the AKs.

mbus_sight_02fcc3ab.name: MBUS Sight
mbus_sight_02fcc3ab.info: The MBUS is a low cost folding back up sight. Being able to adjust for windage and is tailor made to AR-15 platform weapons.

dcl_120_02fcc3ab.name: DCL 120
dcl_120_02fcc3ab.info:
Heavy duty optic designed primarily for use on .50 heavy machine guns by G.R.D. High performance with no magnification with a huge sight window. 
This optic's size and weight will be a benifit to recoil control (-5% max rot. recoil), but a hindrance to aim speed (-15%) / equip speed. (-25%)

barska_electro_02fcc3ab.name: Barska Electro
barska_electro_02fcc3ab.info: The Electro is Barska's entry into the world of compact red dot sights. It features a powerful diode to create an easy-to-see reticle on a panoramic screen.

pka_s_02fcc3ab.name: PKA-S
pka_s_02fcc3ab.info: A descendant of the PKS-01, this is an advanced Zarovian battery-powered red dot collimator sight. It is suitable for mid to close range engagements, with a clear and open sight picture.

coyote_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Coyote Sight
coyote_sight_02fcc3ab.info: A small Jinhanian pale red dot sight for quick target acquisition and pinpoint accuracy.

c79_02fcc3ab.name: C79
c79_02fcc3ab.info:
Press T to use backup irons.

The C79 is a standard Cascadian telescopic scope that delivers top-notch optical clarity and light gathering ability, allowing it to significantly improve hit probability at longer ranges.

aac_flip_up_sight_02fcc3ab.name: AAC Flip Up Sight
aac_flip_up_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on the Honey Badger. These sights are non obscructive and are able to be flipped up and down. But you won't be able to do a lot of that.

steyr_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Steyr Sight
steyr_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on UAR family weapons. These sights are smaller than the rest of the irons available and is most commonly seen with the UAR A3 PARA.

eotech_xps2_02fcc3ab.name: EOTech XPS2
eotech_xps2_02fcc3ab.info: The EXPS3 is a battle-tested holographic sight. Robust, proven, and durable. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

mars_02fcc3ab.name: MARS
mars_02fcc3ab.info: The Multi-Purpose Aiming Reflex Sight is a battery powered Eretz-Kedem red dot optic. It's made for accurate high performance sighting in tactical situations.

okp_7_02fcc3ab.name: OKP-7
okp_7_02fcc3ab.info: The OKP-7 is a Zarovian battery-powered collimating optic. Its most striking feature is the "floating" lens for improved sight clarity. It uses a laser-generated reticle, much like the Kobra.

kac_sight_02fcc3ab.name: KAC Sight
kac_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on most SOCOM-issued loadouts. These sights are found on main infantry rifles found in the Grand Federation Army for example and are designed to be fit atop a rifles handguard.

pilad_3_02fcc3ab.name: Pilad 3
pilad_3_02fcc3ab.info: The Pilad 3 uses a traditional light tube to project a dot onto a lens. It is a simple and small red dot sight, boiled down to the absolute basics for a hunter.

amt_terminator_02fcc3ab.name: AMT-Terminator
amt_terminator_02fcc3ab.info: The future holds many surprises, this 'optic'. Taken from a crazy android this sight is a giant laser fitted on top of your firearm. Maybe you can aim easier with it..?

vcog_6x_scope_02fcc3ab.name: Vcog 6x Scope
vcog_6x_scope_02fcc3ab.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The Trijicon Variable Combat Optical Gunsight is a mil-spec scope built to accomodate for both CQB and long-ranged marksmanship, matching Trijicon's legendary build quality with tough construction.

pk_a_02fcc3ab.name: PK-A
pk_a_02fcc3ab.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

The PK-A is a sturdy battery-powered Zarovian red dot tube optic, perfectly suited for high density urban suppression situations and picking up fast moving targets.

eotech_552_02fcc3ab.name: EOTech 552
eotech_552_02fcc3ab.info: The Model 558 Holographic sight is the model of choice for elite military forces and law enforcement, designed for close-in combat speed and versatility. It comes on a new QD system that makes the optic sit higher for a 1/3 co-witness position.

h_k_sight_02fcc3ab.name: H&K Sight
h_k_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on the X46A2. These sights are unique as they have two different forms, as they can be folded into two different configurations, which you will not be doing.

hensoldt_3x_sight_010f9d6d.name: Hensoldt 3x Sight
hensoldt_3x_sight_010f9d6d.info:
Press T to change zoom level.

A modular component for the STG-91 rifles, featuring a 3x optical sight and carry handle combination. It was a common sight on early STG-91 models, and was often accompanied by a special reflex sight.

kel_tec_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Kel-Tec Sight
kel_tec_sight_02fcc3ab.info: 1.5x zoom. A low-profile aperture sight with elevation and windage adjustments.

microdot_mini_02fcc3ab.name: Microdot Mini
microdot_mini_02fcc3ab.info:
A sight with robust quality, light weight, and the performance of full-sized sights all in a small package.
Model by Makosushi.

delta_sight_77d412b4.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_77d412b4.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_b601c060.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_b601c060.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

eotech_m40_02fcc3ab.name: EOTech M40
eotech_m40_02fcc3ab.info:
The M40 Holo is an optic designed for use with grenade launchers, but who needs a grenade launcher really?
Model by Mako.

diopter_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Diopter Sight
diopter_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on the SMX-9 family of weapons. These sights are able to be rotated and adjusted with various sizes of closed peep sight holes for ranging.

kousaku_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Kousaku Sight
kousaku_sight_02fcc3ab.info: A homemade sight that uses Tetsujin black magic.

animu_sight_02fcc3ab.name: Animu Sight
animu_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Your personal waifu giving her neko love to support you in combat.

buis_sight_02fcc3ab.name: BUIS Sight
buis_sight_02fcc3ab.info: Iron sights found on the NEOWULF ECR. These sights are produced by Mangonel with a front sight which can be folded into different positions depending on your weapon. The front sight is also based on the M16A2 front iron sight.

ddhb_reflex_02fcc3ab.name: DDHB Reflex
ddhb_reflex_02fcc3ab.info: The Dagger Defense DDHB is an ergonomically designed red dot sight, constructed from aircraft grade aluminum for durability and lightness.

elfx_sight_02fcc3ab.name: ELFX Sight
elfx_sight_02fcc3ab.info: A miniature red-dot sight with a large square viewing window. Very clear picture compared to most reflex sights.

iwi_sight_02fcc3ab.name: IWI Sight
iwi_sight_02fcc3ab.info: 1.25x zoom. An aperture sight often found on the Tavor family of weapons as an aftermarket option. *Aperture not included.

microdot_srs_02fcc3ab.name: Microdot SRS
microdot_srs_02fcc3ab.info:
A sealed reflex sight for expert marksmen. Powered by a combination of a single double A battery helped by a solar cell.
Model by Makosushi.

long_barrel_pistol_f20e5aaa.name: Long Barrel (PISTOL)
long_barrel_pistol_f20e5aaa.info: Lengthened barrel best suited for longer range engagements. Attachment flattens out the damage curve of the weapon giving said weapon a more gradual damage reduction over distance.

33rd_mag_d6295a13.name: 33rd Mag
33rd_mag_d6295a13.info: A factory manufactured extended magazine for the G17 and G18. Guaranteed to make missing slightly less of a problem.

glock_switch_f325d4f7.name: Glock Switch
glock_switch_f325d4f7.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

rat_shot_73ae6643.name: Rat Shot
rat_shot_73ae6643.info: Pitifully weak multi projectile shell designed to be fired from a .22lr firearm.

pro_mag_14b67f97.name: Pro Mag
pro_mag_14b67f97.info:
A 50 round drum magazine for the Ruger 10/22, and by extension, the ZIP 22. Yeah, that's right, 50 rounds of .22 Long Rifle. Reduces mobility and aiming speed.
To have the pro mag, you must be a pro.

mini_sight_85bdbc73.name: Mini Sight
mini_sight_85bdbc73.info: The Mini Red Dot Sight (MRDS) is a small battery powered reflex sight for rapid target acquisition within close quarters. Its clear sight picture provides high visibility in all lighting conditions.

half_ring_sight_88350520.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_88350520.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

plague_insight_c914ef8b.name: Plague Insight
plague_insight_c914ef8b.info:
Harvest insect of unknown reality, forms a bond with the weapon it's put onto and the owner of said weapon. Different species of this insectoid are used depending on the weapon of choice. Press T and aim to enter a state of bloodshot covered rage.
Halloween 2020 sight.

delta_sight_85bdbc73.name: Delta Sight
delta_sight_85bdbc73.info: A compact delta reticle sight built to be durable. Provides a clean, single-point sight picture for extremely simple, accurate shot placement.

full_ring_sight_88350520.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_88350520.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

extended_magazine_bde79d9e.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_bde79d9e.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

12rd_mak_5eb13f40.name: 12rd MAK
12rd_mak_5eb13f40.info: Fits your Makarov family pistol with a 12rd magazine. Reduces total spare rounds carried.

osprey_suppressor_38d3b99c.name: Osprey Suppressor
osprey_suppressor_38d3b99c.info:
35 stud detection radius.

A light multi-caliber Western suppressor manufactured by SilencerCo for pistol caliber weaponry. Provides better hipfire accuracy, range, and exceptional masking, however aim accuracy is not affected.

extended_magazine_7c6fd8e4.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine_7c6fd8e4.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold more rounds. Sometimes reduces total spare rounds carried.

police_barrel_0fe19d13.name: Police Barrel
police_barrel_0fe19d13.info: The perfect barrel fitting for a crime fighting law abiding mercenary ready to bring the long arm of justice to this tainted land.

police_stock_dc959a13.name: Police Stock
police_stock_dc959a13.info: What's a sheriff without his deputy? This stock will be at your side to through the best and worst times. Treat it with respect.

long_barrel_gyrojet_b8933fc6.name: Long Barrel Gyrojet
long_barrel_gyrojet_b8933fc6.info:
Extended barrel for extended rocket flinging purposes.
This longer barrel is great for solving the Gyrojets primary issue at the cost of performance.

short_barrel_gyrojet_b8933fc6.name: Short Barrel Gyrojet
short_barrel_gyrojet_b8933fc6.info: Fits your Gyrojet with a shorter barrel, making an already small handheld rocket launcher even smaller. Costing accuracy and a couple thousand dollars.

gyrojet_12mm_rockets_4ed1950b.name: Gyrojet 12mm Rockets
gyrojet_12mm_rockets_4ed1950b.info:
12mm Rockets introduced with the Gyrojet Mark II.
This makes your Gyrojet load a newer, smaller .49 caliber rocket. These rockets will fly faster at the cost of a longer activation range. Higher firerate.

gyrojet_full_auto_conversion_005ca7e4.name: Gyrojet Full-Auto Conversion
gyrojet_full_auto_conversion_005ca7e4.info:
You ever wonder how the Grand Federation had made it to the moon? Rockets of course!
This fits your Gyrojet with the capability of firing in automatic. Trading off semi-auto performance for full-auto rocket power!

half_ring_sight_62eba27e.name: Half Ring Sight
half_ring_sight_62eba27e.info: A replacement half ring ghost sight for balanced visibility and rapid targeting at shorter ranges, with a thicker front post included.

full_ring_sight_62eba27e.name: Full Ring Sight
full_ring_sight_62eba27e.info: A replacement iron sight with a thin ring to minimize occlusion of the target, accompanied by a thicker front post for rapid target acquisition.

police_barrel_57ccd731.name: Police Barrel
police_barrel_57ccd731.info: The perfect barrel fitting for a crime fighting law abiding mercenary ready to bring the long arm of justice to this tainted land.

extended_barrel_xix_6df3e26c.name: Extended Barrel XIX
extended_barrel_xix_6df3e26c.info: Extends your Mark XIX Desert Eagles barrel length, providing greater damage over range at the cost of handling.

deagle_50_357_0afe7346.name: Deagle 50 357
deagle_50_357_0afe7346.info: A .44 wildcat round developed using a necked-down .50 AE cartridge for use in the Desert Eagle XIX. Stronger ballistic performance at range at the cost of some close-range power.

12rd_mak_24fbdc36.name: 12rd MAK
12rd_mak_24fbdc36.info: Fits your Makarov family pistol with a 12rd magazine. Reduces total spare rounds carried.

m1911_38_super_d0cf8d81.name: M1911 .38 Super
m1911_38_super_d0cf8d81.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your M1911 into .38 Super.
A smaller pistol cartridge with a higher muzzle velocity, recoil and damage over range and slightly increases penetration but deals less damage at close range.

m1911_22lr_conversion_8ef44f87.name: M1911 .22LR Conversion
m1911_22lr_conversion_8ef44f87.info:
Change the ammunition fired from your M1911 into .22 Rat Shot.
Why would you do this to yourself? Basically you have a mini shotgun...

m1911_dart_conversion_2d663403.name: M1911 Dart Conversion
m1911_dart_conversion_2d663403.info: Change the ammunition fired from your M1911 into a single dart. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.

engravings_577a4d22.name: Engravings
engravings_577a4d22.info: Some people call it the gun that won two world wars, however I just think it looks cool... Custom engravings that offer absolutely no tactical advantage, just bragging rights.

m3822_dart_conversion_7aee7005.name: M3822 Dart Conversion
m3822_dart_conversion_7aee7005.info: Load your AF2011-A1 into two barrel loaded darts. Deals more damage, but with worse recoil, low bullet velocity and less ammunition carried.

m17_21rnd_f922875f.name: M17 21rnd
m17_21rnd_f922875f.info: Inreases your magsize from 17 to 21. 5% decrease to overall mobility.

short_barrel_pistol_4edfa263.name: Short Barrel (PISTOL)
short_barrel_pistol_4edfa263.info:
Shorter barrel best suited for close range engagements.
Greater mid-range performance at the cost of long range performance and penetration. Greater mobility.

long_barrel_sniper_ddb1032b.name: Long Barrel (SNIPER)
long_barrel_sniper_ddb1032b.info:
Heavier barrel best suited for longer range engagements.
Greater long range potential, with a faster bullet speed and higher penetration, but worse close overall handling and movement.

glock_switch_1be4a4c3.name: Glock Switch
glock_switch_1be4a4c3.info: Replaces parts of your G-Series pistol to allow it to fire fully automatic and become a machine gun by law. However, you cannot stop it from firing

elite_darts_ad73c815.name: Elite Darts
elite_darts_ad73c815.info: The most dangerous ammunition known to man.
